4.  If <var>position</var> is beyond the end of <var>input</var> or if the character at <var>position</var> is neither a U&#43;0054 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER T character &#40;T&#41; nor a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; then fail&#46; Otherwise&#44; move <var>position</var> forwards one character&#46;

5.  <a id="global&#45;dates&#45;and&#45;times&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;component"></a>[Parse a time component](#parse-a-time-component) to obtain <var>hour</var>&#44; <var>minute</var>&#44; and <var>second</var>&#46; If this returns nothing&#44; then fail&#46;

6.  If <var>position</var> is beyond the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

7.  <a id="global&#45;dates&#45;and&#45;times&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;zone&#45;offset&#45;component"></a>[Parse a time&#45;zone offset component](#parse-a-time-zone-offset-component) to obtain <var>timezone<sub>hours</sub></var> and <var>timezone<sub>minutes</sub></var>&#46; If this returns nothing&#44; then fail&#46;

8.  If <var>position</var> is <em>not</em> beyond the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

9.  Let <var>time</var> be the moment in time at year <var>year</var>&#44; month <var>month</var>&#44; day <var>day</var>&#44; hours <var>hour</var>&#44; minute <var>minute</var>&#44; second <var>second</var>&#44; subtracting <var>timezone<sub>hours</sub></var> hours and <var>timezone<sub>minutes</sub></var> minutes&#46; That moment in time is a moment in the UTC time zone&#46;

10. Let <var>timezone</var> be <var>timezone<sub>hours</sub></var> hours and <var>timezone<sub>minutes</sub></var> minutes from UTC&#46;

11. Return <var>time</var> and <var>timezone</var>&#46;

##### <a id="weeks"></a>2&#46;3&#46;5&#46;8 Weeks[](#weeks)

A <a id="concept&#45;week"></a><strong>week</strong> consists of a week&#45;year number and a week number representing a seven&#45;day period starting on a Monday&#46; Each week&#45;year in this calendaring system has either 52 or 53 such seven&#45;day periods&#44; as defined below&#46; The seven&#45;day period starting on the Gregorian date Monday December 29th 1969 &#40;1969&#45;12&#45;29&#41; is defined as week number 1 in week&#45;year 1970&#46; Consecutive weeks are numbered sequentially&#46; The week before the number 1 week in a week&#45;year is the last week in the previous week&#45;year&#44; and vice versa&#46; [&#91;GREGORIAN&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsGREGORIAN)

A week&#45;year with a number <var>year</var> has 53 weeks if it corresponds to either a year <var>year</var> in the <a id="weeks&#58;proleptic&#45;gregorian&#45;calendar"></a>[proleptic Gregorian calendar](#proleptic-gregorian-calendar) that has a Thursday as its first day &#40;January 1st&#41;&#44; or a year <var>year</var> in the <a id="weeks&#58;proleptic&#45;gregorian&#45;calendar&#45;2"></a>[proleptic Gregorian calendar](#proleptic-gregorian-calendar) that has a Wednesday as its first day &#40;January 1st&#41; and where <var>year</var> is a number divisible by 400&#44; or a number divisible by 4 but not by 100&#46; All other week&#45;years have 52 weeks&#46;

The <a id="week&#45;number&#45;of&#45;the&#45;last&#45;day"></a><strong>week number of the last day</strong> of a week&#45;year with 53 weeks is 53&#59; the week number of the last day of a week&#45;year with 52 weeks is 52&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The week&#45;year number of a particular day can be different than the number of the year that contains that day in the <a id="weeks&#58;proleptic&#45;gregorian&#45;calendar&#45;3"></a>[proleptic Gregorian calendar](#proleptic-gregorian-calendar)&#46; The first week in a week&#45;year <var>y</var> is the week that contains the first Thursday of the Gregorian year <var>y</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For modern purposes&#44; a <a id="weeks&#58;concept&#45;week"></a>[week](#concept-week) as defined here is equivalent to ISO weeks as defined in ISO 8601&#46; [&#91;ISO8601&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsISO8601)

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;week&#45;string"></a><strong>valid week string</strong> representing a week&#45;year <var>year</var> and week <var>week</var> if it consists of the following components in the given order&#58;

1.  Four or more <a id="weeks&#58;ascii&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; representing <var>year</var>&#44; where <var>year</var> &#62; 0
2.  A U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41;
3.  A U&#43;0057 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER W character &#40;W&#41;
4.  Two <a id="weeks&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;2"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; representing the week <var>week</var>&#44; in the range 1 ≤ <var>week</var> ≤ <var>maxweek</var>&#44; where <var>maxweek</var> is the <a id="weeks&#58;week&#45;number&#45;of&#45;the&#45;last&#45;day"></a>[week number of the last day](#week-number-of-the-last-day) of week&#45;year <var>year</var>

The rules to <a id="parse&#45;a&#45;week&#45;string"></a><strong>parse a week string</strong> are as follows&#46; This will return either a week&#45;year number and week number&#44; or nothing&#46; If at any point the algorithm says that it &#34;fails&#34;&#44; this means that it is aborted at that point and returns nothing&#46;

1.  Let <var>input</var> be the string being parsed&#46;

2.  Let <var>position</var> be a pointer into <var>input</var>&#44; initially pointing at the start of the string&#46;

3.  <a id="weeks&#58;collect&#45;a&#45;sequence&#45;of&#45;code&#45;points"></a>[Collect a sequence of code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points) that are <a id="weeks&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;3"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) from <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46; If the collected sequence is not at least four characters long&#44; then fail&#46; Otherwise&#44; interpret the resulting sequence as a base&#45;ten integer&#46; Let <var>year</var> be that number&#46;

4.  If <var>year</var> is not a number greater than zero&#44; then fail&#46;

5.  If <var>position</var> is beyond the end of <var>input</var> or if the character at <var>position</var> is not a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character&#44; then fail&#46; Otherwise&#44; move <var>position</var> forwards one character&#46;

6.  If <var>position</var> is beyond the end of <var>input</var> or if the character at <var>position</var> is not a U&#43;0057 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER W character &#40;W&#41;&#44; then fail&#46; Otherwise&#44; move <var>position</var> forwards one character&#46;

7.  <a id="weeks&#58;collect&#45;a&#45;sequence&#45;of&#45;code&#45;points&#45;2"></a>[Collect a sequence of code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points) that are <a id="weeks&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;4"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) from <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46; If the collected sequence is not exactly two characters long&#44; then fail&#46; Otherwise&#44; interpret the resulting sequence as a base&#45;ten integer&#46; Let <var>week</var> be that number&#46;

8.  Let <var>maxweek</var> be the <a id="weeks&#58;week&#45;number&#45;of&#45;the&#45;last&#45;day&#45;2"></a>[week number of the last day](#week-number-of-the-last-day) of year <var>year</var>&#46;

9.  If <var>week</var> is not a number in the range 1 ≤ <var>week</var> ≤ <var>maxweek</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

10. If <var>position</var> is <em>not</em> beyond the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

11. Return the week&#45;year number <var>year</var> and the week number <var>week</var>&#46;

##### <a id="durations"></a>2&#46;3&#46;5&#46;9 Durations[](#durations)

A <a id="concept&#45;duration"></a><strong>duration</strong> consists of a number of seconds&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since months and seconds are not comparable &#40;a month is not a precise number of seconds&#44; but is instead a period whose exact length depends on the precise day from which it is measured&#41; a <a id="durations&#58;concept&#45;duration"></a>[duration](#concept-duration) as defined in this specification cannot include months &#40;or years&#44; which are equivalent to twelve months&#41;&#46; Only durations that describe a specific number of seconds can be described&#46;

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;duration&#45;string"></a><strong>valid duration string</strong> representing a <a id="durations&#58;concept&#45;duration&#45;2"></a>[duration](#concept-duration) <var>t</var> if it consists of either of the following&#58;

- A literal U&#43;0050 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER P character followed by one or more of the following subcomponents&#44; in the order given&#44; where the number of days&#44; hours&#44; minutes&#44; and seconds corresponds to the same number of seconds as in <var>t</var>&#58;

  1.  One or more <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) followed by a U&#43;0044 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER D character&#44; representing a number of days&#46;

  2.  A U&#43;0054 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER T character followed by one or more of the following subcomponents&#44; in the order given&#58;

      1.  One or more <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;2"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) followed by a U&#43;0048 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER H character&#44; representing a number of hours&#46;

      2.  One or more <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;3"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) followed by a U&#43;004D LATIN CAPITAL LETTER M character&#44; representing a number of minutes&#46;

      3.  The following components&#58;

          1.  One or more <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;4"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; representing a number of seconds&#46;

          2.  Optionally&#44; a U&#43;002E FULL STOP character &#40;&#46;&#41; followed by one&#44; two&#44; or three <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;5"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; representing a fraction of a second&#46;

          3.  A U&#43;0053 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER S character&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  This&#44; as with a number of other date&#45; and time&#45;related microsyntaxes defined in this specification&#44; is based on one of the formats defined in ISO 8601&#46; [&#91;ISO8601&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsISO8601)

- One or more <a id="durations&#58;duration&#45;time&#45;component"></a>[duration time components](#duration-time-component)&#44; each with a different <a id="durations&#58;duration&#45;time&#45;component&#45;scale"></a>[duration time component scale](#duration-time-component-scale)&#44; in any order&#59; the sum of the represented seconds being equal to the number of seconds in <var>t</var>&#46;

  A <a id="duration&#45;time&#45;component"></a><strong>duration time component</strong> is a string consisting of the following components&#58;

  1.  Zero or more <a id="durations&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

  2.  One or more <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;6"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; representing a number of time units&#44; scaled by the <a id="durations&#58;duration&#45;time&#45;component&#45;scale&#45;2"></a>[duration time component scale](#duration-time-component-scale) specified &#40;see below&#41; to represent a number of seconds&#46;

  3.  If the <a id="durations&#58;duration&#45;time&#45;component&#45;scale&#45;3"></a>[duration time component scale](#duration-time-component-scale) specified is 1 &#40;i&#46;e&#46; the units are seconds&#41;&#44; then&#44; optionally&#44; a U&#43;002E FULL STOP character &#40;&#46;&#41; followed by one&#44; two&#44; or three <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;7"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; representing a fraction of a second&#46;

  4.  Zero or more <a id="durations&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

  5.  One of the following characters&#44; representing the <a id="duration&#45;time&#45;component&#45;scale"></a><strong>duration time component scale</strong> of the time unit used in the numeric part of the <a id="durations&#58;duration&#45;time&#45;component&#45;2"></a>[duration time component](#duration-time-component)&#58;

      <strong>U&#43;0057 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER W character</strong>

      <strong>U&#43;0077 LATIN SMALL LETTER W character</strong>

      Weeks&#46; The scale is 604800&#46;
      <strong>U&#43;0044 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER D character</strong>

      <strong>U&#43;0064 LATIN SMALL LETTER D character</strong>

      Days&#46; The scale is 86400&#46;
      <strong>U&#43;0048 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER H character</strong>

      <strong>U&#43;0068 LATIN SMALL LETTER H character</strong>

      Hours&#46; The scale is 3600&#46;
      <strong>U&#43;004D LATIN CAPITAL LETTER M character</strong>

      <strong>U&#43;006D LATIN SMALL LETTER M character</strong>

      Minutes&#46; The scale is 60&#46;
      <strong>U&#43;0053 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER S character</strong>

      <strong>U&#43;0073 LATIN SMALL LETTER S character</strong>

      Seconds&#46; The scale is 1&#46;

  6.  Zero or more <a id="durations&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  This is not based on any of the formats in ISO 8601&#46; It is intended to be a more human&#45;readable alternative to the ISO 8601 duration format&#46;

The rules to <a id="parse&#45;a&#45;duration&#45;string"></a><strong>parse a duration string</strong> are as follows&#46; This will return either a <a id="durations&#58;concept&#45;duration&#45;3"></a>[duration](#concept-duration) or nothing&#46; If at any point the algorithm says that it &#34;fails&#34;&#44; this means that it is aborted at that point and returns nothing&#46;

1.  Let <var>input</var> be the string being parsed&#46;

2.  Let <var>position</var> be a pointer into <var>input</var>&#44; initially pointing at the start of the string&#46;

3.  Let <var>months</var>&#44; <var>seconds</var>&#44; and <var>component count</var> all be zero&#46;

4.  Let <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> be <em>minutes</em>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This flag&#39;s other value is <em>months</em>&#46; It is used to disambiguate the &#34;M&#34; unit in ISO8601 durations&#44; which use the same unit for months and minutes&#46; Months are not allowed&#44; but are parsed for future compatibility and to avoid misinterpreting ISO8601 durations that would be valid in other contexts&#46;

5.  <a id="durations&#58;skip&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[Skip ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#skip-ascii-whitespace) within <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46;

6.  If <var>position</var> is past the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

7.  If the character in <var>input</var> pointed to by <var>position</var> is a U&#43;0050 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER P character&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next character&#44; set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>months</em>&#44; and <a id="durations&#58;skip&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[skip ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#skip-ascii-whitespace) within <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46;

8.  While true&#58;

    1.  Let <var>units</var> be undefined&#46; It will be assigned one of the following values&#58; <em>years</em>&#44; <em>months</em>&#44; <em>weeks</em>&#44; <em>days</em>&#44; <em>hours</em>&#44; <em>minutes</em>&#44; and <em>seconds</em>&#46;

    2.  Let <var>next character</var> be undefined&#46; It is used to process characters from the <var>input</var>&#46;

    3.  If <var>position</var> is past the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then break&#46;

    4.  If the character in <var>input</var> pointed to by <var>position</var> is a U&#43;0054 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER T character&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next character&#44; set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#44; <a id="durations&#58;skip&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;3"></a>[skip ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#skip-ascii-whitespace) within <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#44; and <a id="durations&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    5.  Set <var>next character</var> to the character in <var>input</var> pointed to by <var>position</var>&#46;

    6.  If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;002E FULL STOP character &#40;&#46;&#41;&#44; then let <var>N</var> be 0&#46; &#40;Do not advance <var>position</var>&#46; That is taken care of below&#46;&#41;

        Otherwise&#44; if <var>next character</var> is an <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;8"></a>[ASCII digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)&#44; then <a id="durations&#58;collect&#45;a&#45;sequence&#45;of&#45;code&#45;points"></a>[collect a sequence of code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points) that are <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;9"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) from <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#44; interpret the resulting sequence as a base&#45;ten integer&#44; and let <var>N</var> be that number&#46;

        Otherwise&#44; <var>next character</var> is not part of a number&#59; fail&#46;

    7.  If <var>position</var> is past the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

    8.  Set <var>next character</var> to the character in <var>input</var> pointed to by <var>position</var>&#44; and this time advance <var>position</var> to the next character&#46; &#40;If <var>next character</var> was a U&#43;002E FULL STOP character &#40;&#46;&#41; before&#44; it will still be that character this time&#46;&#41;

    9.  If <var>next character</var> is U&#43;002E &#40;&#46;&#41;&#58;

        1.  <a id="durations&#58;collect&#45;a&#45;sequence&#45;of&#45;code&#45;points&#45;2"></a>[Collect a sequence of code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points) that are <a id="durations&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;10"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) from <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46; Let <var>s</var> be the resulting sequence&#46;

        2.  If <var>s</var> is the empty string&#44; then fail&#46;

        3.  Let <var>length</var> be the number of characters in <var>s</var>&#46;

        4.  Let <var>fraction</var> be the result of interpreting <var>s</var> as a base&#45;ten integer&#44; and then dividing that number by 10<sup><var>length</var></sup>&#46;

        5.  Increment <var>N</var> by <var>fraction</var>&#46;

        6.  <a id="durations&#58;skip&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;4"></a>[Skip ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#skip-ascii-whitespace) within <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46;

        7.  If <var>position</var> is past the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

        8.  Set <var>next character</var> to the character in <var>input</var> pointed to by <var>position</var>&#44; and advance <var>position</var> to the next character&#46;

        9.  If <var>next character</var> is neither a U&#43;0053 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER S character nor a U&#43;0073 LATIN SMALL LETTER S character&#44; then fail&#46;

        10. Set <var>units</var> to <em>seconds</em>&#46;

        Otherwise&#58;

        1.  If <var>next character</var> is <a id="durations&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;4"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; then <a id="durations&#58;skip&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;5"></a>[skip ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#skip-ascii-whitespace) within <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#44; set <var>next character</var> to the character in <var>input</var> pointed to by <var>position</var>&#44; and advance <var>position</var> to the next character&#46;

        2.  If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;0059 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER Y character&#44; or a U&#43;0079 LATIN SMALL LETTER Y character&#44; set <var>units</var> to <em>years</em> and set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>months</em>&#46;

            If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;004D LATIN CAPITAL LETTER M character or a U&#43;006D LATIN SMALL LETTER M character&#44; and <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> is <em>months</em>&#44; then set <var>units</var> to <em>months</em>&#46;

            If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;0057 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER W character or a U&#43;0077 LATIN SMALL LETTER W character&#44; set <var>units</var> to <em>weeks</em> and set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#46;

            If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;0044 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER D character or a U&#43;0064 LATIN SMALL LETTER D character&#44; set <var>units</var> to <em>days</em> and set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#46;

            If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;0048 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER H character or a U&#43;0068 LATIN SMALL LETTER H character&#44; set <var>units</var> to <em>hours</em> and set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#46;

            If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;004D LATIN CAPITAL LETTER M character or a U&#43;006D LATIN SMALL LETTER M character&#44; and <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> is <em>minutes</em>&#44; then set <var>units</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#46;

            If <var>next character</var> is a U&#43;0053 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER S character or a U&#43;0073 LATIN SMALL LETTER S character&#44; set <var>units</var> to <em>seconds</em> and set <var>M&#45;disambiguator</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#46;

            Otherwise&#44; if <var>next character</var> is none of the above characters&#44; then fail&#46;

    10. Increment <var>component count</var>&#46;

    11. Let <var>multiplier</var> be 1&#46;

    12. If <var>units</var> is <em>years</em>&#44; multiply <var>multiplier</var> by 12 and set <var>units</var> to <em>months</em>&#46;

    13. If <var>units</var> is <em>months</em>&#44; add the product of <var>N</var> and <var>multiplier</var> to <var>months</var>&#46;

        Otherwise&#58;

        1.  If <var>units</var> is <em>weeks</em>&#44; multiply <var>multiplier</var> by 7 and set <var>units</var> to <em>days</em>&#46;

        2.  If <var>units</var> is <em>days</em>&#44; multiply <var>multiplier</var> by 24 and set <var>units</var> to <em>hours</em>&#46;

        3.  If <var>units</var> is <em>hours</em>&#44; multiply <var>multiplier</var> by 60 and set <var>units</var> to <em>minutes</em>&#46;

        4.  If <var>units</var> is <em>minutes</em>&#44; multiply <var>multiplier</var> by 60 and set <var>units</var> to <em>seconds</em>&#46;

        5.  Forcibly&#44; <var>units</var> is now <em>seconds</em>&#46; Add the product of <var>N</var> and <var>multiplier</var> to <var>seconds</var>&#46;

    14. <a id="durations&#58;skip&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;6"></a>[Skip ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#skip-ascii-whitespace) within <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#46;

9.  If <var>component count</var> is zero&#44; fail&#46;

10. If <var>months</var> is not zero&#44; fail&#46;

11. Return the <a id="durations&#58;concept&#45;duration&#45;4"></a>[duration](#concept-duration) consisting of <var>seconds</var> seconds&#46;

##### <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time"></a>2&#46;3&#46;5&#46;10 Vaguer moments in time[](#vaguer-moments-in-time)

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;with&#45;optional&#45;time"></a><strong>valid date string with optional time</strong> if it is also one of the following&#58;

- A <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[valid date string](#valid-date-string)
- A <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;valid&#45;global&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string"></a>[valid global date and time string](#valid-global-date-and-time-string)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The rules to <a id="parse&#45;a&#45;date&#45;or&#45;time&#45;string"></a><strong>parse a date or time string</strong> are as follows&#46; The algorithm will return either a <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;concept&#45;date"></a>[date](#concept-date)&#44; a <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;concept&#45;time"></a>[time](#concept-time)&#44; a <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;concept&#45;datetime"></a>[global date and time](#concept-datetime)&#44; or nothing&#46; If at any point the algorithm says that it &#34;fails&#34;&#44; this means that it is aborted at that point and returns nothing&#46;

1.  Let <var>input</var> be the string being parsed&#46;

2.  Let <var>position</var> be a pointer into <var>input</var>&#44; initially pointing at the start of the string&#46;

3.  Set <var>start position</var> to the same position as <var>position</var>&#46;

4.  Set the <var>date present</var> and <var>time present</var> flags to true&#46;

5.  <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;date&#45;component"></a>[Parse a date component](#parse-a-date-component) to obtain <var>year</var>&#44; <var>month</var>&#44; and <var>day</var>&#46; If this fails&#44; then set the <var>date present</var> flag to false&#46;

6.  If <var>date present</var> is true&#44; and <var>position</var> is not beyond the end of <var>input</var>&#44; and the character at <var>position</var> is either a U&#43;0054 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER T character &#40;T&#41; or a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next character in <var>input</var>&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; if <var>date present</var> is true&#44; and either <var>position</var> is beyond the end of <var>input</var> or the character at <var>position</var> is neither a U&#43;0054 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER T character &#40;T&#41; nor a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; then set <var>time present</var> to false&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; if <var>date present</var> is false&#44; set <var>position</var> back to the same position as <var>start position</var>&#46;

7.  If the <var>time present</var> flag is true&#44; then <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;component"></a>[parse a time component](#parse-a-time-component) to obtain <var>hour</var>&#44; <var>minute</var>&#44; and <var>second</var>&#46; If this returns nothing&#44; then fail&#46;

8.  If the <var>date present</var> and <var>time present</var> flags are both true&#44; but <var>position</var> is beyond the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

9.  If the <var>date present</var> and <var>time present</var> flags are both true&#44; <a id="vaguer&#45;moments&#45;in&#45;time&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;zone&#45;offset&#45;component"></a>[parse a time&#45;zone offset component](#parse-a-time-zone-offset-component) to obtain <var>timezone<sub>hours</sub></var> and <var>timezone<sub>minutes</sub></var>&#46; If this returns nothing&#44; then fail&#46;

10. If <var>position</var> is <em>not</em> beyond the end of <var>input</var>&#44; then fail&#46;

11. If the <var>date present</var> flag is true and the <var>time present</var> flag is false&#44; then let <var>date</var> be the date with year <var>year</var>&#44; month <var>month</var>&#44; and day <var>day</var>&#44; and return <var>date</var>&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; if the <var>time present</var> flag is true and the <var>date present</var> flag is false&#44; then let <var>time</var> be the time with hour <var>hour</var>&#44; minute <var>minute</var>&#44; and second <var>second</var>&#44; and return <var>time</var>&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; let <var>time</var> be the moment in time at year <var>year</var>&#44; month <var>month</var>&#44; day <var>day</var>&#44; hours <var>hour</var>&#44; minute <var>minute</var>&#44; second <var>second</var>&#44; subtracting <var>timezone<sub>hours</sub></var> hours and <var>timezone<sub>minutes</sub></var> minutes&#44; that moment in time being a moment in the UTC time zone&#59; let <var>timezone</var> be <var>timezone<sub>hours</sub></var> hours and <var>timezone<sub>minutes</sub></var> minutes from UTC&#59; and return <var>time</var> and <var>timezone</var>&#46;

#### <a id="colours"></a>2&#46;3&#46;6 Legacy colors[](#colours)

Some obsolete legacy attributes parse colors using the <a id="rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;legacy&#45;colour&#45;value"></a><strong>rules for parsing a legacy color value</strong>&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#46; They will return either a CSS color or failure&#46;

1.  If <var>input</var> is the empty string&#44; then return failure&#46;

2.  <a id="colours&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from <var>input</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>input</var> is an <a id="colours&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>transparent</code>&#34;&#44; then return failure&#46;

4.  If <var>input</var> is an <a id="colours&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the <a id="colours&#58;named&#45;color"></a>[named colors](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#named-color)&#44; then return the CSS color corresponding to that keyword&#46; [&#91;CSSCOLOR&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSCOLOR)

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    [CSS2 System Colors](https://www.w3.org/TR/css3-color/#css2-system) are not recognized&#46;

5.  If <var>input</var>&#39;s <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point&#45;length"></a>[code point length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-code-point-length) is four&#44; and the first character in <var>input</var> is U&#43;0023 &#40;&#35;&#41;&#44; and the last three characters of <var>input</var> are all <a id="colours&#58;ascii&#45;hex&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII hex digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-hex-digit)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>result</var> be a CSS color&#46;

    2.  Interpret the second character of <var>input</var> as a hexadecimal digit&#59; let the red component of <var>result</var> be the resulting number multiplied by 17&#46;

    3.  Interpret the third character of <var>input</var> as a hexadecimal digit&#59; let the green component of <var>result</var> be the resulting number multiplied by 17&#46;

    4.  Interpret the fourth character of <var>input</var> as a hexadecimal digit&#59; let the blue component of <var>result</var> be the resulting number multiplied by 17&#46;

    5.  Return <var>result</var>&#46;

6.  Replace any <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point"></a>[code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-point) greater than U&#43;FFFF in <var>input</var> &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; any characters that are not in the basic multilingual plane&#41; with &#34;<code>00</code>&#34;&#46;

7.  If <var>input</var>&#39;s <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point&#45;length&#45;2"></a>[code point length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-code-point-length) is greater than 128&#44; truncate <var>input</var>&#44; leaving only the first 128 characters&#46;

8.  If the first character in <var>input</var> is U&#43;0023 &#40;&#35;&#41;&#44; then remove it&#46;

9.  Replace any character in <var>input</var> that is not an <a id="colours&#58;ascii&#45;hex&#45;digits&#45;2"></a>[ASCII hex digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-hex-digit) with U&#43;0030 &#40;0&#41;&#46;

10. While <var>input</var>&#39;s <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point&#45;length&#45;3"></a>[code point length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-code-point-length) is zero or not a multiple of three&#44; append U&#43;0030 &#40;0&#41; to <var>input</var>&#46;

11. Split <var>input</var> into three strings of equal <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point&#45;length&#45;4"></a>[code point length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-code-point-length)&#44; to obtain three components&#46; Let <var>length</var> be the <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point&#45;length&#45;5"></a>[code point length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-code-point-length) that all of those components have &#40;one third the <a id="colours&#58;code&#45;point&#45;length&#45;6"></a>[code point length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-code-point-length) of <var>input</var>&#41;&#46;

12. If <var>length</var> is greater than 8&#44; then remove the leading <var>length</var>&#45;8 characters in each component&#44; and let <var>length</var> be 8&#46;

13. While <var>length</var> is greater than two and the first character in each component is U&#43;0030 &#40;0&#41;&#44; remove that character and reduce <var>length</var> by one&#46;

14. If <var>length</var> is <em>still</em> greater than two&#44; truncate each component&#44; leaving only the first two characters in each&#46;

15. Let <var>result</var> be a CSS color&#46;

16. Interpret the first component as a hexadecimal number&#59; let the red component of <var>result</var> be the resulting number&#46;

17. Interpret the second component as a hexadecimal number&#59; let the green component of <var>result</var> be the resulting number&#46;

18. Interpret the third component as a hexadecimal number&#59; let the blue component of <var>result</var> be the resulting number&#46;

19. Return <var>result</var>&#46;

#### <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>2&#46;3&#46;7 Space&#45;separated tokens[](#space-separated-tokens)

A <a id="set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a><strong>set of space&#45;separated tokens</strong> is a string containing zero or more words &#40;known as tokens&#41; separated by one or more <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; where words consist of any string of one or more characters&#44; none of which are <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

A string containing a <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-space-separated-tokens) may have leading or trailing <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

An <a id="unordered&#45;set&#45;of&#45;unique&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a><strong>unordered set of unique space&#45;separated tokens</strong> is a <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#45;2"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-space-separated-tokens) where none of the tokens are duplicated&#46;

An <a id="ordered&#45;set&#45;of&#45;unique&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a><strong>ordered set of unique space&#45;separated tokens</strong> is a <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#45;3"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-space-separated-tokens) where none of the tokens are duplicated but where the order of the tokens is meaningful&#46;

<a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#45;4"></a>[Sets of space&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-space-separated-tokens) sometimes have a defined set of allowed values&#46; When a set of allowed values is defined&#44; the tokens must all be from that list of allowed values&#59; other values are non&#45;conforming&#46; If no such set of allowed values is provided&#44; then all values are conforming&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

How tokens in a <a id="space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#45;5"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-space-separated-tokens) are to be compared &#40;e&#46;g&#46; case&#45;sensitively or not&#41; is defined on a per&#45;set basis&#46;

#### <a id="comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>2&#46;3&#46;8 Comma&#45;separated tokens[](#comma-separated-tokens)

A <a id="set&#45;of&#45;comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a><strong>set of comma&#45;separated tokens</strong> is a string containing zero or more tokens each separated from the next by a single U&#43;002C COMMA character &#40;&#44;&#41;&#44; where tokens consist of any string of zero or more characters&#44; neither beginning nor ending with <a id="comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; nor containing any U&#43;002C COMMA characters &#40;&#44;&#41;&#44; and optionally surrounded by <a id="comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; the string &#34;<code> a &#44;b&#44;&#44;d d </code>&#34; consists of four tokens&#58; &#34;a&#34;&#44; &#34;b&#34;&#44; the empty string&#44; and &#34;d d&#34;&#46; Leading and trailing whitespace around each token doesn&#39;t count as part of the token&#44; and the empty string can be a token&#46;

<a id="comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#58;set&#45;of&#45;comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[Sets of comma&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-comma-separated-tokens) sometimes have further restrictions on what consists a valid token&#46; When such restrictions are defined&#44; the tokens must all fit within those restrictions&#59; other values are non&#45;conforming&#46; If no such restrictions are specified&#44; then all values are conforming&#46;

#### <a id="syntax&#45;references"></a>2&#46;3&#46;9 References[](#syntax-references)

A <a id="valid&#45;hash&#45;name&#45;reference"></a><strong>valid hash&#45;name reference</strong> to an element of type <var>type</var> is a string consisting of a U&#43;0023 NUMBER SIGN character &#40;&#35;&#41; followed by a string which exactly matches the value of the <code>name</code> attribute of an element with type <var>type</var> in the same <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree)&#46;

The <a id="rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;hash&#45;name&#45;reference"></a><strong>rules for parsing a hash&#45;name reference</strong> to an element of type <var>type</var>&#44; given a context node <var>scope</var>&#44; are as follows&#58;

1.  If the string being parsed does not contain a U&#43;0023 NUMBER SIGN character&#44; or if the first such character in the string is the last character in the string&#44; then return null&#46;

2.  Let <var>s</var> be the string from the character immediately after the first U&#43;0023 NUMBER SIGN character in the string being parsed up to the end of that string&#46;

3.  Return the first element of type <var>type</var> in <var>scope</var>&#39;s <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;tree&#45;2"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree)&#44; in <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; that has an <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> or <code>name</code> attribute whose value is <var>s</var>&#44; or null if there is no such element&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Although <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attributes are accounted for when parsing&#44; they are not used in determining whether a value is a <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;valid&#45;hash&#45;name&#45;reference"></a>[<em>valid</em> hash&#45;name reference](#valid-hash-name-reference)&#46; That is&#44; a hash&#45;name reference that refers to an element based on <a id="syntax&#45;references&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> is a conformance error &#40;unless that element also has a <code>name</code> attribute with the same value&#41;&#46;

#### <a id="mq"></a>2&#46;3&#46;10 Media queries[](#mq)

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;media&#45;query&#45;list"></a><strong>valid media query list</strong> if it matches the <code>&#60;media&#45;query&#45;list&#62;</code> production of Media Queries&#46; [&#91;MQ&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMQ)

A string <a id="matches&#45;the&#45;environment"></a><strong>matches the environment</strong> of the user if it is the empty string&#44; a string consisting of only <a id="mq&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; or is a media query list that matches the user&#39;s environment according to the definitions given in Media Queries&#46; [&#91;MQ&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMQ)

#### <a id="unique&#45;values"></a>2&#46;3&#46;11 Unique internal values[](#unique-values)

A <a id="unique&#45;internal&#45;value"></a><strong>unique internal value</strong> is a value that is serializable&#44; comparable by value&#44; and never exposed to script&#46;

To create a <a id="new&#45;unique&#45;internal&#45;value"></a><strong>new unique internal value</strong>&#44; return a <a id="unique&#45;values&#58;unique&#45;internal&#45;value"></a>[unique internal value](#unique-internal-value) that has never previously been returned by this algorithm&#46;

### <a id="urls"></a>2&#46;4 URLs[](#urls)

#### <a id="terminology&#45;2"></a>2&#46;4&#46;1 Terminology[](#terminology-2)

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url"></a><strong>valid non&#45;empty URL</strong> if it is a <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;valid&#45;url&#45;string"></a>[valid URL string](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string) but it is not the empty string&#46;

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a><strong>valid URL potentially surrounded by spaces</strong> if&#44; after <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[stripping leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from it&#44; it is a <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;valid&#45;url&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid URL string](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string)&#46;

A string is a <a id="valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a><strong>valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces</strong> if&#44; after <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[stripping leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from it&#44; it is a <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL](#valid-non-empty-url)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This specification defines the URL <a id="about&#58;legacy&#45;compat"></a><strong><code>about&#58;legacy&#45;compat</code></strong> as a reserved&#44; though unresolvable&#44; <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;about&#45;protocol"></a><code>[about&#58;](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6694#section-2)</code> URL&#44; for use in <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;doctype"></a>[DOCTYPE](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-doctype)s in <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;html&#45;documents"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document) when needed for compatibility with XML tools&#46; [&#91;ABOUT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsABOUT)

This specification defines the URL <a id="about&#58;html&#45;kind"></a><strong><code>about&#58;html&#45;kind</code></strong> as a reserved&#44; though unresolvable&#44; <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;about&#45;protocol&#45;2"></a><code>[about&#58;](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6694#section-2)</code> URL&#44; that is used as an identifier for kinds of media tracks&#46; [&#91;ABOUT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsABOUT)

This specification defines the URL <a id="about&#58;srcdoc"></a><strong><code>about&#58;srcdoc</code></strong> as a reserved&#44; though unresolvable&#44; <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;about&#45;protocol&#45;3"></a><code>[about&#58;](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6694#section-2)</code> URL&#44; that is used as the <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) of <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document"></a>[<code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> documents](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#46; [&#91;ABOUT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsABOUT)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <a id="matches&#45;about&#58;blank"></a><strong>matches <code>about&#58;blank</code></strong> if its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;scheme"></a>[scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is &#34;<code>about</code>&#34;&#44; its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;path"></a>[path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) contains a single string &#34;<code>blank</code>&#34;&#44; its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;username"></a>[username](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-username) and <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;password"></a>[password](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-password) are the empty string&#44; and its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;host"></a>[host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host) is null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Such a URL&#39;s <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) and <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) can be non&#45;null&#46; For example&#44; the <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;url&#45;record"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) created by <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;url&#45;parser"></a>[parsing](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-parser) &#34;<code>about&#58;blank&#63;foo&#35;bar</code>&#34; <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;blank"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;blank</code>](#matches-about:blank)&#46;

A <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <a id="matches&#45;about&#58;srcdoc"></a><strong>matches <code>about&#58;srcdoc</code></strong> if its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;scheme&#45;2"></a>[scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is &#34;<code>about</code>&#34;&#44; its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) contains a single string &#34;<code>srcdoc</code>&#34;&#44; its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;2"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) is null&#44; its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;username&#45;2"></a>[username](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-username) and <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;password&#45;2"></a>[password](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-password) are the empty string&#44; and its <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;host&#45;2"></a>[host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host) is null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The reason that <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;srcdoc"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;srcdoc</code>](#matches-about:srcdoc) ensures that the <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;url&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#39;s <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;3"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) is null is because it is not possible to create <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#an-iframe-srcdoc-document) whose <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) has a non&#45;null <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;4"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query)&#44; unlike <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>s whose <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;blank&#45;2"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;blank</code>](#matches-about:blank)&#46; In other words&#44; the set of all <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;url&#45;4"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)s that <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;srcdoc&#45;2"></a>[match <code>about&#58;srcdoc</code>](#matches-about:srcdoc) only vary in their <a id="terminology&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment&#45;2"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment)&#46;

#### <a id="resolving&#45;urls"></a>2&#46;4&#46;2 Parsing URLs[](#resolving-urls)

Parsing a URL is the process of taking a string and obtaining the <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;record"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) that it represents&#46; While this process is defined in URL&#44; the HTML standard defines several wrappers to abstract base URLs and encodings&#46; [&#91;URL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsURL)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Most new APIs are to use <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[parse a URL](#parse-a-url)&#46; Older APIs and HTML elements might have reason to use <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parse a URL](#encoding-parsing-a-url)&#46; When a custom base URL is needed or no base URL is desired&#44; the <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;parser"></a>[URL parser](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-parser) can of course be used directly as well&#46;

To <a id="parse&#45;a&#45;url"></a><strong>parse a URL</strong>&#44; given a string <var>url</var>&#44; relative to a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object or <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;environment&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[environment settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#environment-settings-object) <var>environment</var>&#44; run these steps&#46; They return failure or a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46;

1.  Let <var>baseURL</var> be <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;base&#45;url"></a>[base URL](#document-base-url)&#44; if <var>environment</var> is a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#59; otherwise <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;api&#45;base&#45;url"></a>[API base URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#api-base-url)&#46;

2.  Return the result of applying the <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[URL parser](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-parser) to <var>url</var>&#44; with <var>baseURL</var>&#46;

<a id="resolve&#45;a&#45;url"></a>To <a id="encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a><strong>encoding&#45;parse a URL</strong>&#44; given a string <var>url</var>&#44; relative to a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object or <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;environment&#45;settings&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[environment settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#environment-settings-object) <var>environment</var>&#44; run these steps&#46; They return failure or a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46;

1.  Let <var>encoding</var> be <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;utf&#45;8"></a>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)&#46;

2.  If <var>environment</var> is a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#44; then set <var>encoding</var> to <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#39;s&#45;character&#45;encoding"></a>[character encoding](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding)&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) is a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> object&#44; set <var>encoding</var> to <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#39;s&#45;character&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[character encoding](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding)&#46;

4.  Let <var>baseURL</var> be <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;base&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[base URL](#document-base-url)&#44; if <var>environment</var> is a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#59; otherwise <var>environment</var>&#39;s <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;api&#45;base&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[API base URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#api-base-url)&#46;

5.  Return the result of applying the <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[URL parser](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-parser) to <var>url</var>&#44; with <var>baseURL</var> and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

To <a id="encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url"></a><strong>encoding&#45;parse&#45;and&#45;serialize a URL</strong>&#44; given a string <var>url</var>&#44; relative to a <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object or <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;environment&#45;settings&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[environment settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#environment-settings-object) <var>environment</var>&#44; run these steps&#46; They return failure or a string&#46;

1.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](#encoding-parsing-a-url) given <var>url</var>&#44; relative to <var>environment</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>url</var> is failure&#44; then return failure&#46;

3.  Return the result of applying the <a id="resolving&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;serializer"></a>[URL serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer) to <var>url</var>&#46;

#### <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls"></a>2&#46;4&#46;3 Document base URLs[](#document-base-urls)

The <a id="document&#45;base&#45;url"></a><strong>document base URL</strong> of a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var> is the <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;record"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) obtained by running these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>document</var> has no <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;descendant"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;base&#45;element"></a><code>[base](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-base-element)</code> element that has an <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;attr&#45;base&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-base-href)</code> attribute&#44; then return <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;fallback&#45;base&#45;url"></a>[fallback base URL](#fallback-base-url)&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; return the <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;frozen&#45;base&#45;url"></a>[frozen base URL](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#frozen-base-url) of the first <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;base&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[base](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-base-element)</code> element in <var>document</var> that has an <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;attr&#45;base&#45;href&#45;2"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-base-href)</code> attribute&#44; in <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

The <a id="fallback&#45;base&#45;url"></a><strong>fallback base URL</strong> of a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object <var>document</var> is the <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;record&#45;2"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) obtained by running these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>document</var> is <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document"></a>[an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#58;

    1.  <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;about&#45;base&#45;url"></a>[about base URL](#concept-document-about-base-url) is non&#45;null&#46;

    2.  Return <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;about&#45;base&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[about base URL](#concept-document-about-base-url)&#46;

2.  If <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;blank"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;blank</code>](#matches-about:blank) and <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;about&#45;base&#45;url&#45;3"></a>[about base URL](#concept-document-about-base-url) is non&#45;null&#44; then return <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;about&#45;base&#45;url&#45;4"></a>[about base URL](#concept-document-about-base-url)&#46;

3.  Return <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To <a id="set&#45;the&#45;url"></a><strong>set the URL</strong> for a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var> to a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;url&#45;record&#45;3"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <var>url</var>&#58;

1.  Set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) to <var>url</var>&#46;

2.  <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;respond&#45;to&#45;base&#45;url&#45;changes"></a>[Respond to base URL changes](#respond-to-base-url-changes) given <var>document</var>&#46;

<a id="dynamic&#45;changes&#45;to&#45;base&#45;urls"></a>To <a id="respond&#45;to&#45;base&#45;url&#45;changes"></a><strong>respond to base URL changes</strong> for a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var>&#58;

1.  The user agent should update any user interface elements which are displaying affected URLs&#44; or data derived from such URLs&#44; to the user&#46; Examples of such user interface elements would be a status bar that displays a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;hyperlink"></a>[hyperlink](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#hyperlink)&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;hyperlink&#45;url"></a>[url](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#concept-hyperlink-url)&#44; or some user interface which displays the URL specified by a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;q&#45;element"></a><code>[q](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-q-element)</code>&#44; <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;blockquote&#45;element"></a><code>[blockquote](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-blockquote-element)</code>&#44; <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code> element&#39;s <code>cite</code> attribute&#46;

2.  Ensure that the CSS <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;selector&#45;link"></a><code>[&#58;link](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#selector-link)</code>&#47;<a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;selector&#45;visited"></a><code>[&#58;visited](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#selector-visited)</code>&#47;etc&#46; <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;pseudo&#45;class"></a>[pseudo&#45;classes](https://drafts.csswg.org/selectors/#pseudo-class) are updated appropriately&#46;

3.  <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>descendant</var> of <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;shadow&#45;including&#45;descendant"></a>[shadow&#45;including descendants](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-descendant)&#58;

    1.  If <var>descendant</var> is a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element whose <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result"></a>[result](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-script-result) is a <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;speculation&#45;rules&#45;parse&#45;result"></a>[speculation rules parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#speculation-rules-parse-result)&#58;

        1.  Let <var>oldResult</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;script&#45;result&#45;2"></a>[result](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-script-result)&#46;

        2.  Let <var>newResult</var> be the result of <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;create&#45;a&#45;speculation&#45;rules&#45;parse&#45;result"></a>[creating a speculation rules parse result](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-speculation-rules-parse-result) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) and <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

        3.  <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;update&#45;speculation&#45;rules"></a>[Update speculation rules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#update-speculation-rules) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; <var>oldResult</var>&#44; and <var>newResult</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;consider&#45;speculative&#45;loads"></a>[Consider speculative loads](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#consider-speculative-loads) given <var>document</var>&#46;

<a id="example&#45;base&#45;url&#45;change&#45;img&#45;unaffected"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-base-url-change-img-unaffected)This means that changing the base URL doesn&#39;t affect&#44; for example&#44; the image displayed by <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> elements&#46; Thus&#44; subsequent accesses of the <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;dom&#45;img&#45;src"></a><code>[src](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#dom-img-src)</code> IDL attribute from script will return a new <a id="document&#45;base&#45;urls&#58;absolute&#45;url"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute) that might no longer correspond to the image being shown&#46;

### <a id="common&#45;dom&#45;interfaces"></a>2&#46;6 Common DOM interfaces[](#common-dom-interfaces)

#### <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes"></a>2&#46;6&#46;1 Reflecting content attributes in IDL attributes[](#reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes)

The building blocks for reflecting are as follows&#58;

- A <a id="reflected&#45;target"></a><strong>reflected target</strong> is an element or <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;elementinternals"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> object&#46; It is typically clear from context and typically identical to the interface of the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute)&#46; It is always identical to that interface when it is an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;elementinternals&#45;2"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> object&#46;

- A <a id="reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute"></a><strong>reflected IDL attribute</strong> is an attribute interface member&#46;

- A <a id="reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name"></a><strong>reflected content attribute name</strong> is a string&#46; When the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) is an element&#44; it represents the local name of a content attribute whose namespace is null&#46; When the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) is an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;elementinternals&#45;3"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> object&#44; it represents a key of the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;3"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#46;

A <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) can be defined to <a id="reflect"></a><strong>reflect</strong> a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name) of a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;4"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target)&#46; In general this means that the IDL attribute getter returns the current value of the content attribute&#44; and the setter changes the value of the content attribute to the given value&#46;

<a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;5"></a>[Reflected targets](#reflected-target) have these associated algorithms&#58;

- <a id="get&#45;the&#45;element"></a><strong>get the element</strong>&#58; takes no arguments&#59; returns an element&#46;
- <a id="get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute"></a><strong>get the content attribute</strong>&#58; takes no arguments&#59; returns null or a string&#46;
- <a id="set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute"></a><strong>set the content attribute</strong>&#58; takes a string <var>value</var>&#59; returns nothing&#46;
- <a id="delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute"></a><strong>delete the content attribute</strong>&#58; takes no arguments&#59; returns nothing&#46;

For a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;6"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) that is an element <var>element</var>&#44; these are defined as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)</strong>

1.  Return <var>element</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)</strong>

1.  Let <var>attribute</var> be the result of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;get&#45;by&#45;namespace"></a>[getting an attribute by namespace and local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-get-by-namespace) given null&#44; the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>attribute</var> is null&#44; then return null&#46;

3.  Return <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#46;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with a string <var>value</var></strong>

1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[Set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) given <var>element</var>&#44; the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#44; and <var>value</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute"></a>[delete the content attribute](#delete-the-content-attribute)</strong>

1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove&#45;by&#45;namespace"></a>[Remove an attribute by namespace and local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove-by-namespace) given null&#44; the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

For a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;7"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) that is an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;elementinternals&#45;4"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> object <var>elementInternals</var>&#44; they are defined as follows&#58;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)</strong>

1.  Return <var>elementInternals</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#46;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)</strong>

1.  If <var>elementInternals</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;3"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#91;the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;5"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#93; <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;map&#45;exists"></a>[does not exist](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#44; then return null&#46;

2.  Return <var>elementInternals</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;4"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map&#45;3"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#91;the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;6"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#93;&#46;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with a string <var>value</var></strong>

1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;map&#45;set"></a>[Set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set) <var>elementInternals</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;5"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map&#45;4"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#91;the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;7"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#93; to <var>value</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[delete the content attribute](#delete-the-content-attribute)</strong>

1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;map&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove) <var>elementInternals</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;6"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map&#45;5"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#91;the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;8"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#93;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>
