This results in somewhat redundant data structures for <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;elementinternals&#45;5"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> objects as their <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internals&#45;target&#45;7"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map&#45;6"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map) cannot be directly manipulated and as such reflection is only happening in a single direction&#46; This approach was nevertheless chosen to make it less error&#45;prone to define IDL attributes that are shared between <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;8"></a>[reflected targets](#reflected-target) and benefit from common API semantics&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

IDL attributes of type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;domstring"></a><code>[DOMString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString)</code> or <code><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;domstring&#45;2"></a>[DOMString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString)&#63;</code> that <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](#reflect) <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated](#enumerated-attribute) content attributes can be <a id="limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a><strong>limited to only known values</strong>&#46; Per the processing models below&#44; those will cause the getters for such IDL attributes to only return keywords for those enumerated attributes&#44; or the empty string or null&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;domstring&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString)</code>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)&#46;

  2.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  3.  Let <var>attributeDefinition</var> be the attribute definition of <var>element</var>&#39;s content attribute whose namespace is null and local name is the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;9"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

  4.  If <var>attributeDefinition</var> indicates it is an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[enumerated attribute](#enumerated-attribute) and the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is defined to be <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](#limited-to-only-known-values)&#58;

      1.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> does not correspond to any state of <var>attributeDefinition</var> &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; it is null and there is no <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](#missing-value-default)</em>&#41;&#44; or if it is in a state of <var>attributeDefinition</var> with no associated keyword value&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

      2.  Return the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;canonical&#45;keyword"></a>[canonical keyword](#canonical-keyword) for the state of <var>attributeDefinition</var> that <var>contentAttributeValue</var> corresponds to&#46;

  5.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is null&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

  6.  Return <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#46;

- The setter steps are to run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the given value&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <code><a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;domstring&#45;4"></a>[DOMString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString)&#63;</code>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)&#46;

  2.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  3.  Let <var>attributeDefinition</var> be the attribute definition of <var>element</var>&#39;s content attribute whose namespace is null and local name is the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;10"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

  4.  If <var>attributeDefinition</var> indicates it is an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[enumerated attribute](#enumerated-attribute)&#58;

      1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;6"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[limited to only known values](#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

      2.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>contentAttributeValue</var> corresponds to a state of <var>attributeDefinition</var>&#46;

      3.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> corresponds to a state of <var>attributeDefinition</var> with no associated keyword value&#44; then return null&#46;

      4.  Return the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;canonical&#45;keyword&#45;2"></a>[canonical keyword](#canonical-keyword) for the state of <var>attributeDefinition</var> that <var>contentAttributeValue</var> corresponds to&#46;

  5.  Return <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the given value is null&#44; then run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[delete the content attribute](#delete-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  2.  Otherwise&#44; run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the given value&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;7"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;usvstring"></a><code>[USVString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString)</code>&#44; optionally <a id="treated&#45;as&#45;a&#45;url"></a><strong>treated as a URL</strong>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)&#46;

  2.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  3.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;8"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;treated&#45;as&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[treated as a URL](#treated-as-a-url)&#58;

      1.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is null&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

      2.  Let <var>urlString</var> be the result of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#44; relative to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

      3.  If <var>urlString</var> is not failure&#44; then return <var>urlString</var>&#46;

  4.  Return <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#44; <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;convert"></a>[converted to a scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert)&#46;

- The setter steps are to run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the given value&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;9"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;boolean"></a><code>[boolean](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-boolean)</code>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;6"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  2.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is null&#44; then return false&#46;

  3.  Return true&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the given value is false&#44; then run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;12"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[delete the content attribute](#delete-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  2.  If the given value is true&#44; then run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;13"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;6"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the empty string&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This corresponds to the rules for <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean content attributes](#boolean-attribute)&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;10"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;long"></a><code>[long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long)</code>&#44; optionally <a id="limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers"></a><strong>limited to only non&#45;negative numbers</strong> and optionally with a <a id="default&#45;value"></a><strong>default value</strong> <var>defaultValue</var>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;14"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;7"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  2.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is not null&#58;

      1.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;integers"></a>[integer parsing](#rules-for-parsing-integers) <var>contentAttributeValue</var> if the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;11"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is not <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers"></a>[limited to only non&#45;negative numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers)&#59; otherwise the result of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[non&#45;negative integer parsing](#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#46;

      2.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is not an error and is within the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;long&#45;2"></a><code>[long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long)</code> range&#44; then return <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

  3.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;12"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value"></a>[default value](#default-value)&#44; then return <var>defaultValue</var>&#46;

  4.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;13"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;2"></a>[limited to only non&#45;negative numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers)&#44; then return −1&#46;

  5.  Return 0&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;14"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;3"></a>[limited to only non&#45;negative numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers) and the given value is negative&#44; then throw an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

  2.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;15"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;7"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the given value converted to the shortest possible string representing the number as a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;valid&#45;integer"></a>[valid integer](#valid-integer)&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;15"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;unsigned&#45;long"></a><code>[unsigned long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long)</code>&#44; optionally <a id="limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero"></a><strong>limited to only positive numbers</strong>&#44; <a id="limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;with&#45;fallback"></a><strong>limited to only positive numbers with fallback</strong>&#44; or <a id="clamped&#45;to&#45;the&#45;range"></a><strong>clamped to the range</strong> &#91;<var>clampedMin</var>&#44; <var>clampedMax</var>&#93;&#44; and optionally with a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[default value](#default-value) <var>defaultValue</var>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;16"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;8"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  2.  Let <var>minimum</var> be 0&#46;

  3.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;16"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero) or <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;with&#45;fallback"></a>[limited to only positive numbers with fallback](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback)&#44; then set <var>minimum</var> to 1&#46;

  4.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;17"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;clamped&#45;to&#45;the&#45;range"></a>[clamped to the range](#clamped-to-the-range)&#44; then set <var>minimum</var> to <var>clampedMin</var>&#46;

  5.  Let <var>maximum</var> be 2147483647 if the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;18"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is not <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;clamped&#45;to&#45;the&#45;range&#45;2"></a>[clamped to the range](#clamped-to-the-range)&#59; otherwise <var>clampedMax</var>&#46;

  6.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is not null&#58;

      1.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers&#45;2"></a>[non&#45;negative integer parsing](#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#46;

      2.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is not an error and is in the range <var>minimum</var> to <var>maximum</var>&#44; inclusive&#44; then return <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

      3.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is not an error and the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;19"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;clamped&#45;to&#45;the&#45;range&#45;3"></a>[clamped to the range](#clamped-to-the-range)&#58;

          1.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is less than <var>minimum</var>&#44; then return <var>minimum</var>&#46;

          2.  Return <var>maximum</var>&#46;

  7.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;20"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[default value](#default-value)&#44; then return <var>defaultValue</var>&#46;

  8.  Return <var>minimum</var>&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;21"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;2"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero) and the given value is 0&#44; then throw an <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

  2.  Let <var>minimum</var> be 0&#46;

  3.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;22"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;3"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero) or <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;with&#45;fallback&#45;2"></a>[limited to only positive numbers with fallback](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback)&#44; then set <var>minimum</var> to 1&#46;

  4.  Let <var>newValue</var> be <var>minimum</var>&#46;

  5.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;23"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[default value](#default-value)&#44; then set <var>newValue</var> to <var>defaultValue</var>&#46;

  6.  If the given value is in the range <var>minimum</var> to 2147483647&#44; inclusive&#44; then set <var>newValue</var> to it&#46;

  7.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;17"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;8"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with <var>newValue</var> converted to the shortest possible string representing the number as a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;clamped&#45;to&#45;the&#45;range&#45;4"></a>[Clamped to the range](#clamped-to-the-range) has no effect on the setter steps&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;24"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;double"></a><code>[double](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double)</code>&#44; optionally <a id="limited&#45;to&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero) and optionally with a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[default value](#default-value) <var>defaultValue</var>&#58;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;18"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;9"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  2.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is not null&#58;

      1.  Let <var>parsedValue</var> be the result of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values"></a>[floating&#45;point number parsing](#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values) <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#46;

      2.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is not an error and is greater than 0&#44; then return <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

      3.  If <var>parsedValue</var> is not an error and the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;25"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is not <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;4"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero)&#44; then return <var>parsedValue</var>&#46;

  3.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;26"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[default value](#default-value)&#44; then return <var>defaultValue</var>&#46;

  4.  Return 0&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;27"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;5"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero) and the given value is not greater than 0&#44; then return&#46;

  2.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;19"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;9"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the given value&#44; converted to the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;best&#45;representation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;number&#45;as&#45;a&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number"></a>[best representation of the number as a floating&#45;point number](#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The values Infinity and Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41; values throw an exception on setting&#44; as defined in Web IDL&#46; [&#91;WEBIDL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBIDL)

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;28"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;domtokenlist"></a><code>[DOMTokenList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-domtokenlist)</code>&#44; then its getter steps are to return a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;domtokenlist&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMTokenList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-domtokenlist)</code> object whose associated element is <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;20"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and associated attribute&#39;s local name is the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;11"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46; Specification authors cannot reflect IDL attributes of this type on <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;elementinternals&#45;6"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code>&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;29"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <code><var>T</var>&#63;</code>&#44; where <var>T</var> is either <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or an interface that inherits from <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>&#44; then with <var>attr</var> being the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;12"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#58;

- Its <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;9"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) has an <a id="explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element"></a><strong>explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element</strong>&#44; which is a weak reference to an element or null&#46; It is initially null&#46;

- Its <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;10"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) <var>reflectedTarget</var> has a <a id="attr&#45;associated&#45;element"></a><strong>get the <var>attr</var>&#45;associated element</strong> algorithm&#44; that runs these steps&#58;

  1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of running <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)&#46;

  2.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;10"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

  3.  If <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element) is not null&#58;

      1.  If <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element) is a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;descendant"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) of any of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;shadow&#45;including&#45;ancestor"></a>[shadow&#45;including ancestors](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-ancestor)&#44; then return <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element)&#46;

      2.  Return null&#46;

  4.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is not null&#44; return the first element <var>candidate</var>&#44; in <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; that meets the following criteria&#58;

      - <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;root"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root) is the same as <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;root&#45;2"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root)&#59;

      - <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) is <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#59; and

      - <var>candidate</var> <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;implements"></a>[implements](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#implements) <var>T</var>&#46;

      If no such element exists&#44; then return null&#46;

  5.  Return null&#46;

- The getter steps are to return the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;21"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[get the <var>attr</var>&#45;associated element](#attr-associated-element)&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the given value is null&#58;

      1.  Set <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;22"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element) to null&#46;

      2.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;23"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a>[delete the content attribute](#delete-the-content-attribute)&#46;

      3.  Return&#46;

  2.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;24"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;10"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the empty string&#46;

  3.  Set <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;25"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element) to a weak reference to the given value&#46;

- For element <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;11"></a>[reflected targets](#reflected-target) only&#58; the following <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;change&#45;ext"></a>[attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext)&#44; given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; <var>oldValue</var>&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; and <var>namespace</var>&#44; are used to synchronize between the content attribute and the IDL attribute&#58;

  1.  If <var>localName</var> is not <var>attr</var> or <var>namespace</var> is not null&#44; then return&#46;

  2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element) to null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;30"></a>[Reflected IDL attributes](#reflected-idl-attribute) of this type are strongly encouraged to have their identifier end in &#34;<code>Element</code>&#34; for consistency&#46;

If a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;31"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) has the type <code>FrozenArray&#60;<var>T</var>&#62;&#63;</code>&#44; where <var>T</var> is either <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;element&#45;3"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or an interface that inherits from <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;element&#45;4"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>&#44; then with <var>attr</var> being the <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;13"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#58;

- Its <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;12"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) has an <a id="explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements"></a><strong>explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements</strong>&#44; which is either a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of weak references to elements or null&#46; It is initially null&#46;

- Its <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;13"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) has a <a id="cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a><strong>cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;2"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of elements&#46; It is initially « »&#46;

- Its <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;14"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) has a <a id="cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements&#45;object"></a><strong>cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements object</strong>&#44; which is a <code>FrozenArray&#60;<var>T</var>&#62;&#63;</code>&#46; It is initially null&#46;

- Its <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;15"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target) <var>reflectedTarget</var> has a <a id="attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a><strong>get the <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements</strong> algorithm&#44; which runs these steps&#58;

  1.  Let <var>elements</var> be an empty <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;3"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

  2.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of running <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[get the element](#get-the-element)&#46;

  3.  If <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements](#explicitly-set-attr-elements) is not null&#58;

      1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>attrElement</var> in <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements](#explicitly-set-attr-elements)&#58;

          1.  If <var>attrElement</var> is not a <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;descendant&#45;2"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) of any of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;shadow&#45;including&#45;ancestor&#45;2"></a>[shadow&#45;including ancestors](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-ancestor)&#44; then <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

          2.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>attrElement</var> to <var>elements</var>&#46;

  4.  Otherwise&#58;

      1.  Let <var>contentAttributeValue</var> be the result of running <var>reflectedTarget</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;get&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;11"></a>[get the content attribute](#get-the-content-attribute)&#46;

      2.  If <var>contentAttributeValue</var> is null&#44; then return null&#46;

      3.  Let <var>tokens</var> be <var>contentAttributeValue</var>&#44; <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;spaces"></a>[split on ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace)&#46;

      4.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;2"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>id</var> of <var>tokens</var>&#58;

          1.  Let <var>candidate</var> be the first element&#44; in <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; that meets the following criteria&#58;

              - <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;root&#45;3"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root) is the same as <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;root&#45;4"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root)&#59;

              - <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) is <var>id</var>&#59; and

              - <var>candidate</var> <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;implements&#45;2"></a>[implements](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#implements) <var>T</var>&#46;

              If no such element exists&#44; then <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;continue&#45;2"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

          2.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>candidate</var> to <var>elements</var>&#46;

  5.  Return <var>elements</var>&#46;

- The getter steps are&#58;

  1.  Let <var>elements</var> be the result of running <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;26"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[get the <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements](#attr-associated-elements)&#46;

  2.  If the contents of <var>elements</var> is equal to the contents of <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;27"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements](#cached-attr-associated-elements)&#44; then return <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;28"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements&#45;object"></a>[cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements object](#cached-attr-associated-elements-object)&#46;

  3.  Let <var>elementsAsFrozenArray</var> be <var>elements</var>&#44; <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converted](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) to a <code>FrozenArray&#60;<var>T</var>&#62;&#63;</code>&#46;

  4.  Set <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;29"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements](#cached-attr-associated-elements) to <var>elements</var>&#46;

  5.  Set <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;30"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements object](#cached-attr-associated-elements-object) to <var>elementsAsFrozenArray</var>&#46;

  6.  Return <var>elementsAsFrozenArray</var>&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  This extra caching layer is necessary to preserve the invariant that <code>element&#46;reflectedElements &#61;&#61;&#61; element&#46;reflectedElements</code>&#46;

- The setter steps are&#58;

  1.  If the given value is null&#58;

      1.  Set <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;31"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements](#explicitly-set-attr-elements) to null&#46;

      2.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;32"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;6"></a>[delete the content attribute](#delete-the-content-attribute)&#46;

      3.  Return&#46;

  2.  Run <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;33"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;11"></a>[set the content attribute](#set-the-content-attribute) with the empty string&#46;

  3.  Let <var>elements</var> be an empty <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;4"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

  4.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;3"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>element</var> in the given value&#58;

      1.  <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;list&#45;append&#45;3"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) a weak reference to <var>element</var> to <var>elements</var>&#46;

  5.  Set <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;34"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements](#explicitly-set-attr-elements) to <var>elements</var>&#46;

- For element <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;16"></a>[reflected targets](#reflected-target) only&#58; the following <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;change&#45;ext&#45;2"></a>[attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext)&#44; given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; <var>oldValue</var>&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; and <var>namespace</var>&#44; are used to synchronize between the content attribute and the IDL attribute&#58;

  1.  If <var>localName</var> is not <var>attr</var> or <var>namespace</var> is not null&#44; then return&#46;

  2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements](#explicitly-set-attr-elements) to null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="reflecting&#45;content&#45;attributes&#45;in&#45;idl&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;32"></a>[Reflected IDL attributes](#reflected-idl-attribute) of this type are strongly encouraged to have their identifier end in &#34;<code>Elements</code>&#34; for consistency&#46;

#### <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes"></a>2&#46;6&#46;2 Using reflect via IDL extended attributes[](#using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes)

<a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect"></a>[Reflection](#reflect) can be used from IDL through <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute"></a>[extended attributes](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute)&#46; <a id="xattr&#45;reflect"></a><strong><code>&#91;Reflect&#93;</code></strong>&#44; <a id="xattr&#45;reflectsetter"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectSetter&#93;</code></strong>&#44; <a id="xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectURL&#93;</code></strong>&#44; <a id="xattr&#45;reflectnonnegative"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectNonNegative&#93;</code></strong>&#44; <a id="xattr&#45;reflectpositive"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectPositive&#93;</code></strong>&#44; and <a id="xattr&#45;reflectpositivewithfallback"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectPositiveWithFallback&#93;</code></strong> all trigger <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;2"></a>[reflection](#reflect)&#46; These must either take no arguments&#44; or take a string&#59; they must not appear on anything other than an interface member attribute&#59; and only one of these can be used at a time&#46;

For one of these primary reflection <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[extended attributes](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute)&#44; its <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name) is the string value it takes&#44; if one is provided&#59; otherwise it is the IDL attribute name <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase"></a>[converted to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase)&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><code>[&#91;Reflect&#93;](#xattr-reflect)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;3"></a>[reflect](#reflect) <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;Reflect&#93;](#xattr-reflect)</code>&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectSetter&#93;](#xattr-reflectsetter)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) on setting must <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;4"></a>[reflect](#reflect) <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectSetter&#93;](#xattr-reflectsetter)</code>&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectURL&#93;](#xattr-reflecturl)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must only appear on attributes with a type of <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;usvstring"></a><code>[USVString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString)</code>&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectURL&#93;](#xattr-reflecturl)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;6"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;5"></a>[reflect](#reflect)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;treated&#45;as&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[as a URL](#treated-as-a-url)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectURL&#93;](#xattr-reflecturl)</code>&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectnonnegative"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectNonNegative&#93;](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;7"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must only appear on attributes with a type of <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;long"></a><code>[long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long)</code>&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectnonnegative&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectNonNegative&#93;](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;8"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;6"></a>[reflect](#reflect)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers"></a>[limited to only non&#45;negative numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectnonnegative&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectNonNegative&#93;](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)</code>&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;5"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositive"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositive&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositive)</code> and <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositivewithfallback"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositiveWithFallback&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;9"></a>[extended attributes](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must only appear on attributes with a type of <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;double"></a><code>[double](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double)</code> or <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;unsigned&#45;long"></a><code>[unsigned long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long)</code>&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositive&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositive&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositive)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;10"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;7"></a>[reflect](#reflect)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero"></a>[limited to only positive numbers](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositive&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositive&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositive)</code>&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;6"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositivewithfallback&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositiveWithFallback&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;11"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;8"></a>[reflect](#reflect)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;numbers&#45;greater&#45;than&#45;zero&#45;with&#45;fallback"></a>[limited to only positive numbers with fallback](#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositivewithfallback&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositiveWithFallback&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)</code>&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflected&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;7"></a>[reflected content attribute name](#reflected-content-attribute-name)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To supplement the above <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;12"></a>[extended attributes](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) we also introduce <a id="xattr&#45;reflectrange"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectRange&#93;</code></strong>&#44; and <a id="xattr&#45;reflectdefault"></a><strong><code>&#91;ReflectDefault&#93;</code></strong>&#46; These augment how <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;9"></a>[reflection](#reflect) works and also must only appear on interface member attributes&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectrange"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectRange&#93;](#xattr-reflectrange)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;13"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must take an integer list limited to two values&#46; It must only be used on attributes with a type of <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;unsigned&#45;long&#45;2"></a><code>[unsigned long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long)</code>&#46; Additionally&#44; it must also only appear alongside <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;Reflect&#93;](#xattr-reflect)</code>&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectrange&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectRange&#93;](#xattr-reflectrange)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;14"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) are <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;clamped&#45;to&#45;the&#45;range"></a>[clamped to the range](#clamped-to-the-range) &#91;<var>clampedMin</var>&#44; <var>clampedMax</var>&#93; where <var>clampedMin</var> is the first&#44; and <var>clampedMax</var> is the second argument to the list provided to <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectrange&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectRange&#93;](#xattr-reflectrange)</code>&#46;

The <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectDefault&#93;](#xattr-reflectdefault)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;15"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) must only be used on attributes with a type of <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;double&#45;2"></a><code>[double](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double)</code>&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;long&#45;2"></a><code>[long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long)</code>&#44; or <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;unsigned&#45;long&#45;3"></a><code>[unsigned long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long)</code>&#46; When used on an attribute of type <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;double&#45;3"></a><code>[double](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double)</code>&#44; it must take a decimal&#59; otherwise it must take an integer&#46; Additionally&#44; it must also only appear alongside <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;4"></a><code>[&#91;Reflect&#93;](#xattr-reflect)</code>&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectnonnegative&#45;4"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectNonNegative&#93;](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)</code>&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositive&#45;4"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositive&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositive)</code>&#44; or <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositivewithfallback&#45;4"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectPositiveWithFallback&#93;](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)</code>&#46;

IDL attributes with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectDefault&#93;](#xattr-reflectdefault)</code> <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;extended&#45;attribute&#45;16"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute) have a <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;default&#45;value"></a>[default value](#default-value) provided by the argument provided to <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;via&#45;idl&#45;extended&#45;attributes&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;ReflectDefault&#93;](#xattr-reflectdefault)</code>&#46;

#### <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications"></a>2&#46;6&#46;3 Using reflect in specifications[](#using-reflect-in-specifications)

<a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflect"></a>[Reflection](#reflect) is primarily about improving web developer ergonomics by giving them typed access to content attributes through <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute"></a>[reflected IDL attributes](#reflected-idl-attribute)&#46; The ultimate source of truth&#44; which the web platform builds upon&#44; is the content attributes themselves&#46; That is&#44; specification authors must not use the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute) getter or setter steps&#44; but instead must use the content attribute presence and value&#46; &#40;Or an abstraction on top&#44; such as the state of an <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](#enumerated-attribute)&#46;&#41;

Two important exceptions to this are <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a>[reflected IDL attributes](#reflected-idl-attribute) whose type is one of the following&#58;

- <code><var>T</var>&#63;</code>&#44; where <var>T</var> is either <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or an interface that inherits from <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>

- <code>FrozenArray&#60;<var>T</var>&#62;&#63;</code>&#44; where <var>T</var> is either <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;element&#45;3"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or an interface that inherits from <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;element&#45;4"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>

For those&#44; specification authors must use the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflected&#45;target"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target)&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[get the <var>attr</var>&#45;associated element](#attr-associated-element) and <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[get the <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements](#attr-associated-elements)&#44; respectively&#46; The content attribute presence and value must not be used as they cannot be fully synchronized with the <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflected&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a>[reflected IDL attribute](#reflected-idl-attribute)&#46;

A <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;reflected&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[reflected target](#reflected-target)&#39;s <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;element"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;element](#explicitly-set-attr-element)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;explicitly&#45;set&#45;attr&#45;elements"></a>[explicitly set <var>attr</var>&#45;elements](#explicitly-set-attr-elements)&#44; <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements](#cached-attr-associated-elements)&#44; and <a id="using&#45;reflect&#45;in&#45;specifications&#58;cached&#45;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements&#45;object"></a>[cached <var>attr</var>&#45;associated elements object](#cached-attr-associated-elements-object) are to be treated as internal implementation details and not to be built upon&#46;

#### <a id="collections"></a>2&#46;6&#46;4 Collections[](#collections)

The <a id="collections&#58;htmlformcontrolscollection"></a><code>[HTMLFormControlsCollection](#htmlformcontrolscollection)</code> and <a id="collections&#58;htmloptionscollection"></a><code>[HTMLOptionsCollection](#htmloptionscollection)</code> interfaces are <a id="collections&#58;concept&#45;collection"></a>[collections](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-collection) derived from the <a id="collections&#58;htmlcollection"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> interface&#46; The <a id="collections&#58;htmlallcollection"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface is a <a id="collections&#58;concept&#45;collection&#45;2"></a>[collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-collection)&#44; but is not so derived&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface"></a>2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;1 The <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface[](#the-htmlallcollection-interface)

The <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface is used for the legacy <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;all"></a><code>[document&#46;all](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#dom-document-all)</code> attribute&#46; It operates similarly to <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code>&#59; the main differences are that it allows a staggering variety of different &#40;ab&#41;uses of its methods to all end up returning something&#44; and that it can be called as a function as an alternative to property access&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

All <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> objects are rooted at a <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> and have a filter that matches all elements&#44; so the elements <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection) of an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> object consist of all the descendant elements of the root <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#46;

Objects that implement the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;5"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface are <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;legacy&#45;platform&#45;object"></a>[legacy platform objects](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-legacy-platform-object) with an additional &#91;&#91;Call&#93;&#93; internal method described in the [section below](#HTMLAllCollection-call)&#46; They also have an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;ishtmldda"></a>[&#91;&#91;IsHTMLDDA&#93;&#93;](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-IsHTMLDDA-internal-slot) internal slot&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Objects that implement the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;6"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface have several unusual behaviors&#44; due of the fact that they have an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;ishtmldda&#45;2"></a>[&#91;&#91;IsHTMLDDA&#93;&#93;](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-IsHTMLDDA-internal-slot) internal slot&#58;

- The <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;js&#45;toboolean"></a>[ToBoolean](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-toboolean) abstract operation in JavaScript returns false when given objects implementing the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;7"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface&#46;

- The <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;js&#45;abstract&#45;equality"></a>[IsLooselyEqual](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-islooselyequal) abstract operation&#44; when given objects implementing the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;8"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface&#44; returns true when compared to the <code>undefined</code> and <code>null</code> values&#46; &#40;Comparisons using the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;js&#45;strict&#45;equality"></a>[IsStrictlyEqual](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isstrictlyequal) abstract operation&#44; and IsLooselyEqual comparisons to other values such as strings or objects&#44; are unaffected&#46;&#41;

- The <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;js&#45;typeof"></a><code>[typeof](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-typeof-operator)</code> operator in JavaScript returns the string <code>&#34;undefined&#34;</code> when applied to objects implementing the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;9"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> interface&#46;

These special behaviors are motivated by a desire for compatibility with two classes of legacy content&#58; one that uses the presence of <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;all&#45;2"></a><code>[document&#46;all](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#dom-document-all)</code> as a way to detect legacy user agents&#44; and one that only supports those legacy user agents and uses the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;all&#45;3"></a><code>[document&#46;all](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#dom-document-all)</code> object without testing for its presence first&#46; [&#91;JAVASCRIPT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsJAVASCRIPT)
