<a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;legacyunenumerablenamedproperties"></a><a id="htmlallcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;length"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;element"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;element&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;nameditem"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;element&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;item"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;ishtmldda&#45;3"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window,
 LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties]
interface HTMLAllCollection {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter Element (unsigned long index);
  getter (HTMLCollection or Element)? namedItem(DOMString name);
  (HTMLCollection or Element)? item(optional DOMString nameOrIndex);

  // Note: HTMLAllCollection objects have a custom [[Call]] internal method and an [[IsHTMLDDA]] internal slot.
};
```

The object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) are as defined for <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> objects&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;names"></a>[supported property names](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names) consist of the non&#45;empty values of all the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attributes of all the elements <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;2"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#44; and the non&#45;empty values of all the <code>name</code> attributes of all the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;all&#45;named&#45;elements"></a>[&#34;all&#34;&#45;named elements](#all-named-elements) <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;3"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#44; in <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; ignoring later duplicates&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> of an element preceding its <code>name</code> if it contributes both&#44; they differ from each other&#44; and neither is the duplicate of an earlier entry&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> getter steps are to return the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;4"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#46;

The indexed property getter must return the result of <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;indexed"></a>[getting the &#34;all&#34;&#45;indexed element](#concept-get-all-indexed) from <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given the passed index&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;nameditem"></a><strong><code>namedItem&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return the result of <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;named"></a>[getting the &#34;all&#34;&#45;named element&#40;s&#41;](#concept-get-all-named) from <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given <var>name</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;item"></a><strong><code>item&#40;<var>nameOrIndex</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>nameOrIndex</var> was not provided&#44; return null&#46;

2.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;indexed&#45;or&#45;named"></a>[getting the &#34;all&#34;&#45;indexed or named element&#40;s&#41;](#concept-get-all-indexed-or-named) from <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; given <var>nameOrIndex</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following elements are <a id="all&#45;named&#45;elements"></a><strong>&#34;all&#34;&#45;named elements</strong>&#58; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-button-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-embed-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;frame"></a><code>[frame](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frame)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;frameset"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-map-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code>

To <a id="concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;indexed"></a><strong>get the &#34;all&#34;&#45;indexed element</strong> from an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;10"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> <var>collection</var> given an index <var>index</var>&#44; return the <var>index</var><sup>th</sup> element in <var>collection</var>&#44; or null if there is no such <var>index</var><sup>th</sup> element&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;named"></a><strong>get the &#34;all&#34;&#45;named element&#40;s&#41;</strong> from an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;11"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> <var>collection</var> given a name <var>name</var>&#44; perform the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>name</var> is the empty string&#44; return null&#46;

2.  Let <var>subCollection</var> be an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection&#45;5"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> object rooted at the same <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> as <var>collection</var>&#44; whose filter matches only elements that are either&#58;

    - <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;all&#45;named&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[&#34;all&#34;&#45;named elements](#all-named-elements) with a <code>name</code> attribute equal to <var>name</var>&#44; or

    - elements with an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) equal to <var>name</var>&#46;

3.  If there is exactly one element in <var>subCollection</var>&#44; then return that element&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>subCollection</var> is empty&#44; return null&#46;

5.  Otherwise&#44; return <var>subCollection</var>&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;indexed&#45;or&#45;named"></a><strong>get the &#34;all&#34;&#45;indexed or named element&#40;s&#41;</strong> from an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlallcollection&#45;12"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> <var>collection</var> given <var>nameOrIndex</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>nameOrIndex</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converted](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) to a JavaScript String value&#44; is an <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;array&#45;index&#45;property&#45;name"></a>[array index property name](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name)&#44; return the result of <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;indexed&#45;2"></a>[getting the &#34;all&#34;&#45;indexed element](#concept-get-all-indexed) from <var>collection</var> given the number represented by <var>nameOrIndex</var>&#46;

2.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;htmlallcollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;named&#45;2"></a>[getting the &#34;all&#34;&#45;named element&#40;s&#41;](#concept-get-all-named) from <var>collection</var> given <var>nameOrIndex</var>&#46;

###### <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call"></a>2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;1&#46;1 &#91;&#91;Call&#93;&#93; &#40; <var>thisArgument</var>&#44; <var>argumentsList</var> &#41;[](#HTMLAllCollection-call)

1.  If <var>argumentsList</var>&#39;s <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call&#58;list&#45;size"></a>[size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size) is zero&#44; or if <var>argumentsList</var>&#91;0&#93; is undefined&#44; return null&#46;

2.  Let <var>nameOrIndex</var> be the result of <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>argumentsList</var>&#91;0&#93; to a <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call&#58;idl&#45;domstring"></a><code>[DOMString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString)</code>&#46;

3.  Let <var>result</var> be the result of <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;all&#45;indexed&#45;or&#45;named"></a>[getting the &#34;all&#34;&#45;indexed or named element&#40;s&#41;](#concept-get-all-indexed-or-named) from this <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call&#58;htmlallcollection"></a><code>[HTMLAllCollection](#htmlallcollection)</code> given <var>nameOrIndex</var>&#46;

4.  Return the result of <a id="HTMLAllCollection&#45;call&#58;concept&#45;idl&#45;convert&#45;2"></a>[converting](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping) <var>result</var> to an ECMAScript value&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <var>thisArgument</var> is ignored&#44; and thus code such as <code>Function&#46;prototype&#46;call&#46;call&#40;document&#46;all&#44; null&#44; &#34;x&#34;&#41;</code> will still search for elements&#46; &#40;<code>document&#46;all&#46;call</code> does not exist&#44; since <code>document&#46;all</code> does not inherit from <code>Function&#46;prototype</code>&#46;&#41;

##### <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface"></a>2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;2 The <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlformcontrolscollection"></a><code>[HTMLFormControlsCollection](#htmlformcontrolscollection)</code> interface[](#the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface)

<a id="htmlformcontrolscollection"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;length"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;item"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;element"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;nameditem"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;nameditem"></a><a id="radionodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;nodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;radionodelist&#45;value"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLFormControlsCollection : HTMLCollection {
  // inherits length and item()
  getter (RadioNodeList or Element)? namedItem(DOMString name); // shadows inherited namedItem()
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface RadioNodeList : NodeList {
  attribute DOMString value;
};
```

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;length&#45;dev"></a>[length](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-length)</code></strong>

Returns the number of elements in <var>collection</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;item&#45;dev"></a>[item](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-item)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#91;<var>index</var>&#93;</code></strong>

Returns the item at index <var>index</var> in <var>collection</var>&#46; The items are sorted in <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;nameditem&#45;dev"></a>[namedItem](#dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem)&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>radioNodeList</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;nameditem&#45;2"></a>[namedItem](#dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem)&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#91;<var>name</var>&#93;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>radioNodeList</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#91;<var>name</var>&#93;</code></strong>

Returns the item with <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) or <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> <var>name</var> from <var>collection</var>&#46;

If there are multiple matching items&#44; then a <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;2"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object containing all those elements is returned&#46;

<strong><code><var>radioNodeList</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;radionodelist&#45;value&#45;dev"></a>[value](#dom-radionodelist-value)</code></strong>

Returns the value of the first checked radio button represented by <var>radioNodeList</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>radioNodeList</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;radionodelist&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#dom-radionodelist-value) &#61; <var>value</var></code></strong>

Checks the first radio button represented by <var>radioNodeList</var> that has value <var>value</var>&#46;

The object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) are as defined for <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> objects&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;names"></a>[supported property names](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names) consist of the non&#45;empty values of all the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> and <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attributes of all the elements <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#44; in <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; ignoring later duplicates&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> of an element preceding its <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> if it contributes both&#44; they differ from each other&#44; and neither is the duplicate of an earlier entry&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;nameditem"></a><strong><code>namedItem&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must act according to the following algorithm&#58;

1.  If <var>name</var> is the empty string&#44; return null and stop the algorithm&#46;
2.  If&#44; at the time the method is called&#44; there is exactly one node in the collection that has either an <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute or a <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute equal to <var>name</var>&#44; then return that node and stop the algorithm&#46;
3.  Otherwise&#44; if there are no nodes in the collection that have either an <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute or a <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;5"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute equal to <var>name</var>&#44; then return null and stop the algorithm&#46;
4.  Otherwise&#44; create a new <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;3"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object representing a <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;live"></a>[live](#live) view of the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLFormControlsCollection](#htmlformcontrolscollection)</code> object&#44; further filtered so that the only nodes in the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;4"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object are those that have either an <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute or a <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;6"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute equal to <var>name</var>&#46; The nodes in the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;5"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object must be sorted in <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;
5.  Return that <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;6"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Members of the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;7"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> interface inherited from the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;nodelist&#45;2"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> interface must behave as they would on a <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;nodelist&#45;3"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> object&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[RadioNodeList&#47;value](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/RadioNodeList/value)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox33&#43;Safari7&#43;Chrome21&#43;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="dom&#45;radionodelist&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> IDL attribute on the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;8"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object&#44; on getting&#44; must return the value returned by running the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>element</var> be the first element in <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;4"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) represented by the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;9"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object that is an <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;"></a>[Radio Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state and whose <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-checked) is true&#46; Otherwise&#44; let it be null&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> is null&#44; return the empty string&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> is an element with no <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; return the string &#34;<code>on</code>&#34;&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; return the value of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#46;

On setting&#44; the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;radionodelist&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](#dom-radionodelist-value)</code> IDL attribute must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the new value is the string &#34;<code>on</code>&#34;&#58; let <var>element</var> be the first element in <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;5"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) represented by the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;10"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object that is an <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Radio Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state and whose <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute is either absent&#44; or present and equal to the new value&#44; if any&#46; If no such element exists&#44; then instead let <var>element</var> be null&#46;

    Otherwise&#58; let <var>element</var> be the first element in <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;6"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) represented by the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radionodelist&#45;11"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](#radionodelist)</code> object that is an <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Radio Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state and whose <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;4"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute is present and equal to the new value&#44; if any&#46; If no such element exists&#44; then instead let <var>element</var> be null&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> is not null&#44; then set its <a id="the&#45;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;2"></a>[checkedness](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-checked) to true&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface"></a>2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;3 The <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionscollection"></a><code>[HTMLOptionsCollection](#htmloptionscollection)</code> interface[](#the-htmloptionscollection-interface)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLOptionsCollection](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLOptionsCollection)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer6&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionscollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLOptionsCollection](#htmloptionscollection)</code> interface is used for <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;collection"></a>[collections](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-collection) of <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements&#46; It is always rooted on a <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element and has attributes and methods that manipulate that element&#39;s descendants&#46;

<a id="htmloptionscollection"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;item"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;nameditem"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;length"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;length"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionelement"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;add"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionelement&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptgroupelement"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;remove"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;selectedindex"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLOptionsCollection : HTMLCollection {
  // inherits item(), namedItem()
  [CEReactions] attribute unsigned long length; // shadows inherited length
  [CEReactions] setter undefined (unsigned long index, HTMLOptionElement? option);
  [CEReactions] undefined add((HTMLOptionElement or HTMLOptGroupElement) element, optional (HTMLElement or long)? before = null);
  [CEReactions] undefined remove(long index);
  [CEReactions] attribute long selectedIndex;
};
```

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;length&#45;dev"></a>[length](#dom-htmloptionscollection-length)</code></strong>

Returns the number of elements in <var>collection</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;length&#45;2"></a>[length](#dom-htmloptionscollection-length) &#61; <var>value</var></code></strong>

When set to a smaller number than the existing length&#44; truncates the number of <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements in the container corresponding to <var>collection</var>&#46;

When set to a greater number than the existing length&#44; if that number is less than or equal to 100000&#44; adds new blank <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements to the container corresponding to <var>collection</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;item&#45;2"></a>[item](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-item)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#91;<var>index</var>&#93;</code></strong>

Returns the item at index <var>index</var> in <var>collection</var>&#46; The items are sorted in <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#91;<var>index</var>&#93; &#61; <var>element</var></code></strong>

When <var>index</var> is a greater number than the number of items in <var>collection</var>&#44; adds new blank <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements in the corresponding container&#46;

When set to null&#44; removes the item at index <var>index</var> from <var>collection</var>&#46;

When set to an <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; adds or replaces it at index <var>index</var> in <var>collection</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;nameditem&#45;dev"></a>[namedItem](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-nameditem)&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>element</var> &#61; <var>collection</var>&#91;<var>name</var>&#93;</code></strong>

Returns the item with <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) or <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-option-name)</code> <var>name</var> from <var>collection</var>&#46;

If there are multiple matching items&#44; then the first is returned&#46;

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;add&#45;dev"></a>[add](#dom-htmloptionscollection-add)&#40;<var>element</var>&#91;&#44; <var>before</var>&#93;&#41;</code></strong>

Inserts <var>element</var> before the node given by <var>before</var>&#46;

The <var>before</var> argument can be a number&#44; in which case <var>element</var> is inserted before the item with that number&#44; or an element from <var>collection</var>&#44; in which case <var>element</var> is inserted before that element&#46;

If <var>before</var> is omitted&#44; null&#44; or a number out of range&#44; then <var>element</var> will be added at the end of the list&#46;

Throws a <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;hierarchyrequesterror"></a>[&#34;<code>HierarchyRequestError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#hierarchyrequesterror) <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>element</var> is an ancestor of the element into which it is to be inserted&#46;

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;remove&#45;dev"></a>[remove](#dom-htmloptionscollection-remove)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Removes the item with index <var>index</var> from <var>collection</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;selectedindex&#45;2"></a>[selectedIndex](#dom-htmloptionscollection-selectedindex)</code></strong>

Returns the index of the first selected item&#44; if any&#44; or −1 if there is no selected item&#46;

<strong><code><var>collection</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;selectedindex&#45;dev"></a>[selectedIndex](#dom-htmloptionscollection-selectedindex) &#61; <var>index</var></code></strong>

Changes the selection to the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element at index <var>index</var> in <var>collection</var>&#46;

The object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) are as defined for <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> objects&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> getter steps are to return the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;length&#45;3"></a><code>[length](#dom-htmloptionscollection-length)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>current</var> be the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;2"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#46;

2.  If the given value is greater than <var>current</var>&#58;

    1.  If the given value is greater than 100&#44;000&#44; then return&#46;

    2.  Let <var>n</var> be <var>value</var> − <var>current</var>&#46;

    3.  <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;append&#45;new&#45;option&#45;elements"></a>[Append new option elements](#append-new-option-elements) to the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is rooted given <var>n</var>&#46;

3.  If the given value is less than <var>current</var>&#58;

    1.  Let <var>n</var> be <var>current</var> − <var>value</var>&#46;

    2.  Remove the last <var>n</var> nodes in the collection from their parent nodes&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Setting <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;length&#45;4"></a><code>[length](#dom-htmloptionscollection-length)</code> never removes or adds any <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> elements&#44; and never adds new children to existing <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> elements &#40;though it can remove children from them&#41;&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;names"></a>[supported property names](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names) consist of the non&#45;empty values of all the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> and <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-option-name)</code> attributes of all the elements <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;3"></a>[represented by the collection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection)&#44; in <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; ignoring later duplicates&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> of an element preceding its <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-option-name)</code> if it contributes both&#44; they differ from each other&#44; and neither is the duplicate of an earlier entry&#46;

To <a id="append&#45;new&#45;option&#45;elements"></a><strong>append new option elements</strong> to a <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var> given a non&#45;negative integer <var>count</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>fragment</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;create&#45;a&#45;document&#45;fragment"></a>[creating a document fragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-document-fragment) given <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  Append <var>count</var> new <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements to <var>fragment</var>&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>fragment</var> to <var>select</var>&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;setter"></a>To <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;a&#45;new&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[set the value of a new indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-indexed-property) or <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;existing&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[set the value of an existing indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-indexed-property) for an <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionscollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLOptionsCollection](#htmloptionscollection)</code> <var>collection</var>&#44; given a property index <var>index</var> and a new value <var>value</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>value</var> is null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionscollection&#45;remove&#45;an&#45;option"></a>[remove an option](#htmloptionscollection-remove-an-option) from <var>collection</var> given <var>index</var> and return&#46;

2.  Let <var>length</var> be the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;4"></a>[represented](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection) by <var>collection</var>&#46;

3.  Let <var>delta</var> be <var>index</var> − <var>length</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>delta</var> is greater than 0&#44; then <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;append&#45;new&#45;option&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[append new option elements](#append-new-option-elements) to the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <var>collection</var> is rooted given <var>delta</var>&#46;

5.  If <var>delta</var> is greater than or equal to 0&#44; then <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>value</var> to the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <var>collection</var> is rooted&#46; Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;replace"></a>[replace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-replace) the <var>index</var>th element in <var>collection</var> by <var>value</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;add"></a><strong><code>add&#40;<var>element</var>&#44; <var>before</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is an ancestor of the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is rooted&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;hierarchyrequesterror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>HierarchyRequestError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#hierarchyrequesterror) <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>before</var> is an element&#44; but that element isn&#39;t a descendant of the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is rooted&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;notfounderror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotFoundError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notfounderror) <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> and <var>before</var> are the same element&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Let <var>reference</var> be null&#46;

5.  If <var>before</var> is a node&#44; then set <var>reference</var> to <var>before</var>&#46; Otherwise&#44; if <var>before</var> is an integer and there is a <var>before</var>th node in <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; then set <var>reference</var> to that node&#46;

6.  Let <var>parent</var> be <var>reference</var>&#39;s parent node if <var>reference</var> is not null&#59; otherwise the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is rooted&#46;

7.  <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;pre&#45;insert"></a>[Pre&#45;insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-pre-insert) <var>element</var> into <var>parent</var> node before <var>reference</var>&#46;

To <a id="htmloptionscollection&#45;remove&#45;an&#45;option"></a><strong>remove an option</strong> from an <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionscollection&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLOptionsCollection](#htmloptionscollection)</code> <var>collection</var> given an integer <var>index</var>&#58;

1.  If the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;5"></a>[represented](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection) by <var>collection</var> is 0&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>index</var> is not a number greater than or equal to 0 and less than the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection&#45;6"></a>[represented](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection) by <var>collection</var>&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Let <var>element</var> be the <var>index</var>th element in <var>collection</var>&#46;

4.  Remove <var>element</var> from its parent node&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;remove"></a><strong><code>remove&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;htmloptionscollection&#45;remove&#45;an&#45;option&#45;2"></a>[remove an option](#htmloptionscollection-remove-an-option) from <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given <var>index</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;selectedindex"></a><strong><code>selectedIndex</code></strong> getter steps are to return the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;select&#45;selected&#45;index"></a>[selected index](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#select-selected-index) of the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is rooted&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;selectedindex&#45;3"></a><code>[selectedIndex](#dom-htmloptionscollection-selectedindex)</code> setter steps are to <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selected&#45;index"></a>[set the selected index](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#set-the-selected-index) of the <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element on which <a id="the&#45;htmloptionscollection&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is rooted to the given value&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface"></a>2&#46;6&#46;5 The <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;domstringlist"></a><code>[DOMStringList](#domstringlist)</code> interface[](#the-domstringlist-interface)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[DOMStringList](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DOMStringList)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari5&#46;1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android3&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;domstringlist&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMStringList](#domstringlist)</code> interface is a non&#45;fashionable retro way of representing a list of strings&#46;

<a id="domstringlist"></a><a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;domstringlist&#45;length"></a><a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;domstringlist&#45;item"></a><a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;domstringlist&#45;contains"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface DOMStringList {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter DOMString? item(unsigned long index);
  boolean contains(DOMString string);
};
```

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

New APIs must use <code>sequence&#60;DOMString&#62;</code> or equivalent rather than <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;domstringlist&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMStringList](#domstringlist)</code>&#46;

<strong><code><var>strings</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;domstringlist&#45;length&#45;dev"></a>[length](#dom-domstringlist-length)</code></strong>

Returns the number of strings in <var>strings</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>strings</var>&#91;<var>index</var>&#93;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>strings</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;domstringlist&#45;item&#45;dev"></a>[item](#dom-domstringlist-item)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns the string with index <var>index</var> from <var>strings</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>strings</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;domstringlist&#45;contains&#45;dev"></a>[contains](#dom-domstringlist-contains)&#40;<var>string</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns true if <var>strings</var> contains <var>string</var>&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;domstringlist&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMStringList](#domstringlist)</code> object has an associated <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;domstringlist&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMStringList](#domstringlist)</code> interface <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;supports&#45;indexed&#45;properties"></a>[supports indexed properties](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-support-indexed-properties)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) are the <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;indices"></a>[indices](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-get-the-indices) of <a id="the&#45;domstringlist&#45;interface&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s associated list&#46;

## <a id="dom"></a>3 Semantics&#44; structure&#44; and APIs of HTML documents[](#dom)

### <a id="documents"></a>3&#46;1 Documents[](#documents)

Every XML and HTML document in an HTML UA is represented by a <a id="documents&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#46; [&#91;DOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOM)

The <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a><strong>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)</strong> is defined in DOM&#46; It is initially set when the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object is created&#44; but can change during the lifetime of the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#59; for example&#44; it changes when the user <a id="documents&#58;navigate"></a>[navigates](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) to a <a id="documents&#58;navigate&#45;fragid"></a>[fragment](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate-fragid) on the page and when the <a id="documents&#58;dom&#45;history&#45;pushstate"></a><code>[pushState&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-history-pushstate)</code> method is called with a new <a id="documents&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46; [&#91;DOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOM)

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Interactive user agents typically expose the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="documents&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) in their user interface&#46; This is the primary mechanism by which a user can tell if a site is attempting to impersonate another&#46;

The <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a><strong>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin)</strong> is defined in DOM&#46; It is initially set when the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object is created&#44; and can change during the lifetime of the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> only upon setting <a id="documents&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;domain"></a><code>[document&#46;domain](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-domain)</code>&#46; A <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="documents&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) can differ from the <a id="documents&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin) of its <a id="documents&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#59; for example when a <a id="documents&#58;child&#45;navigable"></a>[child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#child-navigable) is <a id="documents&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[created](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable)&#44; its <a id="documents&#58;nav&#45;document"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#39;s <a id="documents&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is inherited from its <a id="documents&#58;nav&#45;parent"></a>[parent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-parent)&#39;s <a id="documents&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#39;s <a id="documents&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;3"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin)&#44; even though its <a id="documents&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#39;s <a id="documents&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) is <a id="documents&#58;about&#58;blank"></a><code>[about&#58;blank](#about:blank)</code>&#46; [&#91;DOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOM)

When a <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> is created by a <a id="documents&#58;concept&#45;script"></a>[script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-script) using the <a id="documents&#58;dom&#45;domimplementation&#45;createdocument"></a><code>[createDocument&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domimplementation-createdocument)</code> or <a id="documents&#58;dom&#45;domimplementation&#45;createhtmldocument"></a><code>[createHTMLDocument&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domimplementation-createhtmldocument)</code> methods&#44; the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;11"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> is <a id="documents&#58;ready&#45;for&#45;post&#45;load&#45;tasks"></a>[ready for post&#45;load tasks](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#ready-for-post-load-tasks) immediately&#46;

<a id="the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;referrer"></a><strong>The document&#39;s referrer</strong> is a string &#40;representing a <a id="documents&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#41; that can be set when the <a id="documents&#58;document&#45;12"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> is created&#46; If it is not explicitly set&#44; then its value is the empty string&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object"></a>3&#46;1&#46;1 The <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object[](#the-document-object)

id="htmlorsvgscriptelement"></a><a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;legacyoverridebuiltins"></a><a id="document"></a><a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;2"></a><a
