id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;globaleventhandlers"></a>

``` text
enum DocumentReadyState { "loading", "interactive", "complete" };
enum DocumentVisibilityState { "visible", "hidden" };
typedef (HTMLScriptElement or SVGScriptElement) HTMLOrSVGScriptElement;

[LegacyOverrideBuiltIns]
partial interface Document {
  static Document parseHTMLUnsafe((TrustedHTML or DOMString) html, optional (ParseHTMLUnsafeOptions or TrustedHTMLParserOptions) options = {});
  static Document parseHTML(DOMString html, optional SetHTMLOptions options = {});

  // resource metadata management
  [PutForwards=href, LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute Location? location;
  attribute USVString domain;
  readonly attribute USVString referrer;
  attribute USVString cookie;
  readonly attribute DOMString lastModified;
  readonly attribute DocumentReadyState readyState;

  // DOM tree accessors
  getter object (DOMString name);
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString title;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString dir;
  [CEReactions] attribute HTMLElement? body;
  readonly attribute HTMLHeadElement? head;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection images;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection embeds;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection plugins;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection links;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection forms;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection scripts;
  NodeList getElementsByName(DOMString elementName);
  readonly attribute HTMLOrSVGScriptElement? currentScript; // classic scripts in a document tree only

  // dynamic markup insertion
  [CEReactions] Document open(optional DOMString unused1, optional DOMString unused2); // both arguments are ignored
  WindowProxy? open(USVString url, DOMString name, DOMString features);
  [CEReactions] undefined close();
  [CEReactions] undefined write((TrustedHTML or DOMString)... text);
  [CEReactions] undefined writeln((TrustedHTML or DOMString)... text);

  // user interaction
  readonly attribute WindowProxy? defaultView;
  boolean hasFocus();
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString designMode;
  [CEReactions] boolean execCommand(DOMString commandId, optional boolean showUI = false, optional DOMString value = "");
  boolean queryCommandEnabled(DOMString commandId);
  boolean queryCommandIndeterm(DOMString commandId);
  boolean queryCommandState(DOMString commandId);
  boolean queryCommandSupported(DOMString commandId);
  DOMString queryCommandValue(DOMString commandId);
  readonly attribute boolean hidden;
  readonly attribute DocumentVisibilityState visibilityState;

  // special event handler IDL attributes that only apply to Document objects
  [LegacyLenientThis] attribute EventHandler onreadystatechange;
  attribute EventHandler onvisibilitychange;

  // also has obsolete members
};
Document includes GlobalEventHandlers;
```

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;policy&#45;container"></a><strong>policy container</strong> &#40;a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;policy&#45;container"></a>[policy container](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#policy-container)&#41;&#44; initially a new policy container&#44; which contains policies which apply to the <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#46;

<a id="concept&#45;document&#45;feature&#45;policy"></a>Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;permissions&#45;policy"></a><strong>permissions policy</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;concept&#45;permissions&#45;policy"></a>[permissions policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#permissions-policy)&#44; which is initially empty&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;module&#45;map"></a><strong>module map</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;module&#45;map"></a>[module map](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#module-map)&#44; initially empty&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has an <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;coop"></a><strong>opener policy</strong>&#44; which is an <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;cross&#45;origin&#45;opener&#45;policy"></a>[opener policy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cross-origin-opener-policy)&#44; initially a new opener policy&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;11"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has an <a id="is&#45;initial&#45;about&#58;blank"></a><strong>is initial <code>about&#58;blank</code></strong>&#44; which is a boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;12"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;navigation&#45;id"></a><strong>during&#45;loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;navigation&#45;id"></a>[navigation ID](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-id) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

As the name indicates&#44; this is used for interfacing with the WebDriver BiDi specification&#44; which needs to be informed about certain occurrences during the early parts of the <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;13"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#39;s lifecycle&#44; in a way that ties them to the original <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;navigation&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[navigation ID](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-id) used when the navigation that created this <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;14"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> was the <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;ongoing&#45;navigation"></a>[ongoing navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#ongoing-navigation)&#46; This eventually gets set back to null&#44; after WebDriver BiDi considers the loading process to be finished&#46; [&#91;BIDI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBIDI)

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;15"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has an <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;about&#45;base&#45;url"></a><strong>about base URL</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This is only populated for &#34;<code>about&#58;</code>&#34;&#45;schemed <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;16"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>s&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;17"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;bfcache&#45;blocking&#45;details"></a><strong>bfcache blocking details</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;set"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) of <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;nrr&#45;details&#45;struct"></a>[not restored reason details](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nrr-details-struct)&#44; initially empty&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;document&#45;18"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has an <a id="open&#45;dialogs&#45;list"></a><strong>open dialogs list</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="the&#45;document&#45;object&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element"></a><code>[dialog](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element)</code> elements&#44; initially empty&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;documentorshadowroot&#45;interface"></a>3&#46;1&#46;2 The <a id="the&#45;documentorshadowroot&#45;interface&#58;documentorshadowroot"></a><code>[DocumentOrShadowRoot](#documentorshadowroot)</code> interface[](#the-documentorshadowroot-interface)

DOM defines the <a id="the&#45;documentorshadowroot&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;documentorshadowroot"></a><code>[DocumentOrShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#documentorshadowroot)</code> mixin&#44; which this specification extends&#46;

<a id="documentorshadowroot"></a><a id="the&#45;documentorshadowroot&#45;interface&#58;element"></a><a id="the&#45;documentorshadowroot&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;documentorshadowroot&#45;activeelement"></a>

``` text
partial interface mixin DocumentOrShadowRoot {
  readonly attribute Element? activeElement;
};
```

#### <a id="ancestor&#45;origins"></a>3&#46;1&#46;3 Ancestor origins[](#ancestor-origins)

A <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object has an associated <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list"></a><strong>internal ancestor origin objects list</strong>&#44; initially null&#46;

The <a id="internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;creation&#45;steps"></a><strong>internal ancestor origin objects list creation steps</strong> given a <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object <var>document</var> and a <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;referrer&#45;policy"></a>[referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) <var>referrerPolicy</var> are&#58;

1.  Let <var>output</var> be « »&#46;

2.  Let <var>parentDoc</var> be <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;doc&#45;container&#45;document"></a>[container document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#doc-container-document)&#46;

3.  If <var>parentDoc</var> is null&#44; then return <var>output</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>parentDoc</var> is <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#46;

5.  Let <var>ancestorOrigins</var> be <var>parentDoc</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list](#concept-document-internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list)&#46;

6.  <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>ancestorOrigins</var> is not null&#46;

7.  Let <var>masked</var> be false&#46;

8.  If <var>referrerPolicy</var> is &#34;<code>no&#45;referrer</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>masked</var> to true&#46;

9.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>referrerPolicy</var> is &#34;<code>same&#45;origin</code>&#34; and <var>parentDoc</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is not <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;same&#45;origin"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) with <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin)&#44; then set <var>masked</var> to true&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Since <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;mixed&#45;content"></a>[mixed content](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-mixed-content/#mixed-content) checks prevent <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;non&#45;secure&#45;context"></a>[non&#45;secure context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#non-secure-context) <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;environment"></a>[environments](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#environment) in <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;secure&#45;context"></a>[secure context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#secure-context) <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;environment&#45;2"></a>[environments](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#environment)&#44; there&#39;s no need to check for <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;secure&#45;context&#45;2"></a>[secure contexts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#secure-context) for &#34;<code>strict&#45;origin</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>strict&#45;origin&#45;when&#45;cross&#45;origin</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>no&#45;referrer&#45;when&#45;downgrade</code>&#34;&#46; The &#34;<code>origin</code>&#34; and &#34;<code>origin&#45;when&#45;cross&#45;origin</code>&#34; values also don&#39;t need special treatment since we&#39;re at most exposing an <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;3"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) here&#46;

10. If <var>masked</var> is true&#44; then <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) a new <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque) to <var>output</var>&#46;

11. Otherwise&#44; <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>parentDoc</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;4"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) to <var>output</var>&#46;

12. <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>ancestorOrigin</var> of <var>ancestorOrigins</var>&#58;

    1.  If <var>masked</var> is true and <var>ancestorOrigin</var> is <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;same&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) with <var>parentDoc</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;5"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin)&#44; then <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;append&#45;3"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) a new <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque&#45;2"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque) to <var>output</var> and <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    2.  <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;append&#45;4"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>ancestorOrigin</var> to <var>output</var> and set <var>masked</var> to false&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        Setting <var>masked</var> to false here doesn&#39;t imply that all further ancestors&#39; origins are necessarily exposed&#46; They might have been previously masked when an ancestor document ran these steps&#44; and the resulting list is used as a starting point when a child document is created &#40;see step 5 above&#41;&#46;

13. Return <var>output</var>&#46;

A <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object has an associated <a id="concept&#45;document&#45;ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list"></a><strong>ancestor origins list</strong>&#44; initially null&#46;

The <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list&#45;creation&#45;steps"></a><strong>ancestor origins list creation steps</strong> given a <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object <var>document</var> are&#58;

1.  Let <var>ancestorOrigins</var> be <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list](#concept-document-internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list)&#46;

2.  <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;assert&#45;3"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>ancestorOrigins</var> is not null&#46;

3.  Let <var>output</var> be « »&#46;

4.  <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;2"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>origin</var> of <var>ancestorOrigins</var>&#58;

    1.  <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;list&#45;append&#45;5"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) the <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;ascii&#45;serialisation&#45;of&#45;an&#45;origin"></a>[serialization](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin) of <var>origin</var> to <var>output</var>&#46;

5.  Return a new <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;domstringlist"></a><code>[DOMStringList](#domstringlist)</code> object whose associated list is <var>output</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Consider a <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;top&#45;level&#45;browsing&#45;context"></a>[top&#45;level browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#top-level-browsing-context) document with the URL <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example&#47;top</code>&#58;

``` text
<!doctype html>
<title>top</title>
<iframe referrerpolicy="no-referrer" src="https://a.example/child"></iframe>
```

The child document&#58;

``` text
<!doctype html>
<title>child</title>
<iframe src="https://b.example/grandchild"></iframe>
<script>
 console.log([...location.ancestorOrigins]);
</script>
```

The grandchild document&#58;

``` text
<!doctype html>
<title>grandchild</title>
<script>
 console.log([...location.ancestorOrigins]);
</script>
```

When the child&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object is created&#44; its parent&#39;s origin is masked because the <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-iframe-referrerpolicy)</code> attribute&#39;s value is &#34;<code>no&#45;referrer</code>&#34;&#44; even though the documents are <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;same&#45;origin&#45;3"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin)&#46; The value logged is « &#34;<code>null</code>&#34; »&#46;

When the grandchild&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object is created&#44; the child&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list](#concept-document-internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list) &#40;which contains a single <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque&#45;3"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque)&#41; is used as a starting point&#44; and the child&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;6"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is added to the list&#46; The value logged is thus « &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>null</code>&#34; »&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If we consider the previous example but the <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> element in the top document has no <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;2"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-iframe-referrerpolicy)</code> attribute&#44; and instead the <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> element in the child document has <code>referrerpolicy&#61;&#34;no&#45;referrer&#34;</code>&#46;

In this case&#44; the top document&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;7"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is added to the child&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;4"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list](#concept-document-internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list)&#46; The value logged is « &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example</code>&#34; »&#46;

For the grandchild&#44; the child&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;8"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is masked as an <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque&#45;4"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque)&#46; Since the top document&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;9"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;same&#45;origin&#45;4"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) with the child document&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;10"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin)&#44; it is also masked&#46; The value logged is thus « &#34;<code>null</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>null</code>&#34; »&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; we show that the top&#45;level document&#39;s origin is not masked even though there&#39;s a descendant same&#45;origin document whose origin <em>is</em> masked&#44; since there&#39;s a cross&#45;origin document in between&#46;

- Top&#45;level with URL <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example&#47;top</code>

  ``` text
  <iframe src="https://b.example/child"></iframe>
  ```

  The <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list"></a>[ancestor origins list](#concept-document-ancestor-origins-list) associated list is « »&#46;

- Child with URL <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;b&#46;example&#47;child</code>

  ``` text
  <iframe src="https://a.example/grandchild"></iframe>
  ```

  The <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[ancestor origins list](#concept-document-ancestor-origins-list) associated list is « &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example</code>&#34; »&#46;

- Grandchild with URL <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example&#47;grandchild</code>

  ``` text
  <iframe src="https://c.example/great-grandchild"
          referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></iframe>
  ```

  The <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[ancestor origins list](#concept-document-ancestor-origins-list) associated list is « &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;b&#46;example</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example</code>&#34; »&#46;

- Great&#45;grandchild with URL <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;c&#46;example&#47;great&#45;grandchild</code>

  The <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list&#45;4"></a>[ancestor origins list](#concept-document-ancestor-origins-list) associated list is « &#34;<code>null</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;b&#46;example</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;a&#46;example</code>&#34; »&#46; The top&#45;level origin is not masked&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If we consider the previous example but the top&#45;level document&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> also has <code>referrerpolicy&#61;&#34;no&#45;referrer&#34;</code>&#44; then the resulting <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;ancestor&#45;origins&#45;list&#45;5"></a>[ancestor origins list](#concept-document-ancestor-origins-list) associated list for each document would be&#58;

- Top&#45;level&#58; « »

- Child&#58; « &#34;<code>null</code>&#34; »

- Grandchild&#58; « &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;b&#46;example</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>null</code>&#34; »

- Great&#45;grandchild&#58; « &#34;<code>null</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;b&#46;example</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>null</code>&#34; »&#46; The top&#45;level origin is masked because it was masked when the child document ran the <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;creation&#45;steps"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list creation steps](#internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list-creation-steps)&#44; and that result is passed on to the grandchild document&#39;s <a id="ancestor&#45;origins&#58;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;creation&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list creation steps](#internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list-creation-steps)&#44; and so on&#46;

#### <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management"></a>3&#46;1&#46;4 <strong>Resource metadata management</strong>[](#resource-metadata-management)

<strong><code><var>document</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;document&#45;referrer&#45;dev"></a>[referrer](#dom-document-referrer)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Document&#47;referrer](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/referrer)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera3&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer4&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

Returns the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) of the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> from which the user navigated to this one&#44; unless it was blocked or there was no such document&#44; in which case it returns the empty string&#46;

The <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;link&#45;type&#45;noreferrer"></a><code>[noreferrer](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#link-type-noreferrer)</code> link type can be used to block the referrer&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;referrer"></a><strong><code>referrer</code></strong> attribute must return <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;referrer"></a>[the document&#39;s referrer](#the-document's-referrer)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>document</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;document&#45;cookie&#45;dev"></a>[cookie](#dom-document-cookie) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the HTTP cookies that apply to the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#46; If there are no cookies or cookies can&#39;t be applied to this resource&#44; the empty string will be returned&#46;

Can be set&#44; to add a new cookie to the element&#39;s set of HTTP cookies&#46;

If the contents are <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;sandboxed&#45;origin&#45;browsing&#45;context&#45;flag"></a>[sandboxed into an opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sandboxed-origin-browsing-context-flag) &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; in an <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> with the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox"></a><code>[sandbox](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute&#41;&#44; a <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> will be thrown on getting and setting&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Document&#47;cookie](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/cookie)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera3&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer4&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;cookie"></a><strong><code>cookie</code></strong> attribute represents the cookies of the resource identified by the document&#39;s <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Using the synchronous <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;cookie"></a><code>[document&#46;cookie](#dom-document-cookie)</code> API can be a source of performance issues&#46; The Cookie Store API can be used instead&#44; as it provides an asynchronous way to handle cookies to avoid performance issues&#46; See the [Cookie Store API introduction](https://cookiestore.spec.whatwg.org/#intro) for more information&#46; [&#91;COOKIESTORE&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCOOKIESTORE)

A <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object that falls into one of the following conditions is a <a id="cookie&#45;averse&#45;document&#45;object"></a><strong>cookie&#45;averse <code>Document</code> object</strong>&#58;

- A <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object whose <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc) is null&#46;
- A <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> whose <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#39;s <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;scheme"></a>[scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is not an <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;http&#40;s&#41;&#45;scheme"></a>[HTTP&#40;S&#41; scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme)&#46;

<a id="sandboxCookies"></a> <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;tracking&#45;vector"></a>[![&#40;This is a tracking vector&#46;&#41;](https://resources.whatwg.org/tracking-vector.svg)](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tracking-vector) On getting&#44; if the document is a <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;cookie&#45;averse&#45;document&#45;object"></a>[cookie&#45;averse <code>Document</code> object](#cookie-averse-document-object)&#44; then the user agent must return the empty string&#46; Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is an <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque)&#44; the user agent must throw a <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;securityerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46; Otherwise&#44; the user agent must return the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;cookie&#45;string"></a>[cookie&#45;string](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6265.html#sane-cookie-syntax) for the document&#39;s <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;4"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) for a &#34;non&#45;HTTP&#34; API&#44; decoded using <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;utf&#45;8&#45;decode&#45;without&#45;bom"></a>[UTF&#45;8 decode without BOM](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode-without-bom)&#46; [&#91;COOKIES&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCOOKIES)

On setting&#44; if the document is a <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;cookie&#45;averse&#45;document&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[cookie&#45;averse <code>Document</code> object](#cookie-averse-document-object)&#44; then the user agent must do nothing&#46; Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is an <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque&#45;2"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque)&#44; the user agent must throw a <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;securityerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46; Otherwise&#44; the user agent must act as it would when <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;receives&#45;a&#45;set&#45;cookie&#45;string"></a>[receiving a set&#45;cookie&#45;string](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6265.html#storage-model) for the document&#39;s <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;5"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) via a &#34;non&#45;HTTP&#34; API&#44; consisting of the new value <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;utf&#45;8&#45;encode"></a>[encoded as UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-encode)&#46; [&#91;COOKIES&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCOOKIES) [&#91;ENCODING&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsENCODING)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;cookie&#45;2"></a><code>[cookie](#dom-document-cookie)</code> attribute is accessible across frames&#44; the path restrictions on cookies are only a tool to help manage which cookies are sent to which parts of the site&#44; and are not in any way a security feature&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

The <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;cookie&#45;3"></a><code>[cookie](#dom-document-cookie)</code> attribute&#39;s getter and setter synchronously access shared state&#46; Since there is no locking mechanism&#44; other browsing contexts in a multiprocess user agent can modify cookies while scripts are running&#46; A site could&#44; for instance&#44; try to read a cookie&#44; increment its value&#44; then write it back out&#44; using the new value of the cookie as a unique identifier for the session&#59; if the site does this twice in two different browser windows at the same time&#44; it might end up using the same &#34;unique&#34; identifier for both sessions&#44; with potentially disastrous effects&#46;

<strong><code><var>document</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;document&#45;lastmodified&#45;dev"></a>[lastModified](#dom-document-lastmodified)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Document&#47;lastModified](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/lastModified)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer4&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the date of the last modification to the document&#44; as reported by the server&#44; in the form &#34;<code>MM&#47;DD&#47;YYYY hh&#58;mm&#58;ss</code>&#34;&#44; in the user&#39;s local time zone&#46;

If the last modification date is not known&#44; the current time is returned instead&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;lastmodified"></a><strong><code>lastModified</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the date and time of the <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#39;s source file&#39;s last modification&#44; in the user&#39;s local time zone&#44; in the following format&#58;

1.  The month component of the date&#46;

2.  A U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character &#40;&#47;&#41;&#46;

3.  The day component of the date&#46;

4.  A U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character &#40;&#47;&#41;&#46;

5.  The year component of the date&#46;

6.  A U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#46;

7.  The hours component of the time&#46;

8.  A U&#43;003A COLON character &#40;&#58;&#41;&#46;

9.  The minutes component of the time&#46;

10. A U&#43;003A COLON character &#40;&#58;&#41;&#46;

11. The seconds component of the time&#46;

All the numeric components above&#44; other than the year&#44; must be given as two <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;ascii&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) representing the number in base ten&#44; zero&#45;padded if necessary&#46; The year must be given as the shortest possible string of four or more <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;ascii&#45;digits&#45;2"></a>[ASCII digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit) representing the number in base ten&#44; zero&#45;padded if necessary&#46;

The <a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>&#39;s source file&#39;s last modification date and time must be derived from relevant features of the networking protocols used&#44; e&#46;g&#46; from the value of the HTTP &#96;<a id="resource&#45;metadata&#45;management&#58;http&#45;last&#45;modified"></a><code>[Last&#45;Modified](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7232.html#header.last-modified)</code>&#96; header of the document&#44; or from metadata in the file system for local files&#46; If the last modification date and time are not known&#44; the attribute must return the current date and time in the above format&#46;

#### <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status"></a>3&#46;1&#46;5 Reporting document loading status[](#reporting-document-loading-status)

<strong><code><var>document</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;document&#45;readystate&#45;dev"></a>[readyState](#dom-document-readystate)</code></strong>

Returns &#34;<code>loading</code>&#34; while the <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> is loading&#44; &#34;<code>interactive</code>&#34; once it is finished parsing but still loading subresources&#44; and &#34;<code>complete</code>&#34; once it has loaded&#46;

The <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;event&#45;readystatechange"></a><code>[readystatechange](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-readystatechange)</code> event fires on the <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object when this value changes&#46;

The <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;event&#45;domcontentloaded"></a><code>[DOMContentLoaded](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-domcontentloaded)</code> event fires after the transition to &#34;<code>interactive</code>&#34; but before the transition to &#34;<code>complete</code>&#34;&#44; at the point where all subresources apart from <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async"></a><code>[async](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-async)</code> <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> elements have loaded&#46;

Each <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="current&#45;document&#45;readiness"></a><strong>current document readiness</strong>&#44; a string&#44; initially &#34;<code>complete</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> objects created via the <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;initialise&#45;the&#45;document&#45;object"></a>[create and initialize a <code>Document</code> object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#initialise-the-document-object) algorithm&#44; this will be immediately reset to &#34;<code>loading</code>&#34; before any script can observe the value of <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;readystate"></a><code>[document&#46;readyState](#dom-document-readystate)</code>&#46; This default applies to other cases such as <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;is&#45;initial&#45;about&#58;blank"></a>[initial <code>about&#58;blank</code>](#is-initial-about:blank) <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>s or <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code>s without a <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;readystate"></a><strong><code>readyState</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;current&#45;document&#45;readiness"></a>[current document readiness](#current-document-readiness)&#46;

To <a id="update&#45;the&#45;current&#45;document&#45;readiness"></a><strong>update the current document readiness</strong> for <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var> to <var>readinessValue</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;current&#45;document&#45;readiness&#45;2"></a>[current document readiness](#current-document-readiness) equals <var>readinessValue</var>&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;current&#45;document&#45;readiness&#45;3"></a>[current document readiness](#current-document-readiness) to <var>readinessValue</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>document</var> is associated with an <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>now</var> be the <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    2.  If <var>readinessValue</var> is &#34;<code>complete</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info"></a>[load timing info](#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;dom&#45;complete&#45;time"></a>[DOM complete time](#dom-complete-time) is 0&#44; then set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;2"></a>[load timing info](#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;dom&#45;complete&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[DOM complete time](#dom-complete-time) to <var>now</var>&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>readinessValue</var> is &#34;<code>interactive</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;3"></a>[load timing info](#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;dom&#45;interactive&#45;time"></a>[DOM interactive time](#dom-interactive-time) is 0&#44; then set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;4"></a>[load timing info](#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;dom&#45;interactive&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[DOM interactive time](#dom-interactive-time) to <var>now</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;event&#45;readystatechange&#45;2"></a><code>[readystatechange](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-readystatechange)</code> at <var>document</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> is said to have an <a id="active&#45;parser"></a><strong>active parser</strong> if it is associated with an <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or an <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser) that has not yet been <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[stopped](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stop-parsing) or <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;abort&#45;a&#45;parser"></a>[aborted](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#abort-a-parser)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;load&#45;timing&#45;info"></a>[document load timing info](#document-load-timing-info) <a id="load&#45;timing&#45;info"></a><strong>load timing info</strong>&#46;

A <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;unload&#45;timing&#45;info"></a>[document unload timing info](#document-unload-timing-info) <a id="previous&#45;document&#45;unload&#45;timing"></a><strong>previous document unload timing</strong>&#46;

A <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;document&#45;11"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a boolean <a id="was&#45;created&#45;via&#45;cross&#45;origin&#45;redirects"></a><strong>was created via cross&#45;origin redirects</strong>&#44; initially false&#46;

The <a id="document&#45;load&#45;timing&#45;info"></a><strong>document load timing info</strong> <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;struct"></a>[struct](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct) has the following <a id="reporting&#45;document&#45;loading&#45;status&#58;struct&#45;item"></a>[items](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item)&#58;

#### <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism"></a>3&#46;1&#46;6 <strong>Render&#45;blocking mechanism</strong>[](#render-blocking-mechanism)

Each <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> has a <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;element&#45;set"></a><strong>render&#45;blocking element set</strong>&#44; a <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;set"></a>[set](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set) of elements&#44; initially the empty set&#46;

A <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var> <a id="allows&#45;adding&#45;render&#45;blocking&#45;elements"></a><strong>allows adding render&#45;blocking elements</strong> if <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;content&#45;type"></a>[content type](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-content-type) is &#34;<a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;text&#47;html"></a><code>[text&#47;html](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text/html)</code>&#34; and <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2) of <var>document</var> is null&#46;

A <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var> is <a id="render&#45;blocked"></a><strong>render&#45;blocked</strong> if both of the following are true&#58;

- <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;render&#45;blocking&#45;element&#45;set"></a>[render&#45;blocking element set](#render-blocking-element-set) is non&#45;empty&#44; or <var>document</var> <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;allows&#45;adding&#45;render&#45;blocking&#45;elements"></a>[allows adding render&#45;blocking elements](#allows-adding-render-blocking-elements)&#46;

- The <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) has not exceeded an <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) timeout value&#46;

An element <var>el</var> is <a id="render&#45;blocking"></a><strong>render&#45;blocking</strong> if <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) <var>document</var> is <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;render&#45;blocked"></a>[render&#45;blocked](#render-blocked)&#44; and <var>el</var> is in <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;render&#45;blocking&#45;element&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[render&#45;blocking element set](#render-blocking-element-set)&#46;

To <a id="block&#45;rendering"></a><strong>block rendering</strong> on an element <var>el</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  If <var>document</var> <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;allows&#45;adding&#45;render&#45;blocking&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[allows adding render&#45;blocking elements](#allows-adding-render-blocking-elements)&#44; then <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;set&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append) <var>el</var> to <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;render&#45;blocking&#45;element&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[render&#45;blocking element set](#render-blocking-element-set)&#46;

To <a id="unblock&#45;rendering"></a><strong>unblock rendering</strong> on an element <var>el</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;list&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove) <var>el</var> from <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;render&#45;blocking&#45;element&#45;set&#45;4"></a>[render&#45;blocking element set](#render-blocking-element-set)&#46;

Whenever a <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;render&#45;blocking"></a>[render&#45;blocking](#render-blocking) element <var>el</var> <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;becomes&#45;browsing&#45;context&#45;disconnected"></a>[becomes browsing&#45;context disconnected](#becomes-browsing-context-disconnected)&#44; or <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;blocking&#45;attribute"></a>[blocking attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#blocking-attribute)&#39;s value is changed so that <var>el</var> is no longer <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;potentially&#45;render&#45;blocking"></a>[potentially render&#45;blocking](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#potentially-render-blocking)&#44; then <a id="render&#45;blocking&#45;mechanism&#58;unblock&#45;rendering"></a>[unblock rendering](#unblock-rendering) on <var>el</var>&#46;

Returns the document&#39;s title&#44; as given by <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[the <code>title</code> element](#the-title-element-2) for HTML and as given by the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;title"></a>[SVG <code>title</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title) element for SVG&#46;

Can be set&#44; to update the document&#39;s title&#46; If there is no appropriate element to update&#44; the new value is ignored&#46;

The <a id="document&#46;title"></a><strong><code>title</code></strong> attribute must&#44; on getting&#44; run the following algorithm&#58;

1.  If the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) is an <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;svg"></a>[SVG <code>svg</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-svg) element&#44; then let <var>value</var> be the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) of the first <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;title&#45;2"></a>[SVG <code>title</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title) element that is a child of the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; let <var>value</var> be the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) of <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[the <code>title</code> element](#the-title-element-2)&#44; or the empty string if <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[the <code>title</code> element](#the-title-element-2) is null&#46;

3.  <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;strip&#45;and&#45;collapse&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[Strip and collapse ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-and-collapse-ascii-whitespace) in <var>value</var>&#46;

4.  Return <var>value</var>&#46;

On setting&#44; the steps corresponding to the first matching condition in the following list must be run&#58;

<strong>If the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) is an <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;svg&#45;2"></a>[SVG <code>svg</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-svg) element</strong>

1.  If there is an <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;title&#45;3"></a>[SVG <code>title</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title) element that is a child of the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#44; let <var>element</var> be the first such element&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#58;

    1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#39;s <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; &#34;<code>title</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;namespace"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)&#46;

    2.  Insert <var>element</var> as the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;first&#45;child"></a>[first child](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-first-child) of the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#46;

3.  <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all"></a>[String replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with the given value within <var>element</var>&#46;

<strong>If the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) is in the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)</strong>

1.  If <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[the <code>title</code> element](#the-title-element-2) is null and <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[the <code>head</code> element](#the-head-element-2) is null&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element&#45;2&#45;5"></a>[the <code>title</code> element](#the-title-element-2) is non&#45;null&#44; let <var>element</var> be <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element&#45;2&#45;6"></a>[the <code>title</code> element](#the-title-element-2)&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#58;

    1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#39;s <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; &#34;<code>title</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

    2.  <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>element</var> to <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[the <code>head</code> element](#the-head-element-2)&#46;

4.  <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all&#45;2"></a>[String replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with the given value within <var>element</var>&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

Do nothing&#46;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

Returns <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2)&#46;

Can be set&#44; to replace <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2)&#46;

If the new value is not a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> or <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;frameset"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code> element&#44; this will throw a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;hierarchyrequesterror"></a>[&#34;<code>HierarchyRequestError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#hierarchyrequesterror) <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

<a id="the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><strong>The body element</strong> of a document is the first of <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[the <code>html</code> element](#the-html-element-2)&#39;s children that is either a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element or a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;frameset&#45;2"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code> element&#44; or null if there is no such element&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;body"></a><strong><code>body</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2) of the document &#40;either a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;frameset&#45;3"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code> element&#44; or null&#41;&#46; On setting&#44; the following algorithm must be run&#58;

1.  If the new value is not a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> or <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;frameset&#45;4"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code> element&#44; then throw a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;hierarchyrequesterror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>HierarchyRequestError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#hierarchyrequesterror) <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;
2.  Otherwise&#44; if the new value is the same as <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2)&#44; return&#46;
3.  Otherwise&#44; if <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;5"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2) is not null&#44; then <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;replace"></a>[replace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-replace) <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;6"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2) with the new value within <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;7"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2)&#39;s parent and return&#46;
4.  Otherwise&#44; if there is no <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#44; throw a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;hierarchyrequesterror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>HierarchyRequestError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#hierarchyrequesterror) <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;
5.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2&#45;8"></a>[the body element](#the-body-element-2) is null&#44; but there&#39;s a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#46; <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) the new value to the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The value returned by the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;body"></a><code>[body](#dom-document-body)</code> getter is not always the one passed to the setter&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; the setter successfully inserts a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element &#40;though this is non&#45;conforming since SVG does not allow a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> as child of <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;svg&#45;svg&#45;3"></a>[SVG <code>svg</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-svg)&#41;&#46; However the getter will return null because the document element is not <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#46;

``` text
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
 <script>
  document.body = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml", "body");
  console.assert(document.body === null);
 </script>
</svg>
```

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;links"></a><strong><code>links</code></strong> attribute must return an <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;htmlcollection&#45;8"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> node&#44; whose filter matches only <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> elements with <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;2"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attributes and <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[area](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-area-element)</code> elements with <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;3"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attributes&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;forms"></a><strong><code>forms</code></strong> attribute must return an <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;htmlcollection&#45;9"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> node&#44; whose filter matches only <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;scripts"></a><strong><code>scripts</code></strong> attribute must return an <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;htmlcollection&#45;10"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> node&#44; whose filter matches only <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> elements&#46;

Returns a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;nodelist"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> of elements in the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;11"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> that have a <code>name</code> attribute with the value <var>name</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;document&#45;getelementsbyname"></a><strong><code>getElementsByName&#40;<var>elementName</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to return a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;live"></a>[live](#live) <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;nodelist&#45;2"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> containing all the <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) in that document that have a <code>name</code> attribute whose value is <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;identical&#45;to"></a>[identical to](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) the <var>elementName</var> argument&#44; in <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46; When the method is invoked on a <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;document&#45;12"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> object again with the same argument&#44; the user agent may return the same as the object returned by the earlier call&#46; In other cases&#44; a new <a id="dom&#45;tree&#45;accessors&#58;nodelist&#45;3"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> object must be returned&#46;
