id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlconstructor&#45;2"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLElement : Element {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  // metadata attributes
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString title;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString lang;
  [CEReactions] attribute boolean translate;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString dir;

  // user interaction
  [CEReactions] attribute (boolean or unrestricted double or DOMString)? hidden;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean inert;
  undefined click();
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString accessKey;
  readonly attribute DOMString accessKeyLabel;
  [CEReactions] attribute boolean draggable;
  [CEReactions] attribute boolean spellcheck;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString writingSuggestions;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString autocapitalize;
  [CEReactions] attribute boolean autocorrect;

  [CEReactions] attribute [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString innerText;
  [CEReactions] attribute [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString outerText;

  ElementInternals attachInternals();

  // The popover API
  undefined showPopover(optional ShowPopoverOptions options = {});
  undefined hidePopover();
  boolean togglePopover(optional (TogglePopoverOptions or boolean) options = {});
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString? popover;

  [CEReactions, Reflect, ReflectRange=(0, 8)] attribute unsigned long headingOffset;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean headingReset;
};

dictionary ShowPopoverOptions {
  HTMLElement source;
};

dictionary TogglePopoverOptions : ShowPopoverOptions {
  boolean force;
};

HTMLElement includes GlobalEventHandlers;
HTMLElement includes ElementContentEditable;
HTMLElement includes HTMLOrSVGOrMathMLElement;

[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLUnknownElement : HTMLElement {
  // Note: intentionally no [HTMLConstructor]
};
```

The <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlelement&#45;7"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code> interface holds methods and attributes related to a number of disparate features&#44; and the members of this interface are therefore described in various different sections of this specification&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;element&#45;interface"></a>[element interface](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-interface) for an element with name <var>name</var> in the <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) is determined as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>name</var> is <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;applet"></a><code>[applet](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#applet)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;bgsound"></a><code>[bgsound](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#bgsound)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;blink"></a><code>[blink](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#blink)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;isindex"></a><code>[isindex](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#isindex)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;keygen"></a><code>[keygen](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#keygen)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;multicol"></a><code>[multicol](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#multicol)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;nextid"></a><code>[nextid](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#nextid)</code>&#44; or <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;spacer"></a><code>[spacer](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#spacer)</code>&#44; then return <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlunknownelement"></a><code>[HTMLUnknownElement](#htmlunknownelement)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>name</var> is <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;acronym"></a><code>[acronym](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#acronym)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;basefont"></a><code>[basefont](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#basefont)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;big"></a><code>[big](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#big)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;center"></a><code>[center](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#center)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;nobr"></a><code>[nobr](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#nobr)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;noembed"></a><code>[noembed](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#noembed)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;noframes"></a><code>[noframes](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#noframes)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;plaintext"></a><code>[plaintext](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#plaintext)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;rb"></a><code>[rb](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rb)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;rtc"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;strike"></a><code>[strike](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#strike)</code>&#44; or <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;tt"></a><code>[tt](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#tt)</code>&#44; then return <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlelement&#45;8"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code>&#46;

3.  If <var>name</var> is <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;listing"></a><code>[listing](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#listing)</code> or <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;xmp"></a><code>[xmp](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#xmp)</code>&#44; then return <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlpreelement"></a><code>[HTMLPreElement](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#htmlpreelement)</code>&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; if this specification defines an interface appropriate for the <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;element&#45;type"></a>[element type](#element-type) corresponding to the local name <var>name</var>&#44; then return that interface&#46;

5.  If <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;other&#45;applicable&#45;specifications"></a>[other applicable specifications](#other-applicable-specifications) define an appropriate interface for <var>name</var>&#44; then return the interface they define&#46;

6.  If <var>name</var> is a <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;valid&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;name"></a>[valid custom element name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#valid-custom-element-name)&#44; then return <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlelement&#45;9"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code>&#46;

7.  Return <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlunknownelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLUnknownElement](#htmlunknownelement)</code>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The use of <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlelement&#45;10"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code> instead of <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlunknownelement&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLUnknownElement](#htmlunknownelement)</code> in the case of <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;valid&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[valid custom element names](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#valid-custom-element-name) is done to ensure that any potential future <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;upgrades"></a>[upgrades](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#upgrades) only cause a linear transition of the element&#39;s prototype chain&#44; from <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlelement&#45;11"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code> to a subclass&#44; instead of a lateral one&#44; from <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlunknownelement&#45;4"></a><code>[HTMLUnknownElement](#htmlunknownelement)</code> to an unrelated subclass&#46;

Features shared between HTML&#44; SVG and MathML elements use the <a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;htmlorsvgelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLOrSVGOrMathMLElement](#htmlorsvgelement)</code> interface mixin&#58; [&#91;SVG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSVG) [&#91;MATHML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMATHML)

<strong>⚠</strong>MDN

[Global&#95;attributes&#47;autofocus](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/autofocus)

Support in one engine only&#46;

Firefox🔰 1&#43;Safari🔰 4&#43;Chrome79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera66&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;NoInternet Explorer🔰 10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android79&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android57&#43;

<a id="htmlorsvgelement"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;domstringmap"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;dom&#45;dataset"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;dom&#45;noncedelement&#45;nonce"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;cereactions&#45;18"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;7"></a><a id="dom&#45;fe&#45;autofocus"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;cereactions&#45;19"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;3"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;dom&#45;tabindex"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;dom&#45;focus"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;focusoptions"></a><a id="elements&#45;in&#45;the&#45;dom&#58;dom&#45;blur"></a>

``` text
interface mixin HTMLOrSVGOrMathMLElement {
  [SameObject] readonly attribute DOMStringMap dataset;
  attribute DOMString nonce; // intentionally no [CEReactions]

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean autofocus;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute long tabIndex;
  undefined focus(optional FocusOptions options = {});
  undefined blur();
};
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

An example of an element that is neither an HTML nor SVG nor MathML element is one created as follows&#58;

``` text
const el = document.createElementNS("some namespace", "example");
console.assert(el.constructor === Element);
```

#### <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors"></a>3&#46;2&#46;3 HTML element constructors[](#html-element-constructors)

To support the [custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-elements) feature&#44; all HTML elements have special constructor behavior&#46; This is indicated via the <a id="htmlconstructor"></a><strong><code>&#91;HTMLConstructor&#93;</code></strong> IDL <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;extended&#45;attribute"></a>[extended attribute](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute)&#46; It indicates that the interface object for the given interface will have a specific behavior when called&#44; as defined in detail below&#46;

The <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><code>[&#91;HTMLConstructor&#93;](#htmlconstructor)</code> extended attribute must take no arguments&#44; and must only appear on <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;constructor&#45;operation"></a>[constructor operations](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-constructors)&#46; It must appear only once on a constructor operation&#44; and the interface must contain only the single&#44; annotated constructor operation&#44; and no others&#46; The annotated constructor operation must be declared to take no arguments&#46;

Interfaces declared with constructor operations that are annotated with the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlconstructor&#45;2"></a><code>[&#91;HTMLConstructor&#93;](#htmlconstructor)</code> extended attribute have the following <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;overridden&#45;constructor&#45;steps"></a>[overridden constructor steps](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#overridden-constructor-steps)&#58;

1.  If <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects) is equal to the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object)&#44; then throw a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;typeerror"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    This can occur when a custom element is defined using an <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;element&#45;interface"></a>[element interface](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-interface) as its constructor&#58;

    ``` text
    customElements.define("bad-1", HTMLButtonElement);
    new HTMLButtonElement();          // (1)
    document.createElement("bad-1");  // (2)
    ```

    In this case&#44; during the execution of <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlbuttonelement"></a><code>[HTMLButtonElement](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#htmlbuttonelement)</code> &#40;either explicitly&#44; as in &#40;1&#41;&#44; or implicitly&#44; as in &#40;2&#41;&#41;&#44; both the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object) and <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;2"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects) are <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlbuttonelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLButtonElement](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#htmlbuttonelement)</code>&#46; If this check was not present&#44; it would be possible to create an instance of <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlbuttonelement&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLButtonElement](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#htmlbuttonelement)</code> whose local name was <code>bad&#45;1</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>registry</var> be null&#46;

3.  If the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;surrounding&#45;agent"></a>[surrounding agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent)&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map"></a>[active custom element constructor map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#active-custom-element-constructor-map)&#91;<a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;3"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects)&#93; <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;map&#45;exists"></a>[exists](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#44; then set <var>registry</var> to the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;surrounding&#45;agent&#45;2"></a>[surrounding agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent)&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[active custom element constructor map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#active-custom-element-constructor-map)&#91;<a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;4"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects)&#93;&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>registry</var> to the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;current&#45;global&#45;object"></a>[current global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#current-global-object)&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry)&#46;

5.  Let <var>definition</var> be the item in <var>registry</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set"></a>[custom element definition set](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-definition-set) with <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor"></a>[constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor) equal to <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;5"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects)&#46; If there is no such item&#44; then throw a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;typeerror&#45;2"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Since there can be no item in <var>registry</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[custom element definition set](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-definition-set) with a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;constructor&#45;2"></a>[constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-constructor) of undefined&#44; this step also prevents HTML element constructors from being called as functions &#40;since in that case <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;6"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects) will be undefined&#41;&#46;

6.  Let <var>isValue</var> be null&#46;

7.  If <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-local-name) is equal to <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name"></a>[name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-name) &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; <var>definition</var> is for an <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;autonomous&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[autonomous custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#autonomous-custom-element)&#41;&#58;

    1.  If the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object) is not <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlelement"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code>&#44; then throw a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;typeerror&#45;3"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

        <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

        This can occur when a custom element is defined to not extend any local names&#44; but inherits from a non&#45;<a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code> class&#58;

        ``` text
        customElements.define("bad-2", class Bad2 extends HTMLParagraphElement {});
        ```

        In this case&#44; during the &#40;implicit&#41; <code>super&#40;&#41;</code> call that occurs when constructing an instance of <code>Bad2</code>&#44; the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;4"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object) is <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlparagraphelement"></a><code>[HTMLParagraphElement](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#htmlparagraphelement)</code>&#44; not <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlelement&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement)</code>&#46;

8.  Otherwise &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; if <var>definition</var> is for a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;customized&#45;built&#45;in&#45;element"></a>[customized built&#45;in element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#customized-built-in-element)&#41;&#58;

    1.  Let <var>valid local names</var> be the list of local names for elements defined in this specification or in <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;other&#45;applicable&#45;specifications"></a>[other applicable specifications](#other-applicable-specifications) that use the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;5"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object) as their <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;element&#45;interface&#45;2"></a>[element interface](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-interface)&#46;

    2.  If <var>valid local names</var> does not contain <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;local&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[local name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-local-name)&#44; then throw a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;typeerror&#45;4"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

        <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

        This can occur when a custom element is defined to extend a given local name but inherits from the wrong class&#58;

        ``` text
        customElements.define("bad-3", class Bad3 extends HTMLQuoteElement {}, { extends: "p" });
        ```

        In this case&#44; during the &#40;implicit&#41; <code>super&#40;&#41;</code> call that occurs when constructing an instance of <code>Bad3</code>&#44; <var>valid local names</var> is the list containing <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;the&#45;q&#45;element"></a><code>[q](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-q-element)</code> and <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;the&#45;blockquote&#45;element"></a><code>[blockquote](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-blockquote-element)</code>&#44; but <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;local&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[local name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-local-name) is <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#44; which is not in that list&#46;

    3.  Set <var>isValue</var> to <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-name)&#46;

9.  If <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;construction&#45;stack"></a>[construction stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-construction-stack) is empty&#58;

    1.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;internally&#45;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;object&#45;implementing&#45;the&#45;interface"></a>[internally creating a new object implementing the interface](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface) to which the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;6"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object) corresponds&#44; given the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;current&#45;realm"></a>[current realm](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm) and <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;7"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) to the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;current&#45;global&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[current global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#current-global-object)&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window&#45;2"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#46;

    3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;namespace"></a>[namespace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-namespace) to the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

    4.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;namespace&#45;prefix"></a>[namespace prefix](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-namespace-prefix) to null&#46;

    5.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name) to <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;local&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[local name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-local-name)&#46;

    6.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry) to <var>registry</var>&#46;

    7.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;state"></a>[custom element state](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-state) to &#34;<code>custom</code>&#34;&#46;

    8.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[custom element definition](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-custom-element-definition) to <var>definition</var>&#46;

    9.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) to <var>isValue</var>&#46;

    10. Return <var>element</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This occurs when author script constructs a new custom element directly&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; via <code>new MyCustomElement&#40;&#41;</code>&#46;

10. Let <var>prototype</var> be &#63; <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;js&#45;get"></a>[Get](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-get-o-p)&#40;<a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;8"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects)&#44; &#34;prototype&#34;&#41;&#46;

11. If <var>prototype</var> <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;js&#45;object"></a>[is not an Object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object-type)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>realm</var> be &#63; <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;getfunctionrealm"></a>[GetFunctionRealm](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-getfunctionrealm)&#40;<a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;9"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects)&#41;&#46;

    2.  Set <var>prototype</var> to the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;interface&#45;prototype&#45;object"></a>[interface prototype object](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-interface-prototype-object) of <var>realm</var> whose interface is the same as the interface of the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;7"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The realm of the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;active&#45;function&#45;object&#45;8"></a>[active function object](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#active-function-object) might not be <var>realm</var>&#44; so we are using the more general concept of &#34;the same interface&#34; across realms&#59; we are not looking for equality of <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;interface&#45;object"></a>[interface objects](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-interface-object)&#46; This fallback behavior&#44; including using the realm of <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;newtarget&#45;10"></a>[NewTarget](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects) and looking up the appropriate prototype there&#44; is designed to match analogous behavior for the JavaScript built&#45;ins and Web IDL&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;internally&#45;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;object&#45;implementing&#45;the&#45;interface&#45;2"></a>[internally create a new object implementing the interface](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#internally-create-a-new-object-implementing-the-interface) algorithm&#46;

12. Let <var>element</var> be the last entry in <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;construction&#45;stack&#45;2"></a>[construction stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-construction-stack)&#46;

13. If <var>element</var> is an <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;already&#45;constructed&#45;marker"></a>[<em>already constructed</em> marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-already-constructed-marker)&#44; then throw a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;typeerror&#45;5"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    This can occur when the author code inside the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor"></a>[custom element constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor) [non&#45;conformantly](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-conformance) creates another instance of the class being constructed&#44; before calling <code>super&#40;&#41;</code>&#58;

    ``` text
    let doSillyThing = true;

    class DontDoThis extends HTMLElement {
      constructor() {
        if (doSillyThing) {
          doSillyThing = false;
          new DontDoThis();
          // Now the construction stack will contain an already constructed marker.
        }

        // This will then fail with a TypeError:
        super();
      }
    }
    ```

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    This can also occur when author code inside the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;2"></a>[custom element constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor) [non&#45;conformantly](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-conformance) calls <code>super&#40;&#41;</code> twice&#44; since per the JavaScript specification&#44; this actually executes the superclass constructor &#40;i&#46;e&#46; this algorithm&#41; twice&#44; before throwing an error&#58;

    ``` text
    class DontDoThisEither extends HTMLElement {
      constructor() {
        super();

        // This will throw, but not until it has already called into the HTMLElement constructor
        super();
      }
    }
    ```

14. Perform &#63; <var>element</var>&#46;&#91;&#91;SetPrototypeOf&#93;&#93;&#40;<var>prototype</var>&#41;&#46;

15. Replace the last entry in <var>definition</var>&#39;s <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition&#45;construction&#45;stack&#45;3"></a>[construction stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-custom-element-definition-construction-stack) with an <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;concept&#45;already&#45;constructed&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[<em>already constructed</em> marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#concept-already-constructed-marker)&#46;

16. Return <var>element</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This step is normally reached when <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;upgrades"></a>[upgrading](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#upgrades) a custom element&#59; the existing element is returned&#44; so that the <code>super&#40;&#41;</code> call inside the <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;3"></a>[custom element constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor) assigns that existing element to <strong>this</strong>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

In addition to the constructor behavior implied by <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;htmlconstructor&#45;3"></a><code>[&#91;HTMLConstructor&#93;](#htmlconstructor)</code>&#44; some elements also have <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;named&#45;constructor"></a>[named constructors](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-named-constructor) &#40;which are really factory functions with a modified <code>prototype</code> property&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Named constructors for HTML elements can also be used in an <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;dom&#45;elementdefinitionoptions&#45;extends"></a><code>[extends](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementdefinitionoptions-extends)</code> clause when defining a <a id="html&#45;element&#45;constructors&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;4"></a>[custom element constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor)&#58;

``` text
class AutoEmbiggenedImage extends Image {
  constructor(width, height) {
    super(width * 10, height * 10);
  }
}

customElements.define("auto-embiggened", AutoEmbiggenedImage, { extends: "img" });

const image = new AutoEmbiggenedImage(15, 20);
console.assert(image.width === 150);
console.assert(image.height === 200);
```

#### <a id="element&#45;definitions"></a>3&#46;2&#46;4 Element definitions[](#element-definitions)

Each element in this specification has a definition that includes the following information&#58;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a><strong>Categories</strong></strong>

A list of <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;content&#45;categories"></a>[categories](#content-categories) to which the element belongs&#46; These are used when defining the <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;content&#45;models"></a>[content models](#content-models) for each element&#46;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a><strong>Contexts in which this element can be used</strong></strong>

A <em>non&#45;normative</em> description of where the element can be used&#46; This information is redundant with the content models of elements that allow this one as a child&#44; and is provided only as a convenience&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For simplicity&#44; only the most specific expectations are listed&#46;

For example&#44; all <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) is <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](#flow-content-2)&#46; Thus&#44; elements that are <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) will only be listed as &#34;where <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) is expected&#34;&#44; since this is the more&#45;specific expectation&#46; Anywhere that expects <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[flow content](#flow-content-2) also expects <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)&#44; and thus also meets this expectation&#46;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a><strong>Content model</strong></strong>

A normative description of what content must be included as children and descendants of the element&#46;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a><strong>Tag omission in text&#47;html</strong></strong>

A <em>non&#45;normative</em> description of whether&#44; in the <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;text&#47;html"></a><code>[text&#47;html](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text/html)</code> syntax&#44; the <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a>[start](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-start-tag) and <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) tags can be omitted&#46; This information is redundant with the normative requirements given in the <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[optional tags](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-tag-omission) section&#44; and is provided in the element definitions only as a convenience&#46;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a><strong>Content attributes</strong></strong>

A normative list of attributes that may be specified on the element &#40;except where otherwise disallowed&#41;&#44; along with non&#45;normative descriptions of those attributes&#46; &#40;The content to the left of the dash is normative&#44; the content to the right of the dash is not&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a><strong>Accessibility considerations</strong></strong>

For authors&#58; Conformance requirements for use of ARIA <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;role"></a><code>[role](#attr-aria-role)</code> and <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;&#42;"></a><code>[aria&#45;&#42;](#attr-aria-*)</code> attributes are defined in ARIA in HTML&#46; [&#91;ARIA&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsARIA) [&#91;ARIAHTML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsARIAHTML)

For implementers&#58; User agent requirements for implementing accessibility API semantics are defined in HTML Accessibility API Mappings&#46; [&#91;HTMLAAM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsHTMLAAM)

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a><strong>Sanitization</strong></strong>

The <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](#concept-element-sanitization) information for each element defines its <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;sanitization&#45;category"></a>[sanitization category](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitization-category)&#44; which affects how the element is processed during sanitization&#46; It can also define one or more of the element&#39;s attributes as <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;navigating&#45;url&#45;attributes"></a>[navigating URL attributes](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigating-url-attributes)&#46;

<strong><a id="concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a><strong>DOM interface</strong></strong>

A normative definition of a DOM interface that such elements must implement&#46;

This is then followed by a description of what the element <a id="element&#45;definitions&#58;represents"></a>[represents](#represents)&#44; along with any additional normative conformance criteria that may apply to authors and implementations&#46; Examples are sometimes also included&#46;

##### <a id="attributes"></a>3&#46;2&#46;4&#46;1 Attributes[](#attributes)

<a id="attribute&#45;text"></a>An attribute value is a string&#46; Except where otherwise specified&#44; attribute values on <a id="attributes&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) may be any string value&#44; including the empty string&#44; and there is no restriction on what text can be specified in such attribute values&#46;

#### <a id="content&#45;models"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5 <strong>Content models</strong>[](#content-models)

Each element defined in this specification has a content model&#58; a description of the element&#39;s expected <a id="content&#45;models&#58;concept&#45;html&#45;contents"></a>[contents](#concept-html-contents)&#46; An <a id="content&#45;models&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements) must have contents that match the requirements described in the element&#39;s content model&#46; The <a id="concept&#45;html&#45;contents"></a><strong>contents</strong> of an element are its children in the DOM&#46;

<a id="content&#45;models&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) is always allowed between elements&#46; User agents represent these characters between elements in the source markup as <a id="content&#45;models&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes in the DOM&#46; Empty <a id="content&#45;models&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes and <a id="content&#45;models&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes consisting of just sequences of those characters are considered <a id="inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a><strong>inter&#45;element whitespace</strong>&#46;

<a id="content&#45;models&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[Inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace)&#44; comment nodes&#44; and processing instruction nodes must be ignored when establishing whether an element&#39;s contents match the element&#39;s content model or not&#44; and must be ignored when following algorithms that define document and element semantics&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; an element <var>A</var> is said to be <em>preceded or followed</em> by a second element <var>B</var> if <var>A</var> and <var>B</var> have the same parent node and there are no other element nodes or <a id="content&#45;models&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes &#40;other than <a id="content&#45;models&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace)&#41; between them&#46; Similarly&#44; a node is the <em>only child</em> of an element if that element contains no other nodes other than <a id="content&#45;models&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace&#45;3"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace)&#44; comment nodes&#44; and processing instruction nodes&#46;

Authors must not use <a id="content&#45;models&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) anywhere except where they are explicitly allowed&#44; as defined for each element&#44; or as explicitly required by other specifications&#46; For XML compound documents&#44; these contexts could be inside elements from other namespaces&#44; if those elements are defined as providing the relevant contexts&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The Atom Syndication Format defines a <code>content</code> element&#46; When its <code>type</code> attribute has the value <code>xhtml</code>&#44; The Atom Syndication Format requires that it contain a single HTML <a id="content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element&#46; Thus&#44; a <a id="content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element is allowed in that context&#44; even though this is not explicitly normatively stated by this specification&#46; [&#91;ATOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsATOM)

In addition&#44; <a id="content&#45;models&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) may be orphan nodes &#40;i&#46;e&#46; without a parent node&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; creating a <a id="content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element and storing it in a global variable in a script is conforming&#44; even though <a id="content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> elements are otherwise only supposed to be used inside <a id="content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> elements&#46;

``` text
var data = {
  name: "Banana",
  cell: document.createElement('td'),
};
```

##### <a id="the&#45;nothing&#45;content&#45;model"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;1 The &#34;nothing&#34; content model[](#the-nothing-content-model)

When an element&#39;s content model is <a id="concept&#45;content&#45;nothing"></a><strong>nothing</strong>&#44; the element must contain no <a id="the&#45;nothing&#45;content&#45;model&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes &#40;other than <a id="the&#45;nothing&#45;content&#45;model&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace)&#41; and no element nodes&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Most HTML elements whose content model is &#34;nothing&#34; are also&#44; for convenience&#44; <a id="the&#45;nothing&#45;content&#45;model&#58;void&#45;elements"></a>[void elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#void-elements) &#40;elements that have no <a id="the&#45;nothing&#45;content&#45;model&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) in the [HTML syntax](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax)&#41;&#46; However&#44; these are entirely separate concepts&#46;

##### <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2 Kinds of content[](#kinds-of-content)

Each element in HTML falls into zero or more <a id="content&#45;categories"></a><strong>categories</strong> that group elements with similar characteristics together&#46; The following broad categories are used in this specification&#58;

- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;metadata&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Metadata content](#metadata-content-2)
- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](#flow-content-2)
- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;sectioning&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Sectioning content](#sectioning-content-2)
- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;heading&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Heading content](#heading-content-2)
- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)
- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category"></a>[Embedded content](#embedded-content-category)
- <a id="kinds&#45;of&#45;content&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Interactive content](#interactive-content-2)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Some elements also fall into other categories&#44; which are defined in other parts of this specification&#46;

These categories are related as follows&#58;



Sectioning content&#44; heading content&#44; phrasing content&#44; embedded content&#44; and interactive content are all types of flow content&#46; Metadata is sometimes flow content&#46; Metadata and interactive content are sometimes phrasing content&#46; Embedded content is also a type of phrasing content&#44; and sometimes is interactive content&#46;

Other categories are also used for specific purposes&#44; e&#46;g&#46; form controls are specified using a number of categories to define common requirements&#46; Some elements have unique requirements and do not fit into any particular category&#46;

###### <a id="metadata&#45;content"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2&#46;1 Metadata content[](#metadata-content)

<a id="metadata&#45;content&#45;2"></a><strong>Metadata content</strong> is content that sets up the presentation or behavior of the rest of the content&#44; or that sets up the relationship of the document with other documents&#44; or that conveys other &#34;out of band&#34; information&#46;

- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;base&#45;element"></a><code>[base](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-base-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>
- <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element"></a><code>[title](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-title-element)</code>

Elements from other namespaces whose semantics are primarily metadata&#45;related &#40;e&#46;g&#46; RDF&#41; are also <a id="metadata&#45;content&#58;metadata&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[metadata content](#metadata-content-2)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; in the XML serialization&#44; one can use RDF&#44; like this&#58;

``` text
<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
      xmlns:r="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#" xml:lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>Hedral's Home Page</title>
  <r:RDF>
   <Person xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/10/swap/pim/contact#"
           r:about="https://hedral.example.com/#">
    <fullName>Cat Hedral</fullName>
    <mailbox r:resource="mailto:hedral@damowmow.com"/>
    <personalTitle>Sir</personalTitle>
   </Person>
  </r:RDF>
 </head>
 <body>
  <h1>My home page</h1>
  <p>I like playing with string, I guess. Sister says squirrels are fun
  too so sometimes I follow her to play with them.</p>
 </body>
</html>
```

This isn&#39;t possible in the HTML serialization&#44; however&#46;

###### <a id="flow&#45;content"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2&#46;2 Flow content[](#flow-content)

Most elements that are used in the body of documents and applications are categorized as <a id="flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a><strong>flow content</strong>&#46;

- <a id="flow&#45;content&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>
- <a id="flow&#45;content&#58;the&#45;abbr&#45;element"></a><code>[abbr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-abbr-element)</code>

- <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;autonomous&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[autonomous custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#autonomous-custom-element)
- <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;text&#45;content"></a>[text](#text-content)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Most elements that are categorized as phrasing content can only contain elements that are themselves categorized as phrasing content&#44; not any flow content&#46;

<a id="text&#45;content"></a><strong>Text</strong>&#44; in the context of content models&#44; means either nothing&#44; or <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes&#46; <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Text](#text-content) is sometimes used as a content model on its own&#44; but is also <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)&#44; and can be <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace) &#40;if the <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes are empty or contain just <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#41;&#46;

<a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes and attribute values must consist of <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;scalar&#45;value"></a>[scalar values](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value)&#44; excluding <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;noncharacter"></a>[noncharacters](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#noncharacter)&#44; and <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;control"></a>[controls](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#control) other than <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46; This specification includes extra constraints on the exact value of <a id="phrasing&#45;content&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes and attribute values depending on their precise context&#46;

###### <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2&#46;6 Embedded content[](#embedded-content-2)

<a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;category"></a><strong>Embedded content</strong> is content that imports another resource into the document&#44; or content from another vocabulary that is inserted into the document&#46;

- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-audio-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-embed-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;mathml&#45;math"></a>[MathML <code>math</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-top-level-math-element)
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element"></a><code>[picture](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-picture-element)</code>
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;svg&#45;svg"></a>[SVG <code>svg</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-svg)
- <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-video-element)</code>

Elements that are from namespaces other than the <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) and that convey content but not metadata&#44; are <a id="embedded&#45;content&#45;2&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category"></a>[embedded content](#embedded-content-category) for the purposes of the content models defined in this specification&#46; &#40;For example&#44; MathML or SVG&#46;&#41;

Some embedded content elements can have <a id="fallback&#45;content"></a><strong>fallback content</strong>&#58; content that is to be used when the external resource cannot be used &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because it is of an unsupported format&#41;&#46; The element definitions state what the fallback is&#44; if any&#46;

###### <a id="interactive&#45;content"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2&#46;7 Interactive content[](#interactive-content)

<a id="interactive&#45;content&#45;2"></a><strong>Interactive content</strong> is content that is specifically intended for user interaction&#46;

- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> &#40;if the <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute is present&#41;
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-audio-element)</code> &#40;if the <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls"></a><code>[controls](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-media-controls)</code> attribute is present&#41;
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-button-element)</code>
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element"></a><code>[details](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-details-element)</code>
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-embed-element)</code>
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code>
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> &#40;if the <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;usemap"></a><code>[usemap](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-hyperlink-usemap)</code> or <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;controls"></a><code>[controls](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-img-controls)</code> attribute is present&#41;
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> &#40;if the <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is <em>not</em> in the <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state&#41;
- <a id="interactive&#45;content&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-label-element)</code>

###### <a id="palpable&#45;content"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2&#46;8 Palpable content[](#palpable-content)

As a general rule&#44; elements whose content model allows any <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](#flow-content-2) or <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) should have at least one node in its <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;concept&#45;html&#45;contents"></a>[contents](#concept-html-contents) that is <a id="palpable&#45;content&#45;2"></a><strong>palpable content</strong> and that does not have the <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute specified&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;palpable&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Palpable content](#palpable-content-2) makes an element non&#45;empty by providing either some descendant non&#45;empty <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;text&#45;content"></a>[text](#text-content)&#44; or else something users can hear &#40;<a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-audio-element)</code> elements&#41; or view &#40;<a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-video-element)</code>&#44; <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="palpable&#45;content&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code> elements&#41; or otherwise interact with &#40;for example&#44; interactive form controls&#41;&#46;

This requirement is not a hard requirement&#44; however&#44; as there are many cases where an element can be empty legitimately&#44; for example when it is used as a placeholder which will later be filled in by a script&#44; or when the element is part of a template and would on most pages be filled in but on some pages is not relevant&#46;

Conformance checkers are encouraged to provide a mechanism for authors to find elements that fail to fulfill this requirement&#44; as an authoring aid&#46;

The following elements are palpable content&#58;
