###### <a id="script&#45;supporting&#45;elements"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2&#46;9 Script&#45;supporting elements[](#script-supporting-elements)

<a id="script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a><strong>Script&#45;supporting elements</strong> are those that do not <a id="script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#58;represents"></a>[represent](#represents) anything themselves &#40;i&#46;e&#46; they are not rendered&#41;&#44; but are used to support scripts&#44; e&#46;g&#46; to provide functionality for the user&#46;

The following elements are script&#45;supporting elements&#58;

- <a id="script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>
- <a id="script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>

##### <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;3 Transparent content models[](#transparent-content-models)

Some elements are described as <a id="transparent"></a><strong>transparent</strong>&#59; they have &#34;transparent&#34; in the description of their content model&#46; The content model of a <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;transparent"></a>[transparent](#transparent) element is derived from the content model of its parent element&#58; the elements required in the part of the content model that is &#34;transparent&#34; are the same elements as required in the part of the content model of the parent of the transparent element in which the transparent element finds itself&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; an <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code> element inside a <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;ruby&#45;element"></a><code>[ruby](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ruby-element)</code> element cannot contain an <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#44; because the part of the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;ruby&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ruby](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ruby-element)</code> element&#39;s content model that allows <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code> elements is the part that allows <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)&#44; and the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element is not <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In some cases&#44; where transparent elements are nested in each other&#44; the process has to be applied iteratively&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Consider the following markup fragment&#58;

``` text
<p><object><ins><map><a href="/">Apples</a></map></ins></object></p>
```

To check whether &#34;Apples&#34; is allowed inside the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element&#44; the content models are examined&#46; The <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element&#39;s content model is transparent&#44; as is the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-map-element)</code> element&#39;s&#44; as is the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code> element&#39;s&#44; as is the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code> element&#39;s&#46; The <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code> element is found in the <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; whose content model is <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)&#46; Thus&#44; &#34;Apples&#34; is allowed&#44; as text is phrasing content&#46;

When a transparent element has no parent&#44; then the part of its content model that is &#34;transparent&#34; must instead be treated as accepting any <a id="transparent&#45;content&#45;models&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](#flow-content-2)&#46;

##### <a id="paragraphs"></a>3&#46;2&#46;5&#46;4 Paragraphs[](#paragraphs)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The term <a id="paragraphs&#58;paragraph"></a>[paragraph](#paragraph) as defined in this section is used for more than just the definition of the <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#46; The <a id="paragraphs&#58;paragraph&#45;2"></a>[paragraph](#paragraph) concept defined here is used to describe how to interpret documents&#46; The <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element is merely one of several ways of marking up a <a id="paragraphs&#58;paragraph&#45;3"></a>[paragraph](#paragraph)&#46;

A <a id="paragraph"></a><strong>paragraph</strong> is typically a run of <a id="paragraphs&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) that forms a block of text with one or more sentences that discuss a particular topic&#44; as in typography&#44; but can also be used for more general thematic grouping&#46; For instance&#44; an address is also a paragraph&#44; as is a part of a form&#44; a byline&#44; or a stanza in a poem&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; there are two paragraphs in a section&#46; There is also a heading&#44; which contains phrasing content that is not a paragraph&#46; Note how the comments and <a id="paragraphs&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace) do not form paragraphs&#46;

``` text
<section>
  <h2>Example of paragraphs</h2>
  This is the <em>first</em> paragraph in this example.
  <p>This is the second.</p>
  <!-- This is not a paragraph. -->
</section>
```

Paragraphs in <a id="paragraphs&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](#flow-content-2) are defined relative to what the document looks like without the <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-map-element)</code> elements complicating matters&#44; since those elements&#44; with their hybrid content models&#44; can straddle paragraph boundaries&#44; as shown in the first two examples below&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Generally&#44; having elements straddle paragraph boundaries is best avoided&#46; Maintaining such markup can be difficult&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example takes the markup from the earlier example and puts <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code> and <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code> elements around some of the markup to show that the text was changed &#40;though in this case&#44; the changes admittedly don&#39;t make much sense&#41;&#46; Notice how this example has exactly the same paragraphs as the previous one&#44; despite the <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code> and <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code> elements — the <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code> element straddles the heading and the first paragraph&#44; and the <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code> element straddles the boundary between the two paragraphs&#46;

``` text
<section>
  <ins><h2>Example of paragraphs</h2>
  This is the <em>first</em> paragraph in</ins> this example<del>.
  <p>This is the second.</p></del>
  <!-- This is not a paragraph. -->
</section>
```

Let <var>view</var> be a view of the DOM that replaces all <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[map](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-map-element)</code> elements in the document with their <a id="paragraphs&#58;concept&#45;html&#45;contents"></a>[contents](#concept-html-contents)&#46; Then&#44; in <var>view</var>&#44; for each run of sibling <a id="paragraphs&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) nodes uninterrupted by other types of content&#44; in an element that accepts content other than <a id="paragraphs&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2) as well as <a id="paragraphs&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[phrasing content](#phrasing-content-2)&#44; let <var>first</var> be the first node of the run&#44; and let <var>last</var> be the last node of the run&#46; For each such run that consists of at least one node that is neither <a id="paragraphs&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category"></a>[embedded content](#embedded-content-category) nor <a id="paragraphs&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](#inter-element-whitespace)&#44; a paragraph exists in the original DOM from immediately before <var>first</var> to immediately after <var>last</var>&#46; &#40;Paragraphs can thus span across <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[map](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-map-element)</code> elements&#46;&#41;

Conformance checkers may warn authors of cases where they have paragraphs that overlap each other &#40;this can happen with <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-video-element)</code>&#44; <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-audio-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code> elements&#44; and indirectly through elements in other namespaces that allow HTML to be further embedded therein&#44; like <a id="paragraphs&#58;svg&#45;svg"></a>[SVG <code>svg</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-svg) or <a id="paragraphs&#58;mathml&#45;math"></a>[MathML <code>math</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-top-level-math-element)&#41;&#46;

A <a id="paragraphs&#58;paragraph&#45;4"></a>[paragraph](#paragraph) is also formed explicitly by <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element can be used to wrap individual paragraphs when there would otherwise not be any content other than phrasing content to separate the paragraphs from each other&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the link spans half of the first paragraph&#44; all of the heading separating the two paragraphs&#44; and half of the second paragraph&#46; It straddles the paragraphs and the heading&#46;

``` text
<header>
 Welcome!
 <a href="about.html">
  This is home of...
  <h1>The Falcons!</h1>
  The Lockheed Martin multirole jet fighter aircraft!
 </a>
 This page discusses the F-16 Fighting Falcon's innermost secrets.
</header>
```

Here is another way of marking this up&#44; this time showing the paragraphs explicitly&#44; and splitting the one link element into three&#58;

``` text
<header>
 <p>Welcome! <a href="about.html">This is home of...</a></p>
 <h1><a href="about.html">The Falcons!</a></h1>
 <p><a href="about.html">The Lockheed Martin multirole jet
 fighter aircraft!</a> This page discusses the F-16 Fighting
 Falcon's innermost secrets.</p>
</header>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

It is possible for paragraphs to overlap when using certain elements that define fallback content&#46; For example&#44; in the following section&#58;

``` text
<section>
 <h2>My Cats</h2>
 You can play with my cat simulator.
 <object data="cats.sim">
  To see the cat simulator, use one of the following links:
  <ul>
   <li><a href="cats.sim">Download simulator file</a>
   <li><a href="https://sims.example.com/watch?v=LYds5xY4INU">Use online simulator</a>
  </ul>
  Alternatively, upgrade to the Mellblom Browser.
 </object>
 I'm quite proud of it.
</section>
```

There are five paragraphs&#58;

1.  The paragraph that says &#34;You can play with my cat simulator&#46; <em>object</em> I&#39;m quite proud of it&#46;&#34;&#44; where <em>object</em> is the <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code> element&#46;
2.  The paragraph that says &#34;To see the cat simulator&#44; use one of the following links&#58;&#34;&#46;
3.  The paragraph that says &#34;Download simulator file&#34;&#46;
4.  The paragraph that says &#34;Use online simulator&#34;&#46;
5.  The paragraph that says &#34;Alternatively&#44; upgrade to the Mellblom Browser&#46;&#34;&#46;

The first paragraph is overlapped by the other four&#46; A user agent that supports the &#34;cats&#46;sim&#34; resource will only show the first one&#44; but a user agent that shows the fallback will confusingly show the first sentence of the first paragraph as if it was in the same paragraph as the second one&#44; and will show the last paragraph as if it was at the start of the second sentence of the first paragraph&#46;

To avoid this confusion&#44; explicit <a id="paragraphs&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> elements can be used&#46; For example&#58;

``` text
<section>
 <h2>My Cats</h2>
 <p>You can play with my cat simulator.</p>
 <object data="cats.sim">
  <p>To see the cat simulator, use one of the following links:</p>
  <ul>
   <li><a href="cats.sim">Download simulator file</a>
   <li><a href="https://sims.example.com/watch?v=LYds5xY4INU">Use online simulator</a>
  </ul>
  <p>Alternatively, upgrade to the Mellblom Browser.</p>
 </object>
 <p>I'm quite proud of it.</p>
</section>
```

#### <a id="global&#45;attributes"></a>3&#46;2&#46;6 <strong>Global attributes</strong>[](#global-attributes)

MDN

[Global&#95;attributes](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes)

The following attributes are common to and may be specified on all <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) &#40;even those not defined in this specification&#41;&#58;

- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;accesskey&#45;attribute"></a><code>[accesskey](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#the-accesskey-attribute)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;autocapitalize"></a><code>[autocapitalize](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-autocapitalize)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;autocorrect"></a><code>[autocorrect](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-autocorrect)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autofocus"></a><code>[autofocus](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-fe-autofocus)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;contenteditable"></a><code>[contenteditable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-contenteditable)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;dir"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;draggable"></a><code>[draggable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-draggable)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;enterkeyhint"></a><code>[enterkeyhint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-enterkeyhint)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;headingoffset"></a><code>[headingoffset](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-headingoffset)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;headingreset"></a><code>[headingreset](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-headingreset)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;inert&#45;attribute"></a><code>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#the-inert-attribute)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;inputmode"></a><code>[inputmode](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-inputmode)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;is"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;itemid"></a><code>[itemid](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-itemid)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;names&#58;&#45;the&#45;itemprop&#45;attribute"></a><code>[itemprop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;itemref"></a><code>[itemref](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-itemref)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;itemscope"></a><code>[itemscope](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-itemscope)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;itemtype"></a><code>[itemtype](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-itemtype)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;lang"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;nonce"></a><code>[nonce](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-nonce)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;popover"></a><code>[popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;spellcheck"></a><code>[spellcheck](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-spellcheck)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;style"></a><code>[style](#attr-style)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;tabindex"></a><code>[tabindex](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-tabindex)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;translate"></a><code>[translate](#attr-translate)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;writingsuggestions"></a><code>[writingsuggestions](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-writingsuggestions)</code>

These attributes are only defined by this specification as attributes for <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#46; When this specification refers to elements having these attributes&#44; elements from namespaces that are not defined as having these attributes must not be considered as being elements with these attributes&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; in the following XML fragment&#44; the &#34;<code>bogus</code>&#34; element does not have a <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;2"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code> attribute as defined in this specification&#44; despite having an attribute with the literal name &#34;<code>dir</code>&#34;&#46; Thus&#44; <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[the directionality](#the-directionality) of the inner&#45;most <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;span&#45;element"></a><code>[span](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-span-element)</code> element is &#39;<a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;rtl"></a>[rtl](#concept-rtl)&#39;&#44; inherited from the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element indirectly through the &#34;<code>bogus</code>&#34; element&#46;

``` text
<div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" dir="rtl">
 <bogus xmlns="https://example.net/ns" dir="ltr">
  <span xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  </span>
 </bogus>
</div>
```

[Global&#95;attributes&#47;slot](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/slot)

DOM defines the user agent requirements for the <a id="classes"></a><strong><code>class</code></strong>&#44; <a id="the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><strong><code>id</code></strong>&#44; and <a id="attr&#45;slot"></a><strong><code>slot</code></strong> attributes for any element in any namespace&#46; [&#91;DOM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDOM)

The <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;classes"></a><code>[class](#classes)</code>&#44; <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code>&#44; and <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot"></a><code>[slot](#attr-slot)</code> attributes may be specified on all <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#46;

When specified on <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#44; the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;classes&#45;2"></a><code>[class](#classes)</code> attribute must have a value that is a <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](#set-of-space-separated-tokens) representing the various classes that the element belongs to&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Assigning classes to an element affects class matching in selectors in CSS&#44; the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;getelementsbyclassname"></a><code>[getElementsByClassName&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-getelementsbyclassname)</code> method in the DOM&#44; and other such features&#46;

There are no additional restrictions on the tokens authors can use in the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;classes&#45;3"></a><code>[class](#classes)</code> attribute&#44; but authors are encouraged to use values that describe the nature of the content&#44; rather than values that describe the desired presentation of the content&#46;

When specified on <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#44; the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute value must be unique amongst all the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[IDs](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) in the element&#39;s <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) and must contain at least one character&#46; The value must not contain any <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute specifies its element&#39;s <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[unique identifier &#40;ID&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id)&#46;

There are no other restrictions on what form an ID can take&#59; in particular&#44; IDs can consist of just digits&#44; start with a digit&#44; start with an underscore&#44; consist of just punctuation&#44; etc&#46;

An element&#39;s <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;id&#45;3"></a>[unique identifier](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) can be used for a variety of purposes&#44; most notably as a way to link to specific parts of a document using <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment"></a>[fragments](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment)&#44; as a way to target an element when scripting&#44; and as a way to style a specific element from CSS&#46;

Identifiers are opaque strings&#46; Particular meanings should not be derived from the value of the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a><code>[id](#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute&#46;

There are no conformance requirements for the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;2"></a><code>[slot](#attr-slot)</code> attribute specific to <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;3"></a><code>[slot](#attr-slot)</code> attribute is used to <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;assign&#45;a&#45;slot"></a>[assign a slot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#assign-a-slot) to an element&#58; an element with a <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;4"></a><code>[slot](#attr-slot)</code> attribute is <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;assign&#45;a&#45;slot&#45;2"></a>[assigned](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#assign-a-slot) to the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;slot"></a>[slot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-slot) created by the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element"></a><code>[slot](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-slot-element)</code> element whose <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;name"></a>[name](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-slot-name) attribute&#39;s value matches that <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;5"></a><code>[slot](#attr-slot)</code> attribute&#39;s value — but only if that <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[slot](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-slot-element)</code> element finds itself in the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree) whose <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;root"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root)&#39;s <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;documentfragment&#45;host"></a>[host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host) has the corresponding <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;slot&#45;6"></a><code>[slot](#attr-slot)</code> attribute value&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To enable assistive technology products to expose a more fine&#45;grained interface than is otherwise possible with HTML elements and attributes&#44; a set of [annotations for assistive technology products](#wai-aria) can be specified &#40;the ARIA <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;role"></a><code>[role](#attr-aria-role)</code> and <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;&#42;"></a><code>[aria&#45;&#42;](#attr-aria-*)</code> attributes&#41;&#46; [&#91;ARIA&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsARIA)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;handler&#45;ontoggle"></a><code>[ontoggle](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#handler-ontoggle)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;handler&#45;onvolumechange"></a><code>[onvolumechange](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#handler-onvolumechange)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;handler&#45;onwaiting"></a><code>[onwaiting](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#handler-onwaiting)</code>
- <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;handler&#45;onwheel"></a><code>[onwheel](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#handler-onwheel)</code>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The attributes marked with an asterisk have a different meaning when specified on <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> elements as those elements expose <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;event&#45;handlers"></a>[event handlers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handlers) of the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> object with the same names&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

While these attributes apply to all elements&#44; they are not useful on all elements&#46; For example&#44; only <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#media-element) will ever receive a <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;event&#45;media&#45;volumechange"></a><code>[volumechange](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#event-media-volumechange)</code> event fired by the user agent&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;custom&#45;data&#45;attribute"></a>[Custom data attributes](#custom-data-attribute) &#40;e&#46;g&#46; <code>data&#45;foldername</code> or <code>data&#45;msgid</code>&#41; can be specified on any <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements)&#44; to store custom data&#44; state&#44; annotations&#44; and similar&#44; specific to the page&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

In <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;documents"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#44; elements in the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) may have an <code>xmlns</code> attribute specified&#44; if&#44; and only if&#44; it has the exact value &#34;<code>http&#58;&#47;&#47;www&#46;w3&#46;org&#47;1999&#47;xhtml</code>&#34;&#46; This does not apply to <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;xml&#45;documents"></a>[XML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In HTML&#44; the <code>xmlns</code> attribute has absolutely no effect&#46; It is basically a talisman&#46; It is allowed merely to make migration to and from XML mildly easier&#46; When parsed by an <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser)&#44; the attribute ends up in no namespace&#46; In XML&#44; the attribute is part of the namespace declaration mechanism and always ends up in the &#34;<code>http&#58;&#47;&#47;www&#46;w3&#46;org&#47;2000&#47;xmlns&#47;</code>&#34; namespace&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

XML also allows the use of the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;space"></a><code>[xml&#58;space](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-white-space)</code> attribute in the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;xml&#45;namespace"></a>[XML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-namespace) on any element in an <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;xml&#45;documents&#45;2"></a>[XML document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document)&#46; This attribute has no effect on <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#44; as the default behavior in HTML is to preserve whitespace&#46; [&#91;XML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXML)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There is no way to serialize the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;space&#45;2"></a><code>[xml&#58;space](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-white-space)</code> attribute on <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) in the <a id="global&#45;attributes&#58;text&#47;html"></a><code>[text&#47;html](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text/html)</code> syntax&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute"></a>3&#46;2&#46;6&#46;1 The <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute[](#the-title-attribute)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Global&#95;attributes&#47;title](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/title)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;title"></a><strong><code>title</code></strong> attribute <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;represents"></a>[represents](#represents) advisory information for the element&#44; such as would be appropriate for a tooltip&#46; On a link&#44; this could be the title or a description of the target resource&#59; on an image&#44; it could be the image credit or a description of the image&#59; on a paragraph&#44; it could be a footnote or commentary on the text&#59; on a citation&#44; it could be further information about the source&#59; on <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[interactive content](#interactive-content-2)&#44; it could be a label for&#44; or instructions for&#44; use of the element&#59; and so forth&#46; The value is text&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Relying on the <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;2"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute is currently discouraged as many user agents do not expose the attribute in an accessible manner as required by this specification &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; requiring a pointing device such as a mouse to cause a tooltip to appear&#44; which excludes keyboard&#45;only users and touch&#45;only users&#44; such as anyone with a modern phone or tablet&#41;&#46;

If this attribute is omitted from an element&#44; then it implies that the <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;3"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute of the nearest ancestor <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements) with a <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;4"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute set is also relevant to this element&#46; Setting the attribute overrides this&#44; explicitly stating that the advisory information of any ancestors is not relevant to this element&#46; Setting the attribute to the empty string indicates that the element has no advisory information&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;5"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute&#39;s value contains U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; characters&#44; the content is split into multiple lines&#46; Each U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; character represents a line break&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Caution is advised with respect to the use of newlines in <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;6"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attributes&#46;

For instance&#44; the following snippet actually defines an abbreviation&#39;s expansion <em>with a line break in it</em>&#58;

``` text
<p>My logs show that there was some interest in <abbr title="Hypertext
Transport Protocol">HTTP</abbr> today.</p>
```

Some elements&#44; such as <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;abbr&#45;element"></a><code>[abbr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-abbr-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code>&#44; define additional semantics for the <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;7"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute beyond the semantics described above&#46;

The <a id="advisory&#45;information"></a><strong>advisory information</strong> of an element is the value that the following algorithm returns&#44; with the algorithm being aborted once a value is returned&#46; When the algorithm returns the empty string&#44; then there is no advisory information&#46;

1.  If the element has a <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;8"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> attribute&#44; then return the result of running <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;normalize&#45;newlines"></a>[normalize newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines) on its value&#46;

2.  If the element has a parent element&#44; then return the parent element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;advisory&#45;information"></a>[advisory information](#advisory-information)&#46;

3.  Return the empty string&#46;

User agents should inform the user when elements have <a id="the&#45;title&#45;attribute&#58;advisory&#45;information&#45;2"></a>[advisory information](#advisory-information)&#44; otherwise the information would not be discoverable&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

##### <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes"></a>3&#46;2&#46;6&#46;2 The <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;lang"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code> and <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;lang"></a><code>[xml&#58;lang](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag)</code> attributes[](#the-lang-and-xml:lang-attributes)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Global&#95;attributes&#47;lang](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/lang)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;lang"></a><strong><code>lang</code></strong> attribute &#40;in no namespace&#41; specifies the primary language for the element&#39;s contents and for any of the element&#39;s attributes that contain text&#46; Its value must be a valid BCP 47 language tag&#44; or the empty string&#46; Setting the attribute to the empty string indicates that the primary language is unknown&#46; [&#91;BCP47&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBCP47)

The <a id="attr&#45;xml&#45;lang"></a><strong>[<code>lang</code>](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag)</strong> attribute in the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;xml&#45;namespace"></a>[XML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-namespace) is defined in XML&#46; [&#91;XML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXML)

If these attributes are omitted from an element&#44; then the language of this element is the same as the language of its parent element&#44; if any &#40;except for <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element"></a><code>[slot](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-slot-element)</code> elements in a <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree)&#41;&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;lang&#45;2"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code> attribute in no namespace may be used on any <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;lang&#45;2"></a>[<code>lang</code> attribute in the XML namespace](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag) may be used on <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) in <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;xml&#45;documents"></a>[XML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document)&#44; as well as elements in other namespaces if the relevant specifications allow it &#40;in particular&#44; MathML and SVG allow <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;lang&#45;3"></a>[<code>lang</code> attributes in the XML namespace](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag) to be specified on their elements&#41;&#46; If both the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;lang&#45;3"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code> attribute in no namespace and the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;lang&#45;4"></a>[<code>lang</code> attribute in the XML namespace](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag) are specified on the same element&#44; they must have exactly the same value when compared in an <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) manner&#46;

Authors must not use the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;lang&#45;5"></a>[<code>lang</code> attribute in the XML namespace](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag) on <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) in <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;documents"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#46; To ease migration to and from XML&#44; authors may specify an attribute in no namespace with no prefix and with the literal localname &#34;<code>xml&#58;lang</code>&#34; on <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) in <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;documents&#45;2"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document)&#44; but such attributes must only be specified if a <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;lang&#45;4"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code> attribute in no namespace is also specified&#44; and both attributes must have the same value when compared in an <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) manner&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The attribute in no namespace with no prefix and with the literal localname &#34;<code>xml&#58;lang</code>&#34; has no effect on language processing&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To determine the <a id="language"></a><strong>language</strong> of a node&#44; user agents must use the first appropriate step in the following list&#58;

<strong>If the node is an element that has a <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;xml&#45;lang&#45;6"></a>[<code>lang</code> attribute in the XML namespace](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-lang-tag) set</strong>

Use the value of that attribute&#46;

<strong>If the node is an <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements) or an element in the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;svg&#45;namespace"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)&#44; and it has a <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;lang&#45;5"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code> in no namespace attribute set</strong>

Use the value of that attribute&#46;

<strong>If the node&#39;s parent is a <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;shadow&#45;root"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-root)</strong>

Use the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;language"></a>[language](#language) of that <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;shadow&#45;root&#45;2"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-root)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;documentfragment&#45;host"></a>[host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host)&#46;

<strong>If the node&#39;s <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;parent&#45;element"></a>[parent element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#parent-element) is not null</strong>

Use the <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;language&#45;2"></a>[language](#language) of that <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;parent&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[parent element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#parent-element)&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

If there is a <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;pragma&#45;set&#45;default&#45;language"></a>[pragma&#45;set default language](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#pragma-set-default-language) set&#44; then that is the language of the node&#46; If there is no <a id="the&#45;lang&#45;and&#45;xml&#58;lang&#45;attributes&#58;pragma&#45;set&#45;default&#45;language&#45;2"></a>[pragma&#45;set default language](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#pragma-set-default-language) set&#44; then language information from a higher&#45;level protocol &#40;such as HTTP&#41;&#44; if any&#44; must be used as the final fallback language instead&#46; In the absence of any such language information&#44; and in cases where the higher&#45;level protocol reports multiple languages&#44; the language of the node is unknown&#44; and the corresponding language tag is the empty string&#46;

If the resulting value is not a recognized language tag&#44; then it must be treated as an unknown language having the given language tag&#44; distinct from all other languages&#46; For the purposes of roundtripping or communicating with other services that expect language tags&#44; user agents should pass unknown language tags through unmodified&#44; and tagged as being BCP 47 language tags&#44; so that subsequent services do not interpret the data as another type of language description&#46; [&#91;BCP47&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBCP47)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; for instance&#44; an element with <code>lang&#61;&#34;xyzzy&#34;</code> would be matched by the selector <code>&#58;lang&#40;xyzzy&#41;</code> &#40;e&#46;g&#46; in CSS&#41;&#44; but it would not be matched by <code>&#58;lang&#40;abcde&#41;</code>&#44; even though both are equally invalid&#46; Similarly&#44; if a web browser and screen reader working in unison communicated about the language of the element&#44; the browser would tell the screen reader that the language was &#34;xyzzy&#34;&#44; even if it knew it was invalid&#44; just in case the screen reader actually supported a language with that tag after all&#46; Even if the screen reader supported both BCP 47 and another syntax for encoding language names&#44; and in that other syntax the string &#34;xyzzy&#34; was a way to denote the Belarusian language&#44; it would be <em>incorrect</em> for the screen reader to then start treating text as Belarusian&#44; because &#34;xyzzy&#34; is not how Belarusian is described in BCP 47 codes &#40;BCP 47 uses the code &#34;be&#34; for Belarusian&#41;&#46;

If the resulting value is the empty string&#44; then it must be interpreted as meaning that the language of the node is <a id="concept&#45;explicitly&#45;unknown"></a><strong>explicitly unknown</strong>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

User agents may use the element&#39;s language to determine proper processing or rendering &#40;e&#46;g&#46; in the selection of appropriate fonts or pronunciations&#44; for dictionary selection&#44; or for the user interfaces of form controls such as date pickers&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute"></a>3&#46;2&#46;6&#46;3 The <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate"></a><code>[translate](#attr-translate)</code> attribute[](#the-translate-attribute)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Global&#95;attributes&#47;translate](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/translate)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox111&#43;Safari6&#43;Chrome19&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;translate"></a><strong><code>translate</code></strong> attribute is used to specify whether an element&#39;s attribute values and the values of its <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node children are to be translated when the page is localized&#44; or whether to leave them unchanged&#46; It is an <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/translate" id="attr-translate-yes-keyword" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>yes</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-translate-yes-state">Yes</dfn>      </td><td>Sets <a href="#translation-mode" id="the-translate-attribute:translation-mode">translation mode</a> to <a href="#translate-enabled" id="the-translate-attribute:translate-enabled">translate&#45;enabled</a>&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/translate" id="attr-translate-no-keyword" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>no</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-translate-no-state">No</dfn>      </td><td>Sets <a href="#translation-mode" id="the-translate-attribute:translation-mode-2">translation mode</a> to <a href="#no-translate" id="the-translate-attribute:no-translate">no&#45;translate</a>&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="attr&#45;translate&#45;inherit&#45;state"></a><strong>Inherit</strong> state&#44; and its <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;empty&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[empty value default](#empty-value-default)</em> is the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;yes&#45;state"></a>[Yes](#attr-translate-yes-state) state&#46;

Each element &#40;even non&#45;HTML elements&#41; has a <a id="translation&#45;mode"></a><strong>translation mode</strong>&#44; which is in either the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translate&#45;enabled&#45;2"></a>[translate&#45;enabled](#translate-enabled) state or the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;no&#45;translate&#45;2"></a>[no&#45;translate](#no-translate) state&#46; If an <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;2"></a><code>[translate](#attr-translate)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;yes&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Yes](#attr-translate-yes-state) state&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translation&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[translation mode](#translation-mode) is in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translate&#45;enabled&#45;3"></a>[translate&#45;enabled](#translate-enabled) state&#59; otherwise&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;3"></a><code>[translate](#attr-translate)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;no&#45;state"></a>[No](#attr-translate-no-state) state&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translation&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[translation mode](#translation-mode) is in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;no&#45;translate&#45;3"></a>[no&#45;translate](#no-translate) state&#46; Otherwise&#44; either the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;4"></a><code>[translate](#attr-translate)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;inherit&#45;state"></a>[Inherit](#attr-translate-inherit-state) state&#44; or the element is not an <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements) and thus does not have a <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;translate&#45;5"></a><code>[translate](#attr-translate)</code> attribute&#59; in either case&#44; the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translation&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[translation mode](#translation-mode) is in the same state as its <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;parent&#45;element"></a>[parent element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#parent-element)&#39;s&#44; if any&#44; or in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translate&#45;enabled&#45;4"></a>[translate&#45;enabled](#translate-enabled) state&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;parent&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[parent element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#parent-element) is null&#46;

When an element is in the <a id="translate&#45;enabled"></a><strong>translate&#45;enabled</strong> state&#44; the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translatable&#45;attributes"></a>[translatable attributes](#translatable-attributes) and the values of its <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node children are to be translated when the page is localized&#46;

When an element is in the <a id="no&#45;translate"></a><strong>no&#45;translate</strong> state&#44; the element&#39;s attribute values and the values of its <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node children are to be left as&#45;is when the page is localized&#44; e&#46;g&#46; because the element contains a person&#39;s name or a name of a computer program&#46;

The following attributes are <a id="translatable&#45;attributes"></a><strong>translatable attributes</strong>&#58;

- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;abbr"></a><code>[abbr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-th-abbr)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> elements
- <code>alt</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt"></a><code>[area](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-area-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-img-alt)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-alt)</code> elements
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;content"></a><code>[content](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-content)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> elements&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-name)</code> attribute specifies a metadata name whose value is known to be translatable
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;download"></a><code>[download](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-download)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element"></a><code>[area](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-area-element)</code> elements
- <code>label</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;optgroup&#45;label"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-optgroup-label)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-option-label)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;label"></a><code>[track](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-track-label)</code> elements
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;lang"></a><code>[lang](#attr-lang)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#59; must be &#34;translated&#34; to match the language used in the translation
- <code>placeholder</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-placeholder)</code> and <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-textarea-placeholder)</code> elements
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc"></a><code>[srcdoc](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> elements&#59; must be parsed and recursively processed
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;style"></a><code>[style](#attr-style)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#59; must be parsed and recursively processed &#40;e&#46;g&#46; for the values of <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;content&#39;"></a>[&#39;content&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#content%E2%91%A0) properties&#41;
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](#attr-title)</code> on all <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)
- <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> on <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;button&#41;"></a>[Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#button-state-(type=button)) state or the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;"></a>[Reset Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#reset-button-state-(type=reset)) state

Other specifications may define other attributes that are also <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translatable&#45;attributes&#45;2"></a>[translatable attributes](#translatable-attributes)&#46; For example&#44; ARIA would define the <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;aria&#45;label"></a><code>[aria&#45;label](https://w3c.github.io/aria/#aria-label)</code> attribute as translatable&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;translate"></a><strong><code>translate</code></strong> IDL attribute must&#44; on getting&#44; return true if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translation&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[translation mode](#translation-mode) is <a id="the&#45;translate&#45;attribute&#58;translate&#45;enabled&#45;5"></a>[translate&#45;enabled](#translate-enabled)&#44; and false otherwise&#46; On setting&#44; it must set the content attribute&#39;s value to &#34;<code>yes</code>&#34; if the new value is true&#44; and set the content attribute&#39;s value to &#34;<code>no</code>&#34; otherwise&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; everything in the document is to be translated when the page is localized&#44; except the sample keyboard input and sample program output&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html lang=en> <!-- default on the document element is translate=yes -->
 <head>
  <title>The Bee Game</title> <!-- implied translate=yes inherited from ancestors -->
 </head>
 <body>
  <p>The Bee Game is a text adventure game in English.</p>
  <p>When the game launches, the first thing you should do is type
  <kbd translate=no>eat honey</kbd>. The game will respond with:</p>
  <pre><samp translate=no>Yum yum! That was some good honey!</samp></pre>
 </body>
</html>
```

##### <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute"></a>3&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4 The <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code> attribute[](#the-dir-attribute)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Global&#95;attributes&#47;dir](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/dir)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;dir"></a><strong><code>dir</code></strong> attribute is an <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/dir" id="attr-dir-ltr" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>ltr</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-dir-ltr-state">LTR</dfn>      </td><td>The contents of the element are explicitly directionally isolated left&#45;to&#45;right text&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/dir" id="attr-dir-rtl" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>rtl</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-dir-rtl-state">RTL</dfn>      </td><td>The contents of the element are explicitly directionally isolated right&#45;to&#45;left text&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/dir" id="attr-dir-auto" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>auto</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-dir-auto-state">Auto</dfn>      </td><td>The contents of the element are explicitly directionally isolated text&#44; but the direction      is to be determined programmatically using the contents of the element &#40;as described      below&#41;&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The heuristic used by the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;auto&#45;state"></a>[Auto](#attr-dir-auto-state) state is very crude &#40;it just looks at the first character with a strong directionality&#44; in a manner analogous to the Paragraph Level determination in the bidirectional algorithm&#41;&#46; Authors are urged to only use this value as a last resort when the direction of the text is truly unknown and no better server&#45;side heuristic can be applied&#46; [&#91;BIDI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBIDI)

For <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code> elements&#44; the heuristic is applied on a per&#45;paragraph level&#46;

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="attr&#45;dir&#45;undefined&#45;state"></a><strong>Undefined</strong> state&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;directionality"></a><strong>directionality</strong> of an element &#40;any element&#44; not just an <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](#html-elements)&#41; is either &#39;<a id="concept&#45;ltr"></a><strong>ltr</strong>&#39; or &#39;<a id="concept&#45;rtl"></a><strong>rtl</strong>&#39;&#46; To compute the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[directionality](#the-directionality) given an element <var>element</var>&#44; switch on <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;2"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code> attribute state&#58;

<strong><a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;ltr&#45;state"></a>[LTR](#attr-dir-ltr-state)</strong>

Return &#39;<a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;ltr"></a>[ltr](#concept-ltr)&#39;&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;rtl&#45;state"></a>[RTL](#attr-dir-rtl-state)</strong>

Return &#39;<a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;rtl"></a>[rtl](#concept-rtl)&#39;&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;auto&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Auto](#attr-dir-auto-state)</strong>

1.  Let <var>result</var> be the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;auto&#45;directionality"></a>[auto directionality](#auto-directionality) of <var>element</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>result</var> is null&#44; then return &#39;<a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;ltr&#45;2"></a>[ltr](#concept-ltr)&#39;&#46;

3.  Return <var>result</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;undefined&#45;state"></a>[Undefined](#attr-dir-undefined-state)</strong>

<strong>If <var>element</var> is a <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;bdi&#45;element"></a><code>[bdi](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-bdi-element)</code> element</strong>

1.  Let <var>result</var> be the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;auto&#45;directionality&#45;2"></a>[auto directionality](#auto-directionality) of <var>element</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>result</var> is null&#44; then return &#39;<a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;ltr&#45;3"></a>[ltr](#concept-ltr)&#39;&#46;

3.  Return <var>result</var>&#46;

<strong>If <var>element</var> is an <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;"></a>[Telephone](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#telephone-state-(type=tel)) state</strong>

Return &#39;<a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;ltr&#45;4"></a>[ltr](#concept-ltr)&#39;&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

Return the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;parent&#45;directionality"></a>[parent directionality](#parent-directionality) of <var>element</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;3"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code> attribute is only defined for <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements)&#44; it cannot be present on elements from other namespaces&#46; Thus&#44; elements from other namespaces always end up using the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;parent&#45;directionality&#45;2"></a>[parent directionality](#parent-directionality)&#46;

The <a id="auto&#45;directionality&#45;form&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a><strong>auto&#45;directionality form&#45;associated elements</strong> are&#58;

- <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hidden-state-(type=hidden))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;"></a>[Text](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Search](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Telephone](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#telephone-state-(type=tel))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;"></a>[URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#url-state-(type=url))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>[Email](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#email-state-(type=email))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;"></a>[Password](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#password-state-(type=password))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;"></a>[Submit Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#submit-button-state-(type=submit))&#44; <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;"></a>[Reset Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#reset-button-state-(type=reset))&#44; or <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;button&#41;"></a>[Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#button-state-(type=button)) state&#44; and

- <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code> elements&#46;

To compute the <a id="auto&#45;directionality"></a><strong>auto directionality</strong> given an element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is an <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;auto&#45;directionality&#45;form&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[auto&#45;directionality form&#45;associated element](#auto-directionality-form-associated-elements)&#58;

    1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-value) contains a character of bidirectional character type AL or R&#44; and there is no character of bidirectional character type L anywhere before it in the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-value)&#44; then return &#39;<a id="the&#45;dir&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;rtl&#45;2"></a>[rtl](#concept-rtl)&#39;&#46; [&#91;BIDI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBIDI)

    2.
