------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;17&#43;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android41&#43;

Returns a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code> object for the element&#39;s <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;2"></a><code>[data&#45;&#42;](#attr-data-*)</code> attributes&#46;

Hyphenated names become camel&#45;cased&#46; For example&#44; <code>data&#45;foo&#45;bar&#61;&#34;&#34;</code> becomes <code>element&#46;dataset&#46;fooBar</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;dataset"></a><strong><code>dataset</code></strong> IDL attribute provides convenient accessors for all the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;3"></a><code>[data&#45;&#42;](#attr-data-*)</code> attributes on an element&#46; On getting&#44; the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;dom&#45;dataset"></a><code>[dataset](#dom-dataset)</code> IDL attribute must return a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code> whose associated element is this element&#46;

The <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code> interface is used for the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;dom&#45;dataset&#45;2"></a><code>[dataset](#dom-dataset)</code> attribute&#46; Each <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code> has an <a id="concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;element"></a><strong>associated element</strong>&#46;

<a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;legacyoverridebuiltins"></a><a id="domstringmap"></a><a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window,
 LegacyOverrideBuiltIns]
interface DOMStringMap {
  getter DOMString (DOMString name);
  [CEReactions] setter undefined (DOMString name, DOMString value);
  [CEReactions] deleter undefined (DOMString name);
};
```

To <a id="concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;pairs"></a><strong>get a <code>DOMStringMap</code>&#39;s name&#45;value pairs</strong>&#44; run the following algorithm&#58;

1.  Let <var>list</var> be an empty list of name&#45;value pairs&#46;

2.  For each content attribute on the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code>&#39;s <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;element"></a>[associated element](#concept-domstringmap-element) whose first five characters are the string &#34;<code>data&#45;</code>&#34; and whose remaining characters &#40;if any&#41; do not include any <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII upper alphas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)&#44; in the order that those attributes are listed in the element&#39;s <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;attribute&#45;list"></a>[attribute list](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attribute)&#44; add a name&#45;value pair to <var>list</var> whose name is the attribute&#39;s name with the first five characters removed and whose value is the attribute&#39;s value&#46;

3.  For each name in <var>list</var>&#44; for each U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; in the name that is followed by an <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)&#44; remove the U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; and replace the character that followed it by the same character <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;uppercase"></a>[converted to ASCII uppercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-uppercase)&#46;

4.  Return <var>list</var>&#46;

The <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;names"></a>[supported property names](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names) on a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code> object at any instant are the names of each pair returned from <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;pairs"></a>[getting the <code>DOMStringMap</code>&#39;s name&#45;value pairs](#concept-domstringmap-pairs) at that instant&#44; in the order returned&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;domstringmap&#45;nameditem"></a>To <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;a&#45;named&#45;property"></a>[determine the value of a named property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property) <var>name</var> for a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code>&#44; return the value component of the name&#45;value pair whose name component is <var>name</var> in the list returned from <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;pairs&#45;2"></a>[getting the <code>DOMStringMap</code>&#39;s name&#45;value pairs](#concept-domstringmap-pairs)&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;domstringmap&#45;setitem"></a>To <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;a&#45;new&#45;named&#45;property"></a>[set the value of a new named property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-named-property) or <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;set&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;existing&#45;named&#45;property"></a>[set the value of an existing named property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-named-property) for a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code>&#44; given a property name <var>name</var> and a new value <var>value</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>name</var> contains a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; followed by an <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII lower alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)&#44; then throw a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;syntaxerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SyntaxError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  For each <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha) in <var>name</var>&#44; insert a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; before the character and replace the character with the same character <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase"></a>[converted to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase)&#46;

3.  Insert the string <code>data&#45;</code> at the front of <var>name</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>name</var> is not a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;valid&#45;attribute&#45;local&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[valid attribute local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-attribute-local-name)&#44; then throw an <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;invalidcharactererror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidCharacterError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidcharactererror) <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

5.  <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[Set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) for the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;9"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code>&#39;s <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[associated element](#concept-domstringmap-element) using <var>name</var> and <var>value</var>&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;domstringmap&#45;removeitem"></a>To <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;delete&#45;an&#45;existing&#45;named&#45;property"></a>[delete an existing named property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-delete-an-existing-named-property) <var>name</var> for a <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;10"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  For each <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters&#45;4"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha) in <var>name</var>&#44; insert a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; before the character and replace the character with the same character <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase&#45;2"></a>[converted to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase)&#46;

2.  Insert the string <code>data&#45;</code> at the front of <var>name</var>&#46;

3.  <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;remove"></a>[Remove an attribute by name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-remove) given <var>name</var> and the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;domstringmap&#45;11"></a><code>[DOMStringMap](#domstringmap)</code>&#39;s <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[associated element](#concept-domstringmap-element)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This algorithm will only get invoked by Web IDL for names that are given by the earlier algorithm for <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;domstringmap&#45;pairs&#45;3"></a>[getting the <code>DOMStringMap</code>&#39;s name&#45;value pairs](#concept-domstringmap-pairs)&#46; [&#91;WEBIDL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBIDL)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If a web page wanted an element to represent a space ship&#44; e&#46;g&#46; as part of a game&#44; it would have to use the <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;classes"></a><code>[class](#classes)</code> attribute along with <a id="embedding&#45;custom&#45;non&#45;visible&#45;data&#45;with&#45;the&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;data&#45;&#42;&#45;4"></a><code>[data&#45;&#42;](#attr-data-*)</code> attributes&#58;

``` text
<div class="spaceship" data-ship-id="92432"
     data-weapons="laser 2" data-shields="50%"
     data-x="30" data-y="10" data-z="90">
 <button class="fire"
         onclick="spaceships[this.parentNode.dataset.shipId].fire()">
  Fire
 </button>
</div>
```

Notice how the hyphenated attribute name becomes camel&#45;cased in the API&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Given the following fragment and elements with similar constructions&#58;

``` text
<img class="tower" id="tower5" data-x="12" data-y="5"
     data-ai="robotarget" data-hp="46" data-ability="flames"
     src="towers/rocket.png" alt="Rocket Tower">
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;one could imagine a function <code>splashDamage&#40;&#41;</code> that takes some arguments&#44; the first of which is the element to process&#58;

``` text
function splashDamage(node, x, y, damage) {
  if (node.classList.contains('tower') && // checking the 'class' attribute
      node.dataset.x == x && // reading the 'data-x' attribute
      node.dataset.y == y) { // reading the 'data-y' attribute
    var hp = parseInt(node.dataset.hp); // reading the 'data-hp' attribute
    hp = hp - damage;
    if (hp < 0) {
      hp = 0;
      node.dataset.ai = 'dead'; // setting the 'data-ai' attribute
      delete node.dataset.ability; // removing the 'data-ability' attribute
    }
    node.dataset.hp = hp; // setting the 'data-hp' attribute
  }
}
```

#### <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute"></a>3&#46;2&#46;7 The <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;dom&#45;innertext"></a><code>[innerText](#dom-innertext)</code> and <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;dom&#45;outertext"></a><code>[outerText](#dom-outertext)</code> properties[](#the-innertext-idl-attribute)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLElement&#47;innerText](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/innerText)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox45&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera9&#46;6&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android1&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

<strong><code><var>element</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;innertext&#45;dev"></a>[innerText](#dom-innertext) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the element&#39;s text content &#34;as rendered&#34;&#46;

Can be set&#44; to replace the element&#39;s children with the given value&#44; but with line breaks converted to <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong><code><var>element</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;outertext&#45;dev"></a>[outerText](#dom-outertext) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the element&#39;s text content &#34;as rendered&#34;&#46;

Can be set&#44; to replace the element with the given value&#44; but with line breaks converted to <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="get&#45;the&#45;text&#45;steps"></a><strong>get the text steps</strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;htmlelement"></a>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement) <var>element</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) or if the user agent is a non&#45;CSS user agent&#44; then return <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This step can produce surprising results&#44; as when the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;dom&#45;innertext&#45;2"></a><code>[innerText](#dom-innertext)</code> getter is invoked on an element not <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;being&#45;rendered&#45;2"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; its text contents are returned&#44; but when accessed on an element that is <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;being&#45;rendered&#45;3"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; all of its children that are not <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;being&#45;rendered&#45;4"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) have their text contents ignored&#46;

2.  Let <var>results</var> be a new empty <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

3.  For each child node <var>node</var> of <var>element</var>&#58;

    1.  Let <var>current</var> be the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;2"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) resulting from running the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;rendered&#45;text&#45;collection&#45;steps"></a>[rendered text collection steps](#rendered-text-collection-steps) with <var>node</var>&#46; Each item in <var>results</var> will either be a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;string"></a>[string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string) or a positive integer &#40;a <em>required line break count</em>&#41;&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        Intuitively&#44; a <em>required line break count</em> item means that a certain number of line breaks appear at that point&#44; but they can be collapsed with the line breaks induced by adjacent <em>required line break count</em> items&#44; reminiscent to CSS margin&#45;collapsing&#46;

    2.  For each item <var>item</var> in <var>current</var>&#44; append <var>item</var> to <var>results</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove) any items from <var>results</var> that are the empty string&#46;

5.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[Remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove) any runs of consecutive <em>required line break count</em> items at the start or end of <var>results</var>&#46;

6.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;replace"></a>[Replace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-replace) each remaining run of consecutive <em>required line break count</em> items with a string consisting of as many U&#43;000A LF code points as the maximum of the values in the <em>required line break count</em> items&#46;

7.  Return the concatenation of the string items in <var>results</var>&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLElement&#47;outerText](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/outerText)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox98&#43;Safari1&#46;3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android1&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="dom&#45;innertext"></a><strong><code>innerText</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;outertext"></a><strong><code>outerText</code></strong> getter steps are to return the result of running <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;get&#45;the&#45;text&#45;steps"></a>[get the text steps](#get-the-text-steps) with <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="rendered&#45;text&#45;collection&#45;steps"></a><strong>rendered text collection steps</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;node"></a>[node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node) <var>node</var>&#44; are as follows&#58;

1.  Let <var>items</var> be the result of running the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;rendered&#45;text&#45;collection&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[rendered text collection steps](#rendered-text-collection-steps) with each child node of <var>node</var> in <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; and then concatenating the results to a single <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;3"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

2.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;computed&#45;value"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;visibility&#39;"></a>[&#39;visibility&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#propdef-visibility) is not &#39;visible&#39;&#44; then return <var>items</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>node</var> is not <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;being&#45;rendered&#45;5"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; then return <var>items</var>&#46; For the purpose of this step&#44; the following elements must act as described if the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;computed&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;display&#39;"></a>[&#39;display&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#display-prop) property is not &#39;none&#39;&#58;

    - <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> elements have an associated non&#45;replaced inline <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box"></a>[CSS box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box) whose child boxes include only those of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element descendant nodes&#59;

    - <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> elements have an associated non&#45;replaced block&#45;level <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box&#45;2"></a>[CSS box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box) whose child boxes include only those of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element descendant nodes&#59; and

    - <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> elements have an associated non&#45;replaced block&#45;level <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box&#45;3"></a>[CSS box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box) whose child boxes are as normal for non&#45;replaced block&#45;level <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box&#45;4"></a>[CSS boxes](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    <var>items</var> can be non&#45;empty due to &#39;display&#58;contents&#39;&#46;

4.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#44; then for each CSS text box produced by <var>node</var>&#44; in content order&#44; compute the text of the box after application of the CSS <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;white&#45;space&#39;"></a>[&#39;white&#45;space&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text/#white-space-property) processing rules and <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;text&#45;transform&#39;"></a>[&#39;text&#45;transform&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text/#text-transform-property) rules&#44; set <var>items</var> to the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;4"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of the resulting strings&#44; and return <var>items</var>&#46; The CSS <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;white&#45;space&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;white&#45;space&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-text/#white-space-property) processing rules are slightly modified&#58; collapsible spaces at the end of lines are always collapsed&#44; but they are only removed if the line is the last line of the block&#44; or it ends with a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> element&#46; Soft hyphens should be preserved&#46; [&#91;CSSTEXT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSTEXT)

5.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) a string containing a single U&#43;000A LF code point to <var>items</var>&#46;

6.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;computed&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;display&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;display&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#display-prop) is <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#45;cell&#39;"></a>[&#39;table&#45;cell&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table-cell)&#44; and <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box&#45;5"></a>[CSS box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box) is not the last <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#45;cell&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;table&#45;cell&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table-cell) box of its enclosing <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#45;row&#39;"></a>[&#39;table&#45;row&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table-row) box&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) a string containing a single U&#43;0009 TAB code point to <var>items</var>&#46;

7.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;computed&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[computed value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value) of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;display&#39;&#45;3"></a>[&#39;display&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#display-prop) is <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#45;row&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;table&#45;row&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table-row)&#44; and <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box&#45;6"></a>[CSS box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box) is not the last <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#45;row&#39;&#45;3"></a>[&#39;table&#45;row&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table-row) box of the nearest ancestor <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#39;"></a>[&#39;table&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table) box&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;append&#45;3"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) a string containing a single U&#43;000A LF code point to <var>items</var>&#46;

8.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;append&#45;4"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) 2 &#40;a <em>required line break count</em>&#41; at the beginning and end of <var>items</var>&#46;

9.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;used&#45;value"></a>[used value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#used-value) of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;display&#39;&#45;4"></a>[&#39;display&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#display-prop) is <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;block&#45;level"></a>[block&#45;level](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#block-level) or <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;&#39;table&#45;caption&#39;"></a>[&#39;table&#45;caption&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-tables/#table-caption)&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;list&#45;append&#45;5"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) 1 &#40;a <em>required line break count</em>&#41; at the beginning and end of <var>items</var>&#46; [&#91;CSSDISPLAY&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSDISPLAY)

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Floats and absolutely&#45;positioned elements fall into this category&#46;

10. Return <var>items</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Note that descendant nodes of most replaced elements &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-video-element)</code> — but not <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-button-element)</code>&#41; are not rendered by CSS&#44; strictly speaking&#44; and therefore have no <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;css&#45;box&#45;7"></a>[CSS boxes](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-display/#css-box) for the purposes of this algorithm&#46;

This algorithm is amenable to being generalized to work on <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;range"></a>[ranges](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-range)&#46; Then we can use it as the basis for <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;selection"></a><code>[Selection](https://w3c.github.io/selection-api/#selection-interface)</code>&#39;s stringifier and maybe expose it directly on <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;range&#45;2"></a>[ranges](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-range)&#46; See [Bugzilla bug 10583](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=10583)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="set&#45;the&#45;inner&#45;text&#45;steps"></a><strong>set the inner text steps</strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;htmlelement&#45;2"></a>[HTMLElement](#htmlelement) <var>element</var>&#44; and a string <var>value</var> are&#58;

1.  Let <var>fragment</var> be the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;rendered&#45;text&#45;fragment"></a>[rendered text fragment](#rendered-text-fragment) for <var>value</var> given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;replace&#45;all"></a>[Replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-replace-all) with <var>fragment</var> within <var>element</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;dom&#45;innertext&#45;3"></a><code>[innerText](#dom-innertext)</code> setter steps are to run <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;set&#45;the&#45;inner&#45;text&#45;steps"></a>[set the inner text steps](#set-the-inner-text-steps) with <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and the given value&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;dom&#45;outertext&#45;2"></a><code>[outerText](#dom-outertext)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s parent is null&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;nomodificationallowederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NoModificationAllowedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#nomodificationallowederror) <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>next</var> be <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;next&#45;sibling"></a>[next sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-next-sibling)&#46;

3.  Let <var>previous</var> be <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;previous&#45;sibling"></a>[previous sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-previous-sibling)&#46;

4.  Let <var>fragment</var> be the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;rendered&#45;text&#45;fragment&#45;2"></a>[rendered text fragment](#rendered-text-fragment) for the given value given <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

5.  If <var>fragment</var> has no <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child"></a>[children](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child)&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) a new <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node whose <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data) is the empty string and <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) to <var>fragment</var>&#46;

6.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;replace"></a>[Replace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-replace) <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) with <var>fragment</var> within <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s parent&#46;

7.  If <var>next</var> is non&#45;null and <var>next</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;previous&#45;sibling&#45;2"></a>[previous sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-previous-sibling) is a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;merge&#45;with&#45;the&#45;next&#45;text&#45;node"></a>[merge with the next text node](#merge-with-the-next-text-node) given <var>next</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;previous&#45;sibling&#45;3"></a>[previous sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-previous-sibling)&#46;

8.  If <var>previous</var> is a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;merge&#45;with&#45;the&#45;next&#45;text&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[merge with the next text node](#merge-with-the-next-text-node) given <var>previous</var>&#46;

The <a id="rendered&#45;text&#45;fragment"></a><strong>rendered text fragment</strong> for a string <var>input</var> given a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](#document)</code> <var>document</var> is the result of running the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>fragment</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;create&#45;a&#45;document&#45;fragment"></a>[creating a document fragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-document-fragment) given <var>document</var>&#46;

2.  Let <var>position</var> be a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;position&#45;variable"></a>[position variable](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-position-variable) for <var>input</var>&#44; initially pointing at the start of <var>input</var>&#46;

3.  Let <var>text</var> be the empty string&#46;

4.  While <var>position</var> is not past the end of <var>input</var>&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;collect&#45;a&#45;sequence&#45;of&#45;code&#45;points"></a>[Collect a sequence of code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points) that are not U&#43;000A LF or U&#43;000D CR from <var>input</var> given <var>position</var>&#44; and set <var>text</var> to the result&#46;

    2.  If <var>text</var> is not the empty string&#44; then <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) a new <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;5"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node whose <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data) is <var>text</var> and <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <var>document</var> to <var>fragment</var>&#46;

    3.  While <var>position</var> is not past the end of <var>input</var>&#44; and the code point at <var>position</var> is either U&#43;000A LF or U&#43;000D CR&#58;

        1.  If the code point at <var>position</var> is U&#43;000D CR and the next code point is U&#43;000A LF&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next code point in <var>input</var>&#46;

        2.  Advance <var>position</var> to the next code point in <var>input</var>&#46;

        3.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append&#45;3"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) the result of <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given <var>document</var>&#44; &#34;<code>br</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) to <var>fragment</var>&#46;

5.  Return <var>fragment</var>&#46;

To <a id="merge&#45;with&#45;the&#45;next&#45;text&#45;node"></a><strong>merge with the next text node</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;6"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node <var>node</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>next</var> be <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;next&#45;sibling&#45;2"></a>[next sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-next-sibling)&#46;

2.  If <var>next</var> is not a <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;7"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;replace&#45;data"></a>[Replace data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-replace) with <var>node</var>&#44; <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;length"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length)&#44; 0&#44; and <var>next</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data&#45;4"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;innertext&#45;idl&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[Remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) <var>next</var>&#46;

#### <a id="requirements&#45;relating&#45;to&#45;the&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm"></a>3&#46;2&#46;8 Requirements relating to the bidirectional algorithm[](#requirements-relating-to-the-bidirectional-algorithm)

##### <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters"></a>3&#46;2&#46;8&#46;1 Authoring conformance criteria for bidirectional&#45;algorithm formatting characters[](#authoring-conformance-criteria-for-bidirectional-algorithm-formatting-characters)

<a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;text&#45;content"></a>[Text content](#text-content) in <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) with <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes in their <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;concept&#45;html&#45;contents"></a>[contents](#concept-html-contents)&#44; and text in attributes of <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) that allow free&#45;form text&#44; may contain characters in the ranges U&#43;202A to U&#43;202E and U&#43;2066 to U&#43;2069 &#40;the bidirectional&#45;algorithm formatting characters&#41;&#46; [&#91;BIDI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBIDI)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Authors are encouraged to use the <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;attr&#45;dir"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code> attribute&#44; the <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;the&#45;bdo&#45;element"></a><code>[bdo](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-bdo-element)</code> element&#44; and the <a id="authoring&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#45;for&#45;bidirectional&#45;algorithm&#45;formatting&#45;characters&#58;the&#45;bdi&#45;element"></a><code>[bdi](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-bdi-element)</code> element&#44; rather than maintaining the bidirectional&#45;algorithm formatting characters manually&#46; The bidirectional&#45;algorithm formatting characters interact poorly with CSS&#46;

##### <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria"></a>3&#46;2&#46;8&#46;2 User agent conformance criteria[](#user-agent-conformance-criteria)

User agents must implement the Unicode bidirectional algorithm to determine the proper ordering of characters when rendering documents and parts of documents&#46; [&#91;BIDI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBIDI)

The mapping of HTML to the Unicode bidirectional algorithm must be done in one of three ways&#46; Either the user agent must implement CSS&#44; including in particular the CSS <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;&#39;unicode&#45;bidi&#39;"></a>[&#39;unicode&#45;bidi&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes/#unicode-bidi)&#44; <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;&#39;direction&#39;"></a>[&#39;direction&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-writing-modes/#direction)&#44; and <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;&#39;content&#39;"></a>[&#39;content&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#content%E2%91%A0) properties&#44; and must have&#44; in its user agent style sheet&#44; the rules using those properties given in this specification&#39;s [rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#rendering) section&#44; or&#44; alternatively&#44; the user agent must act as if it implemented just the aforementioned properties and had a user agent style sheet that included all the aforementioned rules&#44; but without letting style sheets specified in documents override them&#44; or&#44; alternatively&#44; the user agent must implement another styling language with equivalent semantics&#46; [&#91;CSSGC&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSGC)

<a id="bidireq"></a>The following elements and attributes have requirements defined by the [rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#rendering) section that&#44; due to the requirements in this section&#44; are requirements on all user agents &#40;not just those that [support the suggested default rendering](#renderingUA)&#41;&#58;

- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;attr&#45;dir"></a><code>[dir](#attr-dir)</code> attribute
- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;the&#45;bdi&#45;element"></a><code>[bdi](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-bdi-element)</code> element
- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;the&#45;bdo&#45;element"></a><code>[bdo](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-bdo-element)</code> element
- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code> element
- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code> element
- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code> element
- <a id="user&#45;agent&#45;conformance&#45;criteria&#58;the&#45;wbr&#45;element"></a><code>[wbr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-wbr-element)</code> element

#### <a id="wai&#45;aria"></a>3&#46;2&#46;9 Requirements related to ARIA and to platform accessibility APIs[](#wai-aria)

User agent requirements for implementing Accessibility API semantics on <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](#html-elements) are defined in HTML Accessibility API Mappings&#46; In addition to the rules there&#44; for a <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;custom&#45;element"></a>[custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element) <var>element</var>&#44; the default ARIA role semantics are determined as follows&#58; [&#91;HTMLAAM&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsHTMLAAM)

1.  Let <var>map</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#46;

2.  If <var>map</var>&#91;&#34;<code>role</code>&#34;&#93; <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;map&#45;exists"></a>[exists](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#44; then return it&#46;

3.  Return no role&#46;

Similarly&#44; for a <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element) <var>element</var>&#44; the default ARIA state and property semantics&#44; for a state or property named <var>stateOrProperty</var>&#44; are determined as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;attached&#45;internals"></a>[attached internals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attached-internals) is non&#45;null&#58;

    1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;attached&#45;internals&#45;2"></a>[attached internals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attached-internals)&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[get the <var>stateOrProperty</var>&#45;associated element](#attr-associated-element) exists&#44; then return the result of running it&#46;

    2.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;attached&#45;internals&#45;3"></a>[attached internals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attached-internals)&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[get the <var>stateOrProperty</var>&#45;associated elements](#attr-associated-elements) exists&#44; then return the result of running it&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;internal&#45;content&#45;attribute&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[internal content attribute map](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internal-content-attribute-map)&#91;<var>stateOrProperty</var>&#93; <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;map&#45;exists&#45;2"></a>[exists](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists)&#44; then return it&#46;

3.  Return the default value for <var>stateOrProperty</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The &#34;default semantics&#34; referred to here are sometimes also called &#34;native&#34;&#44; &#34;implicit&#34;&#44; or &#34;host language&#34; semantics in ARIA&#46; [&#91;ARIA&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsARIA)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

One implication of these definitions is that the default semantics can change over time&#46; This allows custom elements the same expressivity as built&#45;in elements&#59; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; compare to how the default ARIA role semantics of an <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element change as the <a id="wai&#45;aria&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute is added or removed&#46;

For an example of this in action&#44; see [the custom elements section](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-elements-accessibility-example)&#46;
